articles.title: Stray Kids Join BTS in Withholding Music From 2027 Grammy Consideration
articles.author: Hannah Dailey

paras.en: Stray Kids is joining BTS in straying from the Grammys, with label JYP Entertainment telling outlets such as BBC and Variety on Friday (Oct. 2) that the boy band did not submit anything for consideration at the 2027 awards.
paras.zh: Stray Kids与BTS一起偏离了格莱美颁奖典礼， JYP娱乐公司周五（ 10月2日）告诉BBC和Variety等媒体，男孩乐队没有提交任何东西供2027年颁奖典礼考虑。

paras.en: The company reportedly did not elaborate on the eight-piece group’s decision to skip out on Grammy submissions, but it seems likely that it comes in response to the Recording Academy’s recent installation of a best Asian pop music performance category. In July, the members of BTS announced that they would not be participating in the Grammys — despite their massive year with three-week Billboard 200-topping album ARIRANG — in protest of the awards “being divided by region or language.”
paras.zh: 据报道，该公司没有详细说明八人小组决定跳过格莱美奖的提交，但似乎是为了回应录音学院最近安装的最佳亚洲流行音乐表演类别。7月， BTS的成员宣布他们不会参加格莱美颁奖典礼—尽管他们在为期三周的Billboard 200顶级专辑ARIRANG中表现出色—以抗议“按地区或语言划分”的奖项。

paras.en: Billboard has reached out to reps for Stray Kids and the Grammys for comment.
paras.zh: Billboard已联系Stray Kids和The Grammys的代表征求意见。

paras.en: The addition of best Asian pop music performance to ballots has been a hot topic for months leading up to now. At the time of BTS’ boycott announcement, Recording Academy CEO Harvey Mason Jr. stated, “I am saddened to hear that BTS has chosen not to participate in the Grammy Awards process this year, but as a music creator, I understand and respect their decision.”
paras.zh: 几个月来，将最佳亚洲流行音乐表演添加到选票中一直是一个热门话题。在BTS宣布抵制时， Recording Academy首席执行官Harvey Mason Jr.表示： “我很难过听到BTS选择不参加今年的格莱美颁奖典礼，但作为一名音乐创作者，我理解并尊重他们的决定。”

paras.en: “I do want to clarify something that seems to be getting lost in the conversation,” he continued, emphasizing that submitting in localized genre-based categories does not bar artists from consideration in the general categories. “The Asian pop category was created to celebrate the depth, diversity and extraordinary growth of pop artistry coming out of Asia. The spirit of this new category is to shine a dedicated spotlight on these important artists. More categories mean more artists’ work is recognized. It’s never to divide, but to expand who is recognized by our 15,000 Grammy voters.”
paras.zh: “我确实想澄清一些似乎在谈话中迷失的东西，”他继续说道，并强调以基于流派的本地化类别提交并不妨碍艺术家在一般类别中进行考虑。“亚洲流行音乐类别的创立是为了庆祝亚洲流行艺术的深度、多样性和非凡增长。这个新类别的精神是专门关注这些重要的艺术家。更多的类别意味着更多的艺术家作品得到认可。它永远不会分裂，而是扩大我们15,000名格莱美选民的认可。”

paras.en: As recently reported by Billboard, the academy has continued its discussions about the category in light of the controversy. In early September, there was a virtual call with 80-plus artists, executives and stakeholders from the Asian music community with trustees and governors from the Recording Academy to review the efficacy of the new award.
paras.zh: 正如Billboard最近报道的那样，鉴于争议，该学院继续就该类别进行讨论。9月初，来自亚洲音乐界的80多位艺术家、高管和利益相关者与唱片学院的受托人和州长进行了虚拟电话会议，以审查新奖项的功效。

paras.en: On Thursday (Oct. 1), however, the academy confirmed its intentions to move forward with the best Asian pop music performance recognition.
paras.zh: 然而，周四（ 10月1日） ，学院确认了推进亚洲最佳流行音乐表演表彰的意图。

paras.en: “Over the past several weeks the academy has been conducting listening sessions and have been in dialogue with leaders of the Asian music community,” Mason Jr. stated. “In this case, we heard candid feedback from people in our community who don’t support the continuation of this category. We also heard from people who didn’t have accurate information about the category, and having space to clear up misperceptions has been especially valuable. But by far, the loudest feedback we heard was from people who were enthusiastic supporters of the category, fellow music creators expressing their encouragement for keeping it.”
paras.zh: Mason Jr.表示： “在过去的几周里，学院一直在举办听证会，并与亚洲音乐界的领导人进行对话。”「在这种情况下，我们听到了社区中不支持继续保留此类别用户的坦诚反馈。我们还听取了对该类别没有准确信息的人的意见，有足够的空间来消除误解尤其有价值。但到目前为止，我们听到的最响亮的反馈来自该类别的热情支持者，其他音乐创作者表达了他们对保留该类别的鼓励。”

paras.en: “We understand this conclusion will not satisfy everyone, and that never feels good,” he added. “But at the same time, we are confident it’s the right conclusion for the music community overall.”
paras.zh: 他补充说： “我们理解这一结论不会让所有人满意，而且永远不会感觉良好。” “但与此同时，我们相信这对整个音乐界来说是正确的结论。”

paras.en: Though going without Grammy recognition, Stray Kids have had an incredible run as of late. In the past year alone, the group has topped the Billboard 200 twice with November EP DO IT and August’s THIS & THAT. The title track from the latter reached No. 38 on the Billboard Hot 100.
paras.zh: 虽然没有获得格莱美奖，但流浪儿童最近的表现令人难以置信。仅在过去的一年里，该集团就以11月的EP DO IT和August的THIS & THAT两次登上Billboard 200榜首。后者的冠军曲目在Billboard Hot 100上排名第38位。

articles.title: Doja Cat’s Tour Ma Vie Setlist: Every Song Played at the First U.S. Show
articles.author: Michael Saponara

paras.en: Doja Cat kicked off the North American Leg of her Tour Ma Vie world tour on Thursday night (Oct. 1) at Little Caesars Arena in Detroit.
paras.zh: Doja Cat于周四晚上（ 10月1日）在底特律的小凯撒竞技场（ Little Caesars Arena ）开始了她的北美巡回演唱会Ma Vie世界巡回演唱会。

paras.en: The U.S. is the last to see Doja on the trek, which has taken her across the globe, making stops in Australia, Asia, South America and Europe before coming stateside.
paras.zh: 美国是最后一个在长途跋涉中看到Doja的人，这使她走遍了全球，在来到美国之前在澳大利亚，亚洲，南美洲和欧洲停留。

paras.en: Latto is on board as an opener on the North American dates. After teaming up on the Atlanta native’s Big Mama album, Doja and Latto delivered the live debut of their “Okayyy” collaboration on Thursday.
paras.zh: Latto是北美日期的揭幕战。Doja和Latto在亚特兰大本地人的Big Mama专辑中合作后，于周四现场首次亮相他们的“Okayyy”合作。

paras.en: Doja has revamped the setlist for the U.S. with additions such as “Cyber Sex,” “You Right,” “Shutcho,” “97,” “Balut” and a fresh remix of “Boss Bitch.” Filled with plenty of wardrobe changes and anthems spanning Doja’s decorated catalog, which boasts nine top 10 Billboard Hot 100 hits (two No. 1s), the dynamic show is broken into four acts.
paras.zh: Doja通过增加“Cyber Sex” ， “You Right” ， “Shutcho” ， “97” ， “Balut”和新的“Boss Bitch”混音，对美国的歌曲列表进行了改进。“Doja的装饰目录中充满了大量的衣柜变化和国歌，其中包括九首十大Billboard Hot 100热门歌曲（两首第一名） ，动态表演分为四幕。

paras.en: Next up, the Grammy-winning artist will be taking her talents to Chicago, Salt Lake City, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Houston, Orlando, Atlanta, Boston, Toronto and Philadelphia before wrapping up on Dec. 1 with a headlining show at Madison Square Garden in New York City.
paras.zh: 接下来，这位获得格莱美奖的艺术家将把她的才华带到芝加哥、盐湖城、旧金山、洛杉矶、休斯顿、奥兰多、亚特兰大、波士顿、多伦多和费城，然后于12月1日在纽约市麦迪逊广场花园举行的头条新闻节目结束。

paras.en: The tour comes in support of Doja Cat’s Vie album, which arrived in September 2025 and debuted at No. 4 on the Billboard 200 with 57,000 total album-equivalent units earned, according to Luminate.
paras.zh: 根据Luminate的说法，这次巡演是为了支持Doja Cat的Vie专辑，该专辑于2025年9月到达，并在Billboard 200上排名第四，总共获得了57,000张专辑等效单位。

paras.en: It’s been three years since Doja last launched a full-length tour run in the U.S. She previously trekked throughout North America in late 2023 as part of The Scarlet Tour, which also included a 2024 Coachella performance.
paras.zh: 自Doja上次在美国推出全长巡演以来，已经过去三年了。她曾于2023年底在北美各地徒步旅行，作为The Scarlet Tour的一部分，其中还包括2024年的科切拉表演。

articles.title: Anne Hathaway Says Rihanna Inspired Her to Shake Up Her Maternity Style: ‘She Changed the Game’
articles.author: Hannah Dailey

paras.en: Anne Hathaway is shining bright like a diamond in her maternity looks, and she credits Rihanna as her inspiration.
paras.zh: 安妮·海瑟薇（ Anne Hathaway ）像钻石一样闪闪发光，她认为蕾哈娜（ Rihanna ）是她的灵感来源。

paras.en: While visiting CBS Mornings on Friday (Oct. 1), the actress opened up about her glamorous outfits on red carpets as of late as she promotes new psychological thriller Verity, in which she plays the titular role. When host Gayle King praised her for being so adventurous with her wardrobe while proudly showing off her baby bump, Hathaway — who’s expecting her third child with husband Adam Shulman — said, “I think we have Rihanna to thank.”
paras.zh: 在周五（ 10月1日）访问哥伦比亚广播公司早间节目时，这位女演员最近在红地毯上公开了她迷人的服装，因为她推广了新的心理惊悚片Verity ，在其中她扮演了名义上的角色。当体验达人Gayle King称赞她在自豪地炫耀她的婴儿颠簸的同时对衣柜充满冒险精神时， Hathaway （她正在期待与丈夫Adam Shulman的第三个孩子）说： “我想我们要感谢Rihanna。”

paras.en: “She changed the game,” the Devil Wears Prada star continued of the Fenty mogul. “When I saw what she was doing with her maternity style, I just realized that I just needed to use my imagination and go out there and have more fun.”
paras.zh: “她改变了游戏规则，”穿着Prada的恶魔明星继续说道。“当我看到她以母性风格所做的事情时，我刚刚意识到，我只需要运用我的想象力，走出去，享受更多的乐趣。”

paras.en: Indeed, Ri has earned acclaim for how she approached maternity fashion during her pregnancies with sons RZA and Riot Rose and daughter Rocki, whom she shares with A$AP Rocky. Rather than always keeping her baby bumps concealed or camouflaged, the hitmaker embraced bold colors and cutouts that made her belly a focal point.
paras.zh: 事实上， Ri在怀孕期间与儿子RZA和Riot Rose以及女儿Rocki （她与A $ AP Rocky分享）一起对待孕妇时尚的方式赢得了赞誉。这位热门歌手不是总是隐藏或伪装婴儿的颠簸，而是采用大胆的颜色和剪裁，使她的腹部成为焦点。

paras.en: “I’m enjoying not having to worry about covering up my tummy,” Rihanna told People in 2022. “If I feel a little chubby, it’s like, whatever! It’s a baby!”
paras.zh: 蕾哈娜在2022年告诉《人物》杂志： “我很享受不用担心掩盖我的肚子。” “如果我觉得有点胖，那就像是，不管怎样！这是一个婴儿！”

paras.en: As for Hathaway, she told King that — in addition to fun pregnancy fashion — she’s enjoying family time with her two sons, who are 10 and 6. “We’re thrilled, we’re overjoyed,” the Oscar winner shared. “But what we’re really focused on right now is actually just taking in still being a family of four, because everything’s going to change for us, but it’s really going to change for our kids.”
paras.zh: 至于Hathaway ，她告诉King ，除了有趣的怀孕时尚之外，她还与10岁和6岁的两个儿子一起享受家庭时光。“我们很高兴，我们非常高兴，”这位奥斯卡获奖者分享道。“但我们现在真正关注的实际上只是接受仍然是一个四口之家，因为对我们来说一切都会改变，但对我们的孩子来说真的会改变。”

paras.en: Watch Hathaway chat about Ri’s impact on her maternity style and new movie Verity below.

articles.title: ‘Digger’ Unearths $1.2M in Box Office Previews Amid Warner Bros.’ Leadership Shake-Up
articles.author: Ryan Gajewski

paras.en: Tom Cruise‘s Digger begins a bumpy box office road as it opens theatrically amid a period of transition for the Warner Bros. Motion Picture Group.

Digger collected $1.2 million domestically from Thursday previews ahead of opening this weekend in more than 3,300 North American locations. Warner Bros. expects a start in the range of $12 million to $15 million for the satire that carries a $125 million production budget.

Director Alejandro G. Iñárritu‘s ambitious movie marks a big swing for the studio and star alike. Digger is unlike the recent action franchises for which Cruise has been known and harkens back to the more filmmaker-driven projects from earlier in his career, such as Rain Man, Born on the Fourth of July and Magnolia. Riz Ahmed, John Goodman and Sandra Hüller also star in Digger, which centers on Cruise’s audacious oil tycoon grappling with having started a natural disaster.

Warner Bros. sees this as an awards play and hopes for legs through word of mouth, although critics have been split, as Digger holds a 52 percent approval rating from Rotten Tomatoes reviewers. In his review for The Hollywood Reporter, chief film critic David Rooney wrote that the film “ultimately just prompts a worn-down shrug.”

The film arrives in theaters amid news having broken that Warner Bros. film chiefs Michael De Luca and Pamela Abdy are exiting the studio. The move comes ahead of Paramount Skydance’s $111 billion merger with Warner Bros. that is likely to be finalized Oct. 6, with Dana Goldberg and Josh Greenstein expected to oversee the film side for both studios. De Luca and Abdy had a glittery 2025, highlighted by the Oscar wins for such celebrated titles as One Battle After Another and Sinners, although the conversation surrounding this year’s output has been dominated by high-profile misses like The Bride! and Supergirl.

Meanwhile, Amazon MGM Studios’ Verity is expected to take the top spot over the weekend as spooky season begins. Launching Friday in 3,510 North American theaters, Verity grossed $4.5 million from Thursday previews. The studio projects an opening in the range of $27 million to $30 million for filmmaker Michael Showalter’s thriller that carries a $40 million production budget. Starring Anne Hathaway, Dakota Johnson and Josh Hartnett, Verity adapts Colleen Hoover’s novel about struggling writer Lowen Ashleigh (Johnson) taking a gig as a ghostwriter for acclaimed author Verity Crawford (Hathaway).

Its previews total marks the second-best sum for a Hoover feature adaptation, behind the $7 million for Sony’s embattled 2024 offering It Ends With Us that notched an opening weekend of $50 million domestically. Last year, Universal’s adaptation of Hoover’s Reminders of Him collected $1.9 million in previews on its way to a $17.9 million domestic opening weekend.

Verity holds a challenging 39 percent Rotten Tomatoes score from reviewers. Critic Richard Lawson wrote for THR that the movie “careens off a cliff, plummeting past so-bad-it’s-good and crashing on the rocks of agonizingly dumb.”

articles.title: James Gunn, Peter Safran to Stay at DC Studios as Brand Takes Key Position at Skydance
articles.author: Aaron Couch

paras.en: When David Ellison unveiled Skydance as the new (but old) name for the combined Paramount and Warner Bros. media entity Friday morning, he showed off a snazzy video reel with clips of movies and shows from both companies, set to the Hans Zimmer score from Inception.
The video end with a constellation of eight brand logos surrounding the Skydance name. And at the top tier, above Skydance, were the Paramount mountain, the Warners shield, and … the round DC bullet.
The appearance of DC in the constellation is as strong a Bat-signal as you can have as to the importance of DC, both the studio and the publisher, to the new company.

More importantly, according to several insiders, in the midst of a shakeout that is seeing executives stay or exiting, DC heads James Gunn and Peter Safran are staying put. At least for the foreseeable future.

Multiple sources tell The Hollywood Reporter that the duo met with Ellison in person Thursday and that the meeting was positive. The pair were asked to stay and “keep doing what you’re doing,” per one source.

But it’s unclear how the two heads, and DC in general, fit into the organizational structure of Skydance. It is unknown to whom Gunn and Safran would report, whether it would be straight to Ellison or if it would be layered underneath Josh Greenstein and Dana Goldberg, the current Paramount film heads who are expected to oversee both film studios, while current Warner film chiefs, Pam Abdy and Michael De Luca, are being shown the door. (At Warner Bros. Discovery, Gunn and Safran reported directly to CEO David Zaslav.)

At this point, it is known that Ellison is supportive of Gunn and Safran and wants them to continue leading. The general consensus is they should at least see through the releases of the movies that are either completed or in post-production, namely the upcoming horror thriller Clayface (Oct. 23), and the especially Man of Tomorrow, the big-budget Superman sequel that opens July 2027. In a show of support, Ellison visited the Atlanta set of that movie over the summer.

No one want to a repeat of the situation that occurred with the 2023 releases of The Flash and Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom, two movies made by one studio regime and opened by another, and which were left dangling in the wind. Both underperformed at the box office.
That said, the executives’ fortunes could turn swiftly turn. Abdy and DeLuca are examples of that.

As one studio insider notes, De Luca and Abdy “were led to believe they would still be here post-merger.” Adds this person: “They met with David months ago and felt secure. Clearly a lot has changed since then.”

The DC logo appearance is also good news for DC Comics, which in the last two years has seen an turnaround in which the publisher has overtaken sales and marketshare from rival Marvel Comics for the first time in decades. That is thanks to the new Absolute Universe imprint and a focus on rebuilding creator relationships.

In the past several years, there have been blips of rumors that Warner Bros. Discovery wanted to sell off the division, which WBD head David Zaslav never did. The likelihood of that is even less now. “It’s an IP generator,” says one source with knowledge of the workings of DC and comics world.
It does, however, suggest DC could potentially put out comics based on Paramount-owned IP, such as Star Trek and Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles.
“I can see why Skydance would combine Nickelodeon with Cartoon Network,” says the source. “DC? They’re not touching that.”

articles.title: Skydance Is a Decent Name, It’s Just Weaker Than Paramount or Warner Bros.
articles.author: James Hibberd

paras.en: In the wake of David Ellison announcing that his combined Paramount-Warner Bros. company would be called Skydance, many on social media are making variations on the same comment: “Ellison just killed the legacies of both Warner Bros. and Paramount in one fell swoop,” bemoaned one New York Post. “Skydance is so weak.”

Ellison has reassured that the 103-year-old Warner Bros. brand and the 114-year-old Paramount brand will stick around. “We will honor what makes Paramount and Warner Bros. special — giving both studios the opportunity to grow, tell more great stories and bring those stories to even broader audiences around the world, powered by the scale and capabilities of Skydance,” he wrote in a statement announcing the branding change Friday.

Ellison revealed a logo menu that had Skydance front and center and large, orbited by tiny icons for brands like Warners and Paramount (along with CBS, HBO Max, DC, CNN and, perhaps just to balance out the graphic, Nickelodeon).

It’s unclear how much the Paramount and Warner Bros. brands will mean going forward. The optimistic parent-studio example would be something like Comcast owning Universal — audiences still think of Universal as its own thing. The pessimistic version is Disney buying 20th Century Fox — it kept the studio but dropped the “Fox,” and the label’s output shrank. Early signs, including Ellison’s leadership shakeups, point to a combined studio here as well. “Paramount” and “Warner Bros.” might remain strong entities … or could devolve into names used mostly for the movies and shows they’re stamped on rather than for actual companies.

Still, the naming decision looked rather egoic, didn’t it? You buy one iconic company, then buy a second iconic company, then slap your 20-year-old production company’s banner above both of them. It’s not quite a Trump-ian move — Ellison could have called the company ELLISON and then sat back and laughed at Mark Ruffalo’s rage tweets — but it’s certainly in the neighborhood of saying, “Hey, I won.”
And as corporate names go, Skydance isn’t terrible.
I know. The move this morning is to hate on it. But Skydance isn’t like … Comcast. Or Max. Or Tubi. Or Peacock. Or AMC Networks (relationship to AMC Theatres? None whatsoever!). Those are terrible.

Skydance just sounds very much like what it is: A circa 2006 production company that also feels vaguely Silicon Valley. One can imagine a Skydance Corp. making fintech products, data centers or dating apps. As such, it also seems very 21st century, which one supposes goes into the brand’s plus column.
And it doesn’t carry a fraction of the weight, gravitas, legacy, or brand recognition of the studios it effectively overtook.

Warner Bros. has the most value for consumers. The studio has 12,500 feature films and 2,400 TV programs. The name is so valued, it’s survived countless mergers and acquisitions (see Erik Hayden’s excellent history of the Warner Bros. and Paramount names).

Yet the name is also a relic — the legacy of Harry, Albert, Sam and Jack, the last of whom passed away nearly 50 years ago. One can understand Ellison not wanting to name the parent company after some studio bosses from the 1940s.

The Paramount library is considerably smaller, but the name was still a household name. The combined company could have kept Paramount on top. The name doesn’t feel particularly dated. So to whatever extent going with the name Skydance is a surprise, the surprise is that Ellison didn’t just stick with Paramount like Shari Redstone did when she merged CBS with her father’s company Viacom (now there’s a bad name — Viacom sounds like a villainous corporation from a 1980s Paul Verhoeven film).
Doing some combined monster like “Paramount Skydance Warner Bros. Discovery” would have been dreadful — a name that only a lawyer could love and a constant reminder of the ghost of mergers past.
Starting Tuesday, all this becomes Wall Street official when PSKY switches to SKYD on the ticker.

There’s a line from Raiders of the Lost Ark — which opens with the Paramount mountain fading into a similar-looking peak in South America — where the villain tells Indiana Jones that when you bury a trinket in the sand, and enough years pass, it becomes priceless. So who knows. Maybe with another 100 years of track record, Skydance will be a name worth to entertainment fans what Warner Bros. and Paramount are worth today. It’s just a long time to wait.
