articles.title: Taking daily supplement may help preserve muscle as you age — even without exercise

paras.en: Daily creatine supplementation could help middle-aged and older adults preserve lean muscle mass, gain strength and support cognitive function, whether it's paired with exercise or not, according to a study published in the Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition.
The 12-week study, conducted by researchers at Texas A&M University’s Exercise & Sport Nutrition Lab, evaluated 64 men and women ages 45 to 65.

Participants were divided into non-exercise and exercise-plus-diet groups, then randomly assigned to take either 10 grams of creatine monohydrate per day — administered in two 5-gram doses — or a placebo.

Creatine is a naturally occurring compound that helps cells regenerate adenosine triphosphate (ATP), the primary energy source for cellular activity in both muscle and brain tissue, according to Cleveland Clinic.
Creatine monohydrate is a dietary supplement that helps muscles produce quick energy during activities like strength training.

Adults naturally lose muscle mass and strength as they age, a condition known as sarcopenia. While dieting can accelerate that muscle loss, the new study found that creatine monohydrate helped counter the effect.

Adding creatine to an exercise and diet intervention resulted in greater reductions in body fat percentage, better preservation of lean body mass, and marked improvements in upper- and lower-body strength compared to a placebo.

Even among participants who did not engage in exercise or dietary changes, daily creatine supplementation increased lean tissue mass and improved muscular strength and endurance, according to the study.

"The fact that you can increase lean muscle mass even without exercise is remarkable, especially as we age," New York-based fitness coach Jacob Zemer told Fox News Digital. "Between the physical and mental benefits, most people should be considering creatine supplementation."
The expert, who was not involved in the study, noted that even participants who did not exercise saw an increase in their bench press and leg press.
"The fact that you can increase lean muscle mass even without exercise is remarkable."
Zemer said the findings suggest creatine may help build actual muscle tissue that generates strength, rather than simply increasing the amount of water stored in muscle cells.
Beyond physical performance, the researchers found that the 10-gram daily dose of creatine supported improvements in select tests of memory and cognitive processing.

"My main takeaway from the study is that the benefits of creatine extend far beyond just athletes and bodybuilders," Zemer said. "Creatine continues to be the most scientifically studied and validated supplement on the market."
However, the trainer emphasized that supplementation should not replace regular physical activity.
"Just because you can increase lean muscle mass by taking creatine without exercise does not mean that it is optimal or a replacement for exercise," Zemer cautioned.
"The benefits of exercise will always supersede those of creatine alone, and when the two are combined, they are both enhanced."
The study authors noted several limitations to their findings.

Participants chose whether to join the exercise or non-exercise groups before being randomly assigned to receive either creatine or a placebo, which could have introduced lifestyle differences between the groups.

Additionally, because the study lasted just 12 weeks and included only healthy adults, researchers don't yet know whether the benefits would be long-term or whether they would apply to people with serious metabolic or neurological conditions.

For those considering taking creatine, Zemer advised consulting a healthcare professional to determine whether it's right for them, then choosing a reputable brand, staying hydrated and taking it consistently.

"Recommended minimum dosages for creatine are typically 3 grams for women and 5 grams for men," he said. "This study used higher dosages. Creatine is about consistency rather than when you take it, so find a time you can consistently take it daily."
According to the NIH Office of Dietary Supplements, creatine is generally considered safe for healthy adults, although some people may experience bloating, stomach discomfort or water retention.
Experts recommend talking with a healthcare provider before beginning supplementation, particularly for those with kidney disease or other chronic health conditions.

articles.title: Mickie James set to appear at TNA's Bound for Glory as incredible matches lined up on card

paras.en: Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA) legend Mickie James will appear at Bound for Glory next weekend as the company prepares for its biggest show of the year.

During "Impact" on Thursday, TNA aired a vignette that showed an older logo on a crate. When the crate opened, a strong beam of light appeared. When the light went dark, a white cowgirl hat and a denim jacket appeared. A woman took the hat and placed it on her head.
James’ "Hardcore Country" entrance theme played and fans knew exactly who was in the video.

The legendary women’s wrestler had multiple stints in TNA. She joined the company initially in 2002 while TNA was under the National Wrestling Alliance banner. She worked there for about a year before moving to WWE.

James returned to TNA in 2010, immediately getting into a feud with Madison Rayne. She defeated Rayne to win the TNA Knockouts Championship in April 2011, becoming the first woman in pro wrestling history to hold the TNA Knockouts Championship, WWE Women’s Championship and WWE Divas Championship. She’s a five-time Knockouts champion.
She was also with the company from 2021 to 2023. Earlier this year, she battled the Elegance Brand at No Surrender and the "Impact" episodes afterward.
Last year, James was inducted into the TNA Hall of Fame.
Her appearance is just one of the many highlights set for Bound for Glory next week. The event takes place Sunday, Oct. 11, at the Yuengling Center in Tampa, Florida.

There are four championships on the line, including a six-way scramble for the vacant TNA X Division Championship which will feature Fabian Aichner, KC Navarro, Cedric Alexander, Rich Swann, Ryan Nemeth and BDE; a Knockouts Championship match between Xia Brookside and Indi Hartwell; a four-way match for the TNA International Championship among Mustafa Ali, Jason Hotch, John Skyler and Special Agent Zero; and Nic Nemeth defending the TNA World Championship against Leon Slater.

Elsewhere, Ricky Sosa will take on Eddie Edwards, Joseph Sawyer and Samuel Shaw go up against The Hardys in a Falls Count Anywhere match and a Call Your Shot Gauntlet will be held with the winner getting a future championship match.
It will be a great weekend of professional wrestling, that’s for sure.

articles.title: G7 to release up to 100m barrels of emergency oil and diesel reserves
articles.author: Joanna Partridge, Jillian Ambrose and Mark Sweney

paras.en: Leaders of G7 nations are to release up to 100m barrels of their emergency diesel and crude oil stockpiles after coming under pressure from Donald Trump to ease surging fuel prices.

The drawdown of reserves from some of the world’s largest economies will be coordinated by the International Energy Agency (IEA) and will take place within four months, according to France’s president, Emmanuel Macron.
Macron is the current chair of the G7 – which also includes the US, UK, Germany, Italy, Canada and Japan – and he confirmed the move on Friday following a leaders’ video meeting.
Macron said G7 nations wanted to “work in a coordinated manner to help bring down the prices of petroleum products, particularly diesel”.

European countries had come under pressure from the White House in recent days to release emergency supplies or face a US diesel export ban. Trump has said he is considering stopping diesel exports to help lower domestic fuel prices before the US midterm elections in November.
Macron said G7 members and partners would front-load a substantial diesel release within the first 20 days.

He added that G7 leaders had agreed to make production more flexible so refineries can work at their maximum capacity, and that they would not take any measures to “restrict the exchange of energy and petroleum products between partner countries”.

“We have all committed together to releasing these strategic reserves in the proportions I mentioned, with a focus on diesel, and we are all committed to ensuring there are no export bans, and President Trump, in particular, was very clear on this point,” Macron said.
The G7 leaders said they would discuss the “possibility of additional diesel releases as necessary” in the coming days.

A US export ban would have presented a considerable challenge for Europe, which produces about 70% of the diesel it consumes from domestic refineries, but relies on imports to make up the shortfall. Oil analysts had also raised concerns that competition for diesel cargoes on the global market would push prices even higher.

The average price of diesel climbed to a record high of £2 a litre on UK forecourts on Friday, putting more pressure on motorists. The cost of filling up an average family car is now £110, according to the RAC motoring group, nearly £32 more than before the Iran war.
Simon Williams, the head of policy at the RAC, said: “This is a pump price threshold that no one wanted to cross.”
The RAC figures measure the average cost of fuel, but in reality many forecourts have been selling diesel above £2 a litre for some time.

Trump said in a post on his Truth Social platform that he welcomed the release of more reserves: “Europe has just agreed to release a massive amount of their heavily stocked diesel oil. The process will begin immediately.”
However, Macquarie Group’s Walt Chancellor said release of the reserves would not address the underlying problem in the US.
“The core issue the US faces is not a diesel problem. Nor is it a refined product problem. It may not even be a petroleum problem. It is a global energy problem,” he said, according to CNBC.
“So what is the solution then? In short, more oil through the strait of Hormuz and out of the Middle East. Anything short of that is really just shuffling deck chairs,” he added.

The IEA, the world’s energy watchdog, ordered the largest release of government oil reserves in its history in March when it agreed to release 400m barrels of emergency crude, to help calm the oil price shock sparked by the US-Israeli attacks on Iran.
The intervention represented a third of the group’s total government stockpiles and was more than double the release of 182m barrels of oil made in 2022 following Russia’s invasion of Ukraine.
Brent crude oil was trading at just above $100 a barrel on Friday, compared with about $72 before the Iran war started.

articles.title: G7 to release 100m barrels from reserves to combat surging diesel prices – as it happened
articles.author: Jakub Krupa (now) and Taz Ali (earlier)

paras.en: G7 to work in 'coordinated manner' to 'bring down prices of petroleum products,' Macron says
France’s Emmanuel Macron said G7 leaders agreed “to work in a coordinated manner to help bring down the prices of petroleum products, particularly diesel.”
→ make production more flexible to produce at the maximum capacity of our refineries,
→ release our strategic reserves up to 100 million barrels, within 4 months, with our partners, under the coordination of the International Energy Agency,
→ take no measures to restrict the exchange of energy and petroleum products between partner countries.”
And, on that note, we will be closing the blog for today.

Leaders of G7 nations are to release up to 100m barrels of their emergency diesel and crude oil stockpiles after coming under pressure from Donald Trump to ease surging fuel prices (16:27, 16:40, 16:54, 17:31).
For more updates, follow the US live blog here:
Hundreds of schools across France saw disruptions today, as student protests continue and escalate to violent incidents, with hundreds of people arrested today (13:16).
The protests are expected to continue next week (17:47).
Sweden’s Social Democratic leader Magdalena Andersson has been given another change to form the new Swedish government, with seven days to report back on the progress (11:21).

The Spanish government lost two key votes to ratify a package of emergency measures aimed at tackling the nation’s housing affordability crisis – just as protesters marched on the parliament demanding help for renters (15:59).
Kyiv mayor Vitali Klitschko warned that Russian attacks are “tearing Kyiv apart,” amid dramatic escalation in relentless strikes in the city (18:01).
If you have any tips, comments or suggestions, email me at jakub.krupa@theguardian.com.
I am also on Bluesky at @jakubkrupa.bsky.social and on X at @jakubkrupa.
Let’s bring you a quick update from Ukraine, as the capital city of Kyiv continues to be severely affected by relentless Russian strikes.
Kyiv mayor Vitali Klitschko said that Russian attacks were “tearing Kyiv apart,” putting it “in a very dramatic situation.”
“It’s no longer possible to pretend that we can live now as we lived in peacetime. The enemy is tearing Kyiv apart,” he said on Telegram.
“[Russia is] destroying infrastructure, critical infrastructure, logistics networks, housing, and social facilities. The aggressor has once again set out to destroy our energy system.”
During the day, Russia once again hit one of Kyiv’s main bridges, causing significant disruption to city traffic.
Further 'mobilisation' in French students' strike planned for Tuesday
There’s more news coming from France, with a coalition of unions reportedly calling for a mobilisation on Tuesday, including a strike action, as reported by Le Figaro.

After a meeting with the education minister Édouard Geffray, high school and student organisations called for further mobilisation, lamenting the absence of “concrete measures” proposed in the meantime.
This comes after another hectic day of protests and street violence today, with authorities estimating damage as running into tens of millions of euros.
It’s fair to say that the G7 decision is much awaited as several countries continue to face high fuel prices.
For example, British motorists face more pressure at the pumps after the average price of diesel climbed to a record £2 a litre.

The price of a litre at UK forecourts has risen 40.5% since late February, when the US-Israel war on Iran began disrupting supplies of crude and refined oil products from the Gulf, leading to cost increases across the economy.
Some countries are taking domestic decision to lower the price: in Germany, fuel subsidies aimed at softening the impact of the Middle East war energy shock came into force yesterday, AFP reported.
The new restrictions put in place by the government do allow for filling stations to raise prices once a day at 12pm.

“On average, consumers are paying today, at around 12:15 p.m. (local time), between 14 and 15 cents less than yesterday, depending on the type of fuel,” the German automobile association (ADAC) told AFP.
EU's von der Leyen welcomes G7's deal averting US diesel export ban
The European Commission president, Ursula von der Leyen, responded to the G7 announcement, stressing the citizens “need and deserve affordable energy.”
“Our citizens need and deserve affordable energy. As @G7, we will closely coordinate towards to achieve this goal.
We welcome the decision of G7 countries not to impose any export bans on allies and the continued solidarity between partners.
We support an @IEA-coordinated release of fuel stocks. While staying the course on the clean transition, to gain more energy security.”
G7 to release 100m barrels of diesel, coordinate maintenance schedule to stabilise energy supplies
Here is the G7’s statement in full, as released by the Élysée Palace.
Just a quick reminder that G7 includes Britain, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, and Japan.
I have highlighted some bits in bold for key information for you.

“Today, We, the Leaders of the G7, convened a virtual meeting to address the deepening challenges to our energy security. Facing unprecedented volatility in oil markets - with surging prices threatening economic stability and the well-being of our citizens - we have agreed on decisive, coordinated measures to stabilize immediate energy supplies, shield households and businesses from price shocks, and strengthen the long-term resilience of global energy systems.

We will coordinate maintenance schedules across G7 refineries to prevent simultaneous capacity shutdowns and temporarily increase utilization rates where feasible. We also encourage engagement with countries holding significant refining capacities to boost global production of refined products, particularly diesel, in light of ongoing market pressures in this segment.

The G7 requests the IEA to monitor the immediate and full implementation of the March 2026 commitments. In this regard, taking into account commitments that have already been fulfilled, we will implement our commitments with a coordinated release through the IEA of 100 million barrels (MB) to begin immediately over 4 months, including a frontloaded substantial diesel release within the first 20 days by G7 members and partners. We will convene in the context of the IEA in the coming days to discuss the possibility of additional diesel releases as necessary.

We reaffirm our commitment to refrain from export restrictions on energy and energy products between G7 countries and call on all producers to refrain from imposing bans that could exacerbate market tensions.

We invite the IEA to monitor the impact of these measures on energy security and market stability and to monitor implementation of commitments. A follow-up report should be delivered before 20 days, include actionable recommendations to enhance future responses, including stocks replenishment.

We condemn Iran’s continued attacks against its regional neighbours and its disruption of international trade, energy security and the global economy. We call for the immediate and full restoration of navigational rights and principles in the Strait of Hormuz and express our determination to redouble our collective efforts to that end. We commend the United States for its efforts to ensure the free flow of commerce through the strait of Hormuz.
We will maintain sanctions against Russia while working with the IEA and global partners to prevent further spillovers into fuel, gas, and other commodity markets.

Our citizens’ concerns about energy prices remain a top priority. We will monitor developments closely and stand ready to adjust measures as needed. Today’s agreements mark a step toward a more secure, transparent, and resilient energy future.”
G7 to work in 'coordinated manner' to 'bring down prices of petroleum products,' Macron says
France’s Emmanuel Macron said G7 leaders agreed “to work in a coordinated manner to help bring down the prices of petroleum products, particularly diesel.”
→ make production more flexible to produce at the maximum capacity of our refineries,
→ release our strategic reserves up to 100 million barrels, within 4 months, with our partners, under the coordination of the International Energy Agency,
→ take no measures to restrict the exchange of energy and petroleum products between partner countries.”
Europe set to release some of its diesel reserves 'immediately,' Trump says
Meanwhile, we are getting big news coming from the G7 meeting, with US president Donald Trump saying that Europe has agreed to release some of its diesel reserves “immediately” (14:19).
Trump announced the action Friday on social media without offering details on which countries were releasing reserves or at what volumes.
“Europe has just agreed to release a massive amount of their heavily stocked Diesel Oil,” Trump wrote. “The process will begin immediately.”
Spanish parliament rejects the government's proposed emergency housing measures

Let me bring you an update from Spain where the government lost two key votes to ratify a package of emergency measures aimed at tackling the nation’s housing affordability crisis – just as protesters marched on the parliament demanding help for renters (12:31).

AP reported that the Catalan separatist party Junts carried out its announcement made hours before that it would vote against both decrees. That doomed the measures when combined with the “No” from the center-right Popular Party and far-right Vox.
Something a little different – a new social media trend has seen tourists in Prague queue near the famed Charles Bridge to recreate a 1988 photo of the iconic British band Depeche Mode.
The black and white image shows Dave Gahan (facing the camera) and Martin Gore (looking towards the bridge) standing next to the Pietà sculpture.
AP has more on how the photo has captured the imaginations of international visitors to Czechia:
Fans have been making the pilgrimage for years, but photographs of a mass gathering on the bridge between the band’s Prague concerts in 2024 appear to have helped fuel a modern-day boom.
Currently, the photo recreated by the visiting fans is trending with millions of views on social media.
Jorge Sanchez, from California, and his wife were among the recent visitors.
“Well, I remember seeing the picture from way back, and then I kind of remember, and I looked it up, and I learned that it was here, so I wanted to make sure I took a picture,” Sanchez said.
“I think it fit at the time, you know, with their music, you know, and their message and their music with your personal Jesus and all of that, so it’s kind of fitting.”

As dozens of school pupils sat on top of a pile of wheelie bins blocking a high school entrance in north-eastern Paris, Sophia, 17, was on the frontline of the barricade, when she would normally have been attending Spanish class.

“We hope this grows into a massive youth protest movement,” said the final year baccalaureate student at Paris’s Lycée Voltaire, who did not want her real name published. She was on her second day of blocking the school entrance along with hundreds of others, ensuring all lessons were cancelled. “We just want to be listened to by the government. We’d rather stand here doing this than have to learn in poor conditions. It’s the only way to make ourselves heard.”

“School is a right, not a privilege,” read a cardboard sign as Sophia listed the grievances of teenagers across France: a lack of state investment in education, overcrowded classes of up to 40 children in crumbling buildings, poor teacher pay, staff absences and an unequal system in which social background determined success. Other reasons for the protest included the opaque and difficult online system for university applications as well as the unbearable temperatures in classrooms during the heatwaves in May and June.

“The education budget is being cut to shreds while so much extra funding is being put into the army,” said Sophia, who wanted to go on to study art and work in animation. She said she hoped the demonstrations and blockades would continue into next week. Several teachers stood by the barricades in support.
17-year-old arrested after police officer violently attacked in student protest, prosecutor says

A police officer deployed to the school protests in Belfort, north-east France was brutally attacked after another off-duty cop arrested a young man, Belfort prosecutor Paul-Edouard Lallois told the AFP news agency.

The officer was “attacked by a mob of young people” near the Courbet secondary school in Belfort at 9.15am local time. The group “knocked him to the ground and beat him with their fists and feet, particularly around the head”, said Lallois, who announced he will open an investigation for attempted murder of a public official. He is scheduled to hold a press conference this afternoon.

Police backup “quickly intervened to disperse the group of attackers” and provide assistance to the officer, Lallois added. He suffered “a brief loss of consciousness” and sustained “several wounds” to his face.

A 17-year-old student at the school was arrested shortly afterward. He has not been formally identified as having struck the officer, Lallois said, adding that investigations are ongoing to establish his involvement.
Commenting on the attack, the French interior minister, Laurent Nuñez,said: “These images, which are exceptionally violent, are unbearable.

“The police officer, who was deliberately targeted, was taken to hospital after losing consciousness. Fortunately, his condition is no longer a cause for serious concern at this time. My thoughts are with him.”
More violent clashes with police across France as school protests continue
We are getting more pictures of violent clashes in France as the high school protests continue across the country.

After a plainclothes officer was violently attacked in Belfort, the interior minister Laurent Nuñez condemned “unbearable” video footage of the incidentand said the investigation will focus on “attempted murder.”
“Everything will be done to identify the perpetrators of this despicable act. Total support for the police officers and gendarmes who are intervening in difficult conditions,” he said.
Macron to host G7 talks as EU mulls response to US pressure on diesel stocks
French president Emmanuel Macron is scheduled to chair a videoconference with G7 leadersin the next half hour focused on the global energy situation, the Élysée Palace said.
Macron has already spoken with US president Donald Trump and Canadian prime minister Mark Carney overnight to discuss the latest surge in fuel prices.
Separately, EU ambassadors will also convene on Friday afternoon to discuss the global energy situation, the Irish Presidency of the EU said.

“The diesel market is currently very tight, leading to high prices for consumers across the world. The Presidency is committed to maintaining close collaboration and coordination with all member states and the Commission,” a spokesperson for the Presidency said.

Earlier, EU representatives discussed a French proposal to release diesel stocks in response to US pressure to help cool surging fuel prices linked to the Iran war, three sources familiar with details of the discussion told Reuters.

The proposal, discussed on a call involving EU governments, calls for European countries to release 50 million barrels of diesel and International Energy Agency members to release 50 million barrels of crude oil, the sources said.
France's justice minister brands far-right Bardella's anti-semitism explanations as 'shameless lies'

In other news in France, the country’s justice minister has accused Jordan Bardella of “shameless lies” after Marine Le Pen’s de facto deputy dismissed new evidence from an investigative website that he posted antisemitic messages on social media as “crude fabrications, obscure and easily manipulated screenshots … vile statements I obviously never made”.

The Mediapart website on Monday published the messages, dating back to 2013, in which Bardella – then a 17-year-old activist in Le Pen’s far-right National Rally (RN) – allegedly wrote comments including “the Jew has to dominate other peoples, crush them, and rob them; a Zionist is necessarily a Jew, and fundamentally so” and “all the banks are owned by Jews”.

Mediapart said on Thursday it had authenticated the messages, mainly on Messenger, Facebook’s instant messaging service, and published screenshots. It said they were provided by two sources close to Bardella, had been authenticated with Meta, Facebook’s parent company, and the data extraction had been certified by a bailiff.

“Extracting the conversation allows us to date it, to confirm that this conversation has not been subsequently modified, and to confirm that the person involved in the conversation is listed by Meta/Facebook under the name Jordan Bardella.”

It added that an analysis of the content also “possible to verify that it is indeed the real Jordan Bardella”: biographical details in the conversation included mention of a mother born in Italy, a 2013 interview Bardella gave to Le Parisien newspaper, and his failure to pass the entrance examination for the prestigious Sciences Po university.
Bardella, who created a new Facebook profile dedicated to his burgeoning political career late in 2013, said on Tuesday he had filed a formal legal complaint for defamation.
On Thursday he repeated his denial and added he would now also file complaints for “forgery and use of forgeries”.
The evidence was “therefore not evidence at all, and will not hold up for a second in court”, he said on social media.
“The so-called ‘investigation’ is already collapsing. The French people will be the judge of this blatant fabrication.”
The allegations against Bardella come just seven months before next year’s presidential elections, with Le Pen leading in the opinion polls.

Bardella is widely expected to become prime minister if she wins and the affair threatens to damage her decades-long “detoxification” of the RN, long associated with the antisemitic views of some of its members including its founder, Le Pen’s father Jean-Marie.
The French justice minister, Gérald Darmanin, told French radio on Friday there was “little doubt” Bardella had made the comments.

“Do we want a prime minister who is not only antisemitic, but also lies to the French people in the face of overwhelming evidence? … His strategy raises serious doubts about his ability to hold political office,” he said.
The French Socialist party’s leader, Olivier Faure, said Bardella was “lying. So we have a two-pronged issue here: his antisemitism and lying in politics. Neither is forgivable.”
Faure added: “He could have had another defence – he could have said: ‘I was young, I’ve changed since then.’ That’s not what he’s saying.”

articles.title: Spanish right wing votes down housing crisis plans as protest movement grows
articles.author: Ashifa Kassam in Madrid

paras.en: Rightwing lawmakers in Spain have joined forces to reject emergency measures put forward to tackle the country’s housing crisis, pitting a fractured parliament against the widespread protest movement that has swelled in recent days.

As protesters outside the parliament building in Madrid held up homemade signs bearing images of vultures, the conservative People’s party, the far-right Vox and the Catalan pro-independence party Junts voted against a package of decrees by Pedro Sánchez’s Socialist-led coalition that included a ban on evictions until 2030 and the regulation of temporary lettings and lettings by room.

The People’s party said it had voted in line with its belief that building, rather than regulating, was the best way to address the crisis. “Housing doesn’t become more affordable through decrees; it becomes more affordable by building more homes,” said the lawmaker Juan Bravo.
News of the package’s rejection was met with boos outside. “Your profits, our misery,” the protesters chanted.

The long-simmering anger at soaring housing costs boiled over late last month, when 87-year-old Maricarmen Abascal, who uses a wheelchair, was evicted from the home she had lived in for 70 years. The octogenarian said she was unable to afford the 230% rent hike demanded by the investment fund that bought her apartment.

On Friday, as a poll suggested that two-thirds of people in Spain supported the idea of government intervention in the housing market to limit prices, sources told the news site Eldiario.es that the Socialists were mulling whether to bring forward next year’s elections, potentially to this November.

Late on Thursday, as news broke that several rightwing parties were planning to vote against the proposed measures, Sánchez said the parliamentary vote would go ahead as planned. “You’re with the social majority or with speculators,” the Spanish prime minister said on social media, adding that the vote would reveal the “true colours” of the rightwing parties.

For many, Abascal’s eviction was a tipping point for feelings about Spain’s housing market, where rents have surged 80% within a decade and the cost of homes climbed by 63%, resulting in significant hardship for many.
Earlier this year, the Youth Council of Spain said the average rent in Spain had climbed to €1,176 ($1,323) a month – an amount equivalent to 98.7% of the average salary for under-30s.

The protests that began with Abascal’s eviction have continued even after the investment firm that bought her apartment said it had struck a deal that would allow her to return to her home, with her rent returning to a level closer to that she had paid in the past.

The government decrees presented in parliament on Friday were intended to quell some of this public uproar. As they were rejected, campaigners vowed to continue their push to improve access to housing.

“They’re not going to stop us,” the Confederation of Tenants’ Unions said in a statement, as it called on people across the country to take to the streets this weekend. “In the face of a parliament that is out of touch, the answer is more organisation and mobilisation. The next step: a general strike.”

Saturday will mark one week since a small group of protesters, intent on making their demands heard, set up 10 tents in Madrid’s central Puerta del Sol plaza, a short walk from parliament. Since then, the encampment had swelled to more than 1,500 tents – a peaceful settlement in the heart of the capital with its own street names, a medical centre and even a co-working space.
Such demonstrations have dominated the national conversation, breathing new life into Sánchez’s beleaguered government and shifting attention away from the lingering impact of recent events in Ceuta.
As news of the vote reached the camp on Friday, one protester, Marta García, said: “People here are disappointed. We had thought that at least one of the decrees would be approved.”

articles.title: What happened in the failed execution of Christa Pike - and what next?

paras.en: US convicted murderer Christa Pike is in a critical condition in hospital after Tennessee authorities failed to execute her by lethal injection, her lawyer says.
paras.zh: 美国被定罪的杀人犯克里斯塔·派克（ Christa Pike ）的律师说，田纳西州当局未能通过注射死刑处决她，她目前在医院处于危急状态。

paras.en: The case of Pike, whose attempted execution on Wednesday had already been the subject of a high-profile legal battle, raised a number of questions, including what went wrong? And what happens next?
paras.zh: 派克周三试图执行死刑已经成为一场备受瞩目的法律斗争的主题，派克的案件引发了许多问题，包括出了什么问题？接下来会发生什么？

paras.en: A third-party review has been ordered by state Governor Bill Lee, who has halted executions in Tennessee for the rest of the year.
paras.zh: 州长比尔·李（ Bill Lee ）已下令进行第三方审查，他在今年剩余时间内暂停了在田纳西州的处决。

paras.en: Pike was scheduled to be put to death in Tennessee on Wednesday evening local time. The injections were allowed by the Supreme Court at the 11th hour.
paras.zh: 派克原定于当地时间周三晚上在田纳西州被处死。最高法院在第11小时允许注射。

paras.en: Pike was given two injections of the drug pentobarbital, but her legal team said these failed to stop her heartbeat and that she could still be heard snoring.
paras.zh: 派克注射了两针戊巴比妥，但她的法律团队表示，这些药物未能阻止她的心跳，她仍然可以听到打鼾声。

paras.en: Her legal team noted difficulty administering the injections, counting "at least seven needles used in her left arm alone, one of which appeared to be bent" upon removal.
paras.zh: 她的法律团队注意到在进行注射时遇到困难，计算出“仅在她的左臂上就使用了至少七根针，其中一根在移除时似乎弯曲了”。

paras.en: Her lawyers had warned something like this might occur.
paras.zh: 她的律师曾警告过这样的事情可能会发生。

paras.en: In January, Pike's legal team filed a lawsuit, external challenging the state's lethal injection protocol. In it, they said Pike suffered from a blood-clotting condition known as thrombocytosis and said she had "small veins that make insertion of a needle more difficult".
paras.zh: 今年1月，派克的法律团队提起诉讼，外部对该州的致命注射方案提出质疑。他们在信中说，派克患有一种称为血小板增多症的凝血病症，并说她的“小静脉使插入针头变得更加困难”。

paras.en: After the botched execution, Pike's attorney Stephen Ferrell said setting an IV line was more difficult than a simple blood draw, adding: "We knew this was coming."
paras.zh: 在拙劣的处决之后，派克的律师斯蒂芬·费雷尔（ Stephen Ferrell ）表示，设置静脉注射线比简单的抽血更困难，并补充说： “我们知道这即将到来。”

paras.en: Pike's other attorney, Randy Spivey, said he noticed during the execution that "her right arm was turning purple" and that there was "burning around the sites of the injection" afterwards.
paras.zh: 派克的另一位律师兰迪·斯皮维（ Randy Spivey ）说，他在处决过程中注意到“她的右臂变成了紫色” ，之后“注射部位周围燃烧”。

paras.en: Pike's lawyers also raised the issue of degraded pentobarbital, the lethal drug injected into her arm, suggesting that it may have lost its potency.
paras.zh: 派克的律师还提出了注射到她手臂上的致命药物戊巴比妥降解的问题，这表明它可能已经失去了效力。

paras.en: The Tennessee Department of Correction has defended the method it used, saying "the protocol does not allow for additional procedures beyond what was carried out".
paras.zh: 田纳西州矫正部门为其使用的方法进行了辩护，称“该方案不允许超出已执行范围的额外程序”。

paras.en: The state protocol does not clearly specify what should happen if an inmate remains alive after a second dose, according to the AP news agency.
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，国家方案没有明确规定如果囚犯在第二次接种后仍然活着会发生什么。

paras.en: Authorities are yet to say whether they will try again to execute Pike. They have not explained why the dosage given to Pike proved to be non-fatal.
paras.zh: 当局尚未说明他们是否会再次尝试处决派克。他们没有解释为什么给派克的剂量被证明是非致命的。

paras.en: Opponents of the death penalty said it was difficult to know what went wrong, because part of Pike's execution happened behind a curtain.
paras.zh: 反对死刑的人说，很难知道出了什么问题，因为派克的部分处决发生在幕后。

paras.en: Maya Foa, the head of international legal organisation Reprieve, said: "Lethal injection relies on secrecy at every stage, to hide the violence of the state taking a human life."
paras.zh: 国际法律组织Reprieve负责人Maya Foa表示： “致命注射在每个阶段都依赖于保密，以掩盖夺走人类生命的国家的暴力。”

paras.en: Pike survived two doses of the lethal drug pentobarbital. Dr Joel Zivot, an anaesthesiologist advising Pike's defence team, said this was enough that, had it entered her bloodstream in normal circulation, "she would have surely died".
paras.zh: 派克在两剂致命药物戊巴比妥中幸存下来。为派克的辩护团队提供建议的麻醉师Joel Zivot博士说，这已经足够了，如果它在正常循环中进入她的血液， “她肯定会死”。

paras.en: Zivot said the only possible explanation for her survival "is that the pentobarbital blood level was never high enough to cause death" and that blisters on her arm after the botched execution indicated a ruptured vein.
paras.zh: Zivot说，她生存的唯一可能解释“是戊巴比妥血液水平从未高到足以导致死亡” ，并且在拙劣的处决后，她手臂上的水泡表明静脉破裂。

paras.en: So, instead of entering Pike's bloodstream, he said, the pentobarbital was more likely to have spread across the tissue under her skin.
paras.zh: 因此，他说，戊巴比妥不是进入派克的血液，而是更有可能扩散到她皮肤下的组织中。

paras.en: Pike's medical condition of thrombocytosis may have also played a role, forming blood clots at the injection site that would potentially block pentobarbital from entering her veins.
paras.zh: 派克的血小板增多症的医疗状况可能也起到了一定的作用，在注射部位形成血栓，这可能会阻止戊巴比妥进入她的静脉。

paras.en: Her lawyers suggested that the pentobarbital used could have been degraded and that this could also have been a factor. Zivot explained that if this was the case, it could be due to factors including poor manufacturing or improper storage.
paras.zh: 她的律师表示，使用的戊巴比妥可能已经降解，这也可能是一个因素。Zivot解释说，如果是这种情况，可能是由于制造不当或存储不当等因素造成的。

paras.en: The Tennessee correction department said Pike had been taken to an off-site medical facility, while one of her lawyers said on Wednesday that she was being given "life-saving measures" in hospital.
paras.zh: 田纳西州矫正部门表示，派克已被送往非现场医疗机构，而她的一名律师周三表示，她正在医院接受“挽救生命的措施”。

paras.en: On Thursday, lawyer Randy Spivey told reporters: "We don't have a sense of her prognosis or much update on her health at the moment."
paras.zh: 周四，律师兰迪·斯皮维（ Randy Spivey ）告诉记者： “我们目前对她的预测或健康状况没有太多了解。”

paras.en: Dr Joel Zivot said: "It's very possible that as a consequence of the delay of the beginning of resuscitation she [Pike] will have a brain injury."
paras.zh: Joel Zivot博士说： “由于复苏开始的延迟，她（ Pike ）很可能会有脑损伤。”

paras.en: Pike's lawyers are now asking for her sentence to be commuted, but it is not clear what might happens next.
paras.zh: 派克的律师现在要求减刑，但目前尚不清楚接下来会发生什么。

paras.en: Historically, the US Supreme Court has not halted second attempts at executions, said John Mills, a lawyer who works with inmates sentenced to death.
paras.zh: 与被判死刑的囚犯一起工作的律师约翰·米尔斯（ John Mills ）说，从历史上看，美国最高法院并没有停止第二次执行死刑的尝试。

paras.en: In 2024, it allowed Alabama to proceed with a second execution of Kenneth Eugene Smith, using an experimental oxygen deprivation method, after their attempt to kill him by lethal injection failed two years earlier.
paras.zh: 2024年，阿拉巴马州在两年前试图通过注射致命药物杀死肯尼思·尤金·史密斯（ Kenneth Eugene Smith ）的尝试失败后，允许他使用实验性缺氧方法进行第二次处决。

paras.en: Pentobarbital is a potent sedative that slows down the body, including the nervous system. Doctors sometimes use it as a treatment for certain conditions, but in high doses it can also be used as a lethal injection to cause death.
paras.zh: 戊巴比妥是一种强效的镇静剂，可以减缓身体，包括神经系统。医生有时将其用作某些疾病的治疗方法，但高剂量也可用作致死注射剂。

paras.en: Its use in lethal injections came under renewed scrutiny last year after a US federal government review during the Biden administration raised concerns about the drug's potential for "unnecessary pain and suffering".
paras.zh: 去年，在拜登政府期间，美国联邦政府进行了一次审查，对该药物可能带来“不必要的疼痛和痛苦”提出了担忧，此后，该药物在致命注射中的使用受到了新的审查。

paras.en: The Biden government banned its use in federal executions, but that did not bind individual states such as Tennessee, which can choose their own methods.
paras.zh: 拜登政府禁止在联邦处决中使用它，但这对田纳西州等个别州没有约束力，田纳西州可以选择自己的方法。

paras.en: In recent years, states have found some drugs needed for lethal injections harder to come by, because pharmaceutical companies have opposed the use of their products for such purposes.
paras.zh: 近年来，各州发现致命注射所需的一些药物更难获得，因为制药公司反对将其产品用于此类目的。

paras.en: The Tennessee correction department has not specifically addressed an allegation from Pike's legal team that the pentobarbital it used was "degraded".
paras.zh: 田纳西州矫正部门没有具体处理派克法律团队关于其使用的戊巴比妥“降解”的指控。

paras.en: But the department said in a statement the lethal injection chemical had "consistently been effective".
paras.zh: 但该部门在一份声明中表示，致命的注射化学品“一直有效”。

paras.en: The attempted execution of Pike was not the first in Tennessee in 2026 that did not go to plan.
paras.zh: 2026年，在田纳西州，派克被处决的企图并不是第一次没有按计划进行。

paras.en: The execution of Tony Carruthers, who was convicted of kidnapping and murdering three people in 1994, was postponed in May after staff were unable to find a vein for a lethal injection. He was granted a year's reprieve by the governor.
paras.zh: 1994年因绑架和谋杀三人而被定罪的托尼·卡拉瑟斯（ Tony Carruthers ）在工作人员无法找到致命注射的静脉后，于5月被推迟处决。州长给了他一年的缓刑。

paras.en: In 2022, more than a third of executions across the US were botched or highly problematic, according to the Death Penalty Information Center.
paras.zh: 根据死刑信息中心（ Death Penalty Information Center ）的数据， 2022年，美国有超过三分之一的死刑执行失败或存在严重问题。

paras.en: Pike, now 50, was sentenced to death in 1996 for the murder a year earlier of 19-year-old Colleen Slemmer, which was perpetrated along with her then-boyfriend, Tadaryl Shipp.
paras.zh: 现年50岁的派克于1996年因谋杀19岁的科琳·斯莱默（ Colleen Slemmer ）而被判处死刑，该谋杀案是与她当时的男朋友塔达里尔·希普（ Tadaryl Shipp ）一起犯下的。

paras.en: Pike killed Slemmer at a camp for troubled teens, after accusing Slemmer of insulting her and attempting to steal Shipp from her.
paras.zh: 派克在一个陷入困境的青少年营地杀死了Slemmer ，此前他指责Slemmer侮辱她并试图从她那里偷走Shipp。

paras.en: Two other residents at the camp later testified that Pike had bragged about the murder and showed them a piece of Slemmer's skull.
paras.zh: 营地的另外两名居民后来作证说，派克吹嘘这起谋杀案，并向他们展示了一块斯莱默的头骨。

paras.en: Shipp was given a life sentence with the possibility of parole and he remains in prison. He was spared the death penalty for his part in the attack because he was not yet legally an adult at the time.
paras.zh: Shipp被判无期徒刑，并有可能获得假释，他仍在监狱中。他因参与袭击而免于死刑，因为他当时在法律上还不是成年人。

paras.en: Correction 1 October: This article originally referred to the inmate executed by the state of Louisiana in 1947 as Willie Smith. We have amended the article to make clear that his name was Willie Francis.
paras.zh: 更正10月1日：这篇文章最初提到1947年被路易斯安那州处决的囚犯是威利·史密斯。我们修改了这篇文章，以明确他的名字是威利·弗朗西斯。

articles.title: Riot police clash with students as education protests rage in France

paras.en: Riot police have clashed with protesters as thousands of students demonstrating over education standards disrupted more than 700 schools in France on Friday.
paras.zh: 防暴警察与抗议者发生冲突，数千名抗议教育水平的学生周五在法国扰乱了700多所学校。

paras.en: Fires have burned in the streets as high school pupils and others objected to a lack of teachers, overcrowded classrooms and run-down buildings.
paras.zh: 由于高中生和其他人反对缺乏教师、教室过度拥挤和破旧的建筑物，街道上发生了火灾。

paras.en: The protests began last week in the capital Paris and have spread across the country, with cities including Montpellier, Nantes and Marseille affected.
paras.zh: 抗议活动于上周在首都巴黎开始，并蔓延到全国各地，蒙彼利埃、南特和马赛等城市受到影响。

paras.en: French justice minister Gerald Darmanin said things had "gone from high-school student demonstrations to a public order disturbance".
paras.zh: 法国司法部长杰拉尔德·达尔马宁（ Gerald Darmanin ）表示，事情已经“从高中学生示威游行到扰乱公共秩序”。

paras.en: On Friday, a 17-year-old was arrested on suspicion of attempted homicide after protests in Belfort, north-eastern France, where a police officer was targeted.
paras.zh: 周五，在法国东北部贝尔福发生抗议活动后，一名17岁的男子因涉嫌谋杀未遂而被捕，当时一名警察成为袭击目标。

paras.en: BBC Verify has now authenticated two videos that show the man, who was later identified as an officer by a minister, being beaten up near a school in Belfort.
paras.zh: BBC Verify现在已经认证了两个视频，显示这名男子在贝尔福的一所学校附近被殴打，后来被一名部长认定为军官。

paras.en: In the graphic footage, a group of young men are seen chasing him. The officer falls to the ground, and is subsequently punched and kicked multiple times in the head.
paras.zh: 在画面中，看到一群年轻人追逐他。警官摔倒在地，随后被拳打脚踢多次头部。

paras.en: At least 65 staff members have been injured in the unrest, the education ministry said.
paras.zh: 教育部表示，至少有65名工作人员在骚乱中受伤。

paras.en: In the Paris suburb of Pantin police charged at protesters and made arrests after projectiles where thrown at officers.
paras.zh: 在巴黎郊区潘坦（ Pantin ） ，警察向抗议者提出指控，并在向警察投掷炮弹后将其逮捕。

paras.en: Meanwhile, in Strasbourg tear gas was deployed as police feared conditions would become more hostile, according to the Reuters news agency.
paras.zh: 与此同时，据路透社报道，在斯特拉斯堡部署了催泪瓦斯，因为警方担心情况会变得更加恶劣。

paras.en: Rubbish bins have also been set on fire in Rennes and Paris.
paras.zh: 雷恩和巴黎的垃圾桶也被放火焚烧。

paras.en: "As far as we're concerned, we've won - our school is closed this morning," Lola, a 16-year-old protester, told the AFP news agency on Friday.
paras.zh: “就我们而言，我们赢了-我们的学校今天早上关闭，” 16岁的抗议者Lola周五告诉法新社。

paras.en: She said police actions had made things worse.
paras.zh: 她说，警方的行动使情况变得更糟。

paras.en: "It makes us even angrier - the police have no right to hit us or use tear gas on us," she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说： “这让我们更加愤怒-警方无权打我们或对我们使用催泪瓦斯。”

paras.en: Police published pictures of some of the items they had seized from demonstrators, including petrol bombs, an axe and so-called mortar fireworks.
paras.zh: 警方公布了他们从示威者手中夺取的一些物品的照片，包括汽油弹、斧头和所谓的迫击炮烟花。

paras.en: "Significant damage" had been done to school facilities, the education ministry said, after attacks on school gates, entrances and fences.
paras.zh: 教育部表示，在学校大门、入口和围栏遭到袭击后，学校设施遭到“严重破坏”。

paras.en: Nelson Mandela high school in Nantes suffered more than â¬2m (Â£1.7m) damage, according to the regional government, after fire destroyed its glass entrance and some areas inside the school.
paras.zh: 据当地政府称，南特的纳尔逊·曼德拉高中在火灾摧毁了其玻璃入口和学校内部的一些区域后，遭受了超过200万欧元（ 170万英镑）的损失。

paras.en: The blockades and protests started last week before spreading to hundreds of schools across the country.
paras.zh: 封锁和抗议活动始于上周，随后蔓延到全国数百所学校。

paras.en: Students say school hours are too long, classrooms too hot and too many members of staff are off work.
paras.zh: 学生们说上课时间太长，教室太热，太多工作人员不上班。

paras.en: It comes at a crucial time for French President Emmanuel Macron, six months before next year's presidential election.
paras.zh: 这是法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙（ Emmanuel Macron ）的关键时刻，距离明年的总统选举还有六个月。

paras.en: Budget cuts planned, which will impact on education funding, have infuriated the young protesters.
paras.zh: 计划削减的预算将影响教育经费，这激怒了年轻的抗议者。

paras.en: French Education Minister Ãdouard Geffray said on Friday that the movement had been hijacked by non-students.
paras.zh: 法国教育部长Ãdouard Geffray周五表示，该运动已被非学生劫持。

paras.en: He told French broadcaster BFMTV that teachers had said "the people in front of me were not my students".
paras.zh: 他告诉法国广播公司BFMTV ，老师们曾说过“我面前的人不是我的学生”。

paras.en: Parents have also been worried that their children have become caught up in a wave of violence and unrest.
paras.zh: 父母也担心他们的孩子陷入了暴力和动荡的浪潮。

paras.en: At the Claude Monet school in southern Paris, 53-year-old Anya was looking for her son.
paras.zh: 在巴黎南部的克劳德莫奈学校， 53岁的Anya正在寻找她的儿子。

paras.en: "We banned him from coming. I hope he isn't here, but he did leave the house," she told AFP. "We're afraid the situation might escalate."
paras.zh: “我们禁止他来。我希望他不在这里，但他确实离开了房子，”她告诉法新社。“我们担心情况可能会升级。”

paras.en: Darmanin, the justice minister, said prosecutors had been asked to hold parents liable for damage caused by their children and "pay for repairs".
paras.zh: 司法部长Darmanin表示，检察官已被要求追究父母对其子女造成的损害的责任，并“支付维修费用”。

paras.en: He said since the start of the movement, about 2,000 people - most of whom were children - had been taken into custody.
paras.zh: 他说，自运动开始以来，约有2000人被拘留，其中大多数是儿童。

paras.en: Many French unions have given their support to the protesting students.
paras.zh: 许多法国工会对抗议的学生给予了支持。

paras.en: Education union SNEP-FSU, public services union SNUEP-FSU and Solidaires have all called for members to support them.
paras.zh: 教育工会SNEP-FSU、公共服务工会SNUEP-FSU和Solidaires都呼吁成员支持他们。

paras.en: Solidaires Trade Union Federation said in a statement: "Let's not let them fire on our children.
paras.zh: 团结工会联合会在一份声明中说： “让我们不要让他们向我们的孩子开火。

paras.en: "Secondary school pupils have the freedom of assembly, association and demonstration."
paras.zh: “中学生有集会、结社和示威的自由。”

articles.title: Woman at centre of Cornell rape inquiry was 'failed' by officials, says New York governor

paras.en: New York Governor Kathy Hochul has said the woman at the centre of the Cornell University rape case was "failed" at "every turn".
paras.zh: 纽约州州长凯西·霍丘尔（ Kathy Hochul ）表示，康奈尔大学强奸案中心的女性在“每一个转折点”都“失败”了。

paras.en: The woman, known as Jane Doe in legal documents, alleges she was drugged and raped by several men at a fraternity house in 2024.
paras.zh: 这名女子在法律文件中被称为Jane Doe ，她声称她于2024年在一家兄弟会中被几名男子下药并被强奸。

paras.en: The case was investigated at the time but no charges were laid. It recently reopened after the woman filed a civil lawsuit last month that thrust the allegations into the national spotlight.
paras.zh: 当时对此案进行了调查，但没有提出任何指控。该女子上个月提起民事诉讼，使指控成为全国关注的焦点，最近重新开放。

paras.en: At a news conference on Friday, Hochul said she was "deeply disturbed" by how the investigation was handled. She has now appointed New York Attorney General Letitia James to lead the case.
paras.zh: 在周五的新闻发布会上， Hochul表示，她对调查的处理方式“深感不安”。她现在已任命纽约总检察长利蒂西亚·詹姆斯（ Letitia James ）领导此案。

paras.en: This appointment was made after Hochul said she "lost faith" in the local prosecutor's ability to oversee the investigation.
paras.zh: 这一任命是在Hochul表示她对当地检察官监督调查的能力“失去信心”之后做出的。

paras.en: Expressing outrage that local prosecutors did not interview the accuser themselves, Hochul on Friday said: "This young woman had already endured something that is utterly unspeakable, and then at every turn she was failed by people and institutions with an obligation to protect her."
paras.zh: Hochul周五对当地检察官没有亲自采访原告表示愤慨，他说： “这位年轻女子已经忍受了一些完全无法形容的事情，然后在每一个转折点上，她都被有义务保护她的人和机构所失败。”

paras.en: She has also vowed to close a "loophole" that prevents prosecutors from pursuing rape charges in cases when the victim has voluntarily consumed drugs or alcohol. Jane Doe is believed to have voluntarily taken drugs and alcohol on the night of the alleged gang rape.
paras.zh: 她还发誓要堵塞一个“漏洞” ，阻止检察官在受害者自愿吸毒或酗酒的情况下追究强奸指控。据信， Jane Doe在涉嫌轮奸的当晚自愿吸毒和酗酒。

paras.en: "If someone is too intoxicated to consent it should not matter if they chose to use drugs or alcohol," said Hochul, adding: "Voluntary intoxication is not a licence for gang rape."
paras.zh: Hochul说： “如果有人喝得太醉而不同意，那么他们是否选择使用毒品或酒精应该无关紧要，”并补充说： “自愿中毒不是轮奸的许可证。”

paras.en: James, who is the state's chief legal officer, appeared alongside Hochul at Friday's news conference, pledging to "lead a process guided by the facts and the law".
paras.zh: 该州首席法律官詹姆斯与霍丘尔一起出席了周五的新闻发布会，承诺“领导一个以事实和法律为指导的过程”。

paras.en: She said her office would interview witnesses and pursue prosecutions if warranted.
paras.zh: 她说，如果有必要，她的办公室将采访证人并提起诉讼。

paras.en: District Attorney Matthew Van Houten, who previously led the investigation, has defended his office's previous decision not to file charges in the case, arguing they were not given enough evidence to meet the legal threshold.
paras.zh: 此前领导调查的地区检察官Matthew Van Houten为其办公室此前不提起诉讼的决定进行了辩护，辩称他们没有得到足够的证据来满足法律门槛。

paras.en: Van Houten said much of the information released in recent weeks about the case was not passed to his office.
paras.zh: Van Houten说，最近几周发布的有关此案的大部分信息都没有传递给他的办公室。

paras.en: In a statement on Friday, he said he supported James' investigation, adding: "It has become clear that we were not provided the full picture by the university."
paras.zh: 在周五的一份声明中，他说他支持詹姆斯的调查，并补充说： “很明显，大学没有向我们提供全面情况。”

paras.en: Cornell has said it provided evidence to the district attorney's office from its own investigation, including a Snapchat group chat in which fraternity members discussed a "free" sexual encounter with Doe on the night of the alleged assault.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学表示，它从自己的调查中向地区检察官办公室提供了证据，包括Snapchat群聊，其中兄弟会成员讨论了涉嫌袭击当晚与美国能源部的“免费”性接触。

paras.en: Jane Doe filed a civil lawsuit against the Ivy League university in September.
paras.zh: 9月， Jane Doe对常春藤大学提起民事诉讼。

paras.en: Speaking to CNN on Friday, her lawyer Thomas Giuffra said she is "not doing well".
paras.zh: 她的律师托马斯·朱芙拉（ Thomas Giuffra ）周五在接受美国有线电视新闻网（ CNN ）采访时表示，她“

paras.en: "She's under siege on social media, where people are trying to identify her; some false court postings, attempting to identify her," he said.
paras.zh: “她在社交媒体上受到围攻，人们试图识别她的身份；一些虚假的法庭帖子，试图识别她的身份，”他说。

paras.en: Survivor and victim advocates say current state law on sexual assault makes it difficult for charges to be brought against perpetrators if the victim voluntarily took drugs or drank alcohol before the alleged assault took place.
paras.zh: 幸存者和受害者权益倡导者表示，目前关于性侵犯的州法律规定，如果受害者在涉嫌袭击发生前自愿吸毒或饮酒，则很难对肇事者提起诉讼。

paras.en: A bill to address what Hochul described as a legal loophole was already before the state legislature prior to this week's public outcry over how police and investigators handled the Cornell rape allegations.
paras.zh: 在本周公众对警方和调查人员如何处理康奈尔强奸指控表示强烈抗议之前，一项解决Hochul所描述的法律漏洞的法案已经提交给州立法机构。

paras.en: People who have voluntarily become intoxicated to the point that they are unable to give consent are currently not protected by New York's rape laws, says state assemblyman Jeffrey Dinowitz, who first sponsored legislation to close the loophole in 2019.
paras.zh: 纽约州议员杰弗里·迪诺维茨（ Jeffrey Dinowitz ）表示，自愿醉酒以至于无法表示同意的人目前不受纽约强奸法的保护，他于2019年首次提出了弥补这一漏洞的立法。

paras.en: "The real bottom line is that right now if you are voluntarily intoxicated, you will not get justice," he tells BBC News.
paras.zh: “真正的底线是，现在如果你自愿喝醉了，你就不会得到正义，”他告诉英国广播公司新闻。

paras.en: "Being voluntarily intoxicated, basically, is almost like giving somebody a get out of jail free card."
paras.zh: “自愿喝醉，基本上就像给别人一张出狱的免费卡。”

paras.en: Dinowitz says that around half of US states have already changed their laws to say it makes no difference whether intoxication is voluntarily or involuntarily in rape cases.
paras.zh: Dinowitz说，美国大约一半的州已经修改了法律，表示在强奸案件中中毒是自愿还是非自愿没有区别。

paras.en: Hochul said she will support the existing bill and that it could move forward as early as the next legislative session which reconvenes in January. As governor, she could also call lawmakers back for a special session before then.
paras.zh: Hochul表示，她将支持现有法案，并可能最早在1月份重新召开的下一届立法会议之前推进。作为州长，她还可以在此之前召回立法者参加特别会议。

articles.title: Hilary Duff Has a ‘CATastrophe’ on Her Hands With New Song for ‘The Cat in the Hat’ Movie: Watch the Video
articles.author: Alicia Urrea

paras.en: Hilary Duff is adding a little more chaos to her comeback year — this time with a certain mischievous feline.
paras.zh: 希拉里·达芙 (Hilary Duff) 为她的复出之年增添了更多混乱——这次是一只顽皮的猫。

paras.en: The pop star has released “CATastrophe,” an original song written for Warner Bros. Pictures Animation’s upcoming theatrical adaptation of The Cat in the Hat. The track arrived Friday (Oct. 2) along with a music video that drops Duff into a series of colorful, oversized worlds inspired by the whimsical visual language of Dr. Seuss.
paras.zh: 这位流行歌星发行了《CATastrophe》，这是一首为华纳兄弟动画公司即将上映的戏剧改编版《戴帽子的猫》创作的原创歌曲。这首歌曲于周五（10 月 2 日）与音乐视频一起发布，在苏斯博士异想天开的视觉语言的启发下，达夫进入了一系列色彩缤纷的超大世界。

paras.en: Duff co-wrote the song with her husband and frequent collaborator Matthew Koma, Madison Love and Brian Phillips, with Koma and Phillips also handling production. Rather than just serving as a playful tie-in to the movie, “CATastrophe” explores a pretty relatable idea: what happens when life suddenly changes before you’re even ready for it.
paras.zh: 达夫与她的丈夫和经常合作的马修·科马、麦迪逊·洛夫和布莱恩·菲利普斯共同创作了这首歌，科马和菲利普斯也负责制作。 《灾难》不仅仅只是作为电影的一个有趣的搭配，它探索了一个非常相关的想法：当生活在你准备好之前突然改变时会发生什么。

paras.en: In a statement provided to Billboard, Duff explained that Dr. Seuss books were a fixture in her childhood home, making the opportunity to contribute to the movie an easy yes. She also described the song as being about the feeling of having your entire world rearranged without getting a say in the matter — an idea that she wanted to pair with an upbeat, car-ready pop song; a great juxtaposition.
paras.zh: 在向《公告牌》提供的一份声明中，达夫解释说，苏斯博士的书籍是她童年家里的固定物品，因此有机会为这部电影做出贡献是很容易的。她还形容这首歌是关于一种在没有发言权的情况下重新安排你的整个世界的感觉——她想将这个想法与一首乐观的、适合汽车使用的流行歌曲搭配起来；一个伟大的并置。

paras.en: The song arrives as Duff continues her big musical comeback. Earlier this year, she released Luck… Or Something, her first studio album in more than a decade. The 11-track album debuted at No. 3 on the Billboard 200, giving Duff her sixth top 10 album on the chart and her highest position on the tally since 2007.
paras.zh: 这首歌的到来正值达芙继续她的音乐大回归之际。今年早些时候，她发行了十多年来的第一张录音室专辑《Luck… Or Something》。这张包含 11 首歌曲的专辑首次亮相就在 Billboard 200 排行榜上排名第 3，这让 Duff 第六次跻身排行榜前 10 名，这也是她自 2007 年以来在排行榜上的最高位置。

paras.en: Duff’s return to pop has also extended beyond the studio. After nearly two decades away from full-scale touring, she launched the Lucky Me tour this year, bringing her Y2K-era hits and new material to fans around the world. Billboard recently reported that the tour has been extended through 2027, and Duff is set to be honored with Billboard‘s Outstanding Pop Tour of the Year award at the 2026 Billboard Live Music Summit in November.
paras.zh: 达夫重返流行音乐的领域也延伸到了录音室之外。在距离全面巡演近二十年后，她今年推出了 Lucky Me 巡演，为世界各地的歌迷带来她的 Y2K 时代热门歌曲和新材料。 《公告牌》最近报道称，巡演已延长至 2027 年，达夫将在 11 月举行的 2026 年公告牌现场音乐峰会上荣获《公告牌》年度杰出流行巡演奖。

paras.en: Duff is now taking her comeback into an entirely different universe, one filled with talking animals, impossible proportions and a very tall red-and-white hat.
paras.zh: 达芙现在正带着她的回归进入一个完全不同的世界，这个世界充满了会说话的动物、不可思议的比例和一顶非常高的红白帽子。

paras.en: The Cat in the Hat will arrive in theaters and IMAX on Nov. 6, with The Cat in the Hat (Original Motion Picture Soundtrack) due roughly a week before on Oct. 30. The Warner Bros. Pictures Animation’s first full-length theatrical feature will star Bill Hader as the iconic Seussian troublemaker, following Cat as he attempts to help siblings Gabby and Sebastian adjust to moving to a new town. Matt Berry, Quinta Brunson, Xochitl Gomez, Giancarlo Esposito and America Ferrera are also among the voice cast.
paras.zh: 《戴帽子的猫》将于 11 月 6 日在影院和 IMAX 上映，而《戴帽子的猫》（电影原声带）大约在一周前于 10 月 30 日上映。华纳兄弟动画公司的首部长篇剧场版将由比尔·哈德尔 (Bill Hader) 主演，饰演标志性的苏斯麻烦制造者，跟随猫试图帮助盖比 (Gabby) 和塞巴斯蒂安 (Sebastian) 兄妹适应搬到新城镇的生活。马特·贝瑞、昆塔·布伦森、索奇特尔·戈麦斯、吉安卡洛·埃斯波西托和亚美莉卡·费雷拉也在配音阵容中。

articles.title: Noah Kahan Unleashes ‘Hunger Games’ Cut ‘Draw You Out’: Stream It Now
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: Noah Kahan is playing to win on “Draw You Out,” the lead single from the forthcoming film in the Hunger Games franchise.
paras.zh: 诺亚·卡汉 (Noah Kahan) 正在为即将上映的《饥饿游戏》系列电影的主打单曲《Draw You Out》而战。

paras.en: Arriving as the clock hit midnight, “Draw You Out” sees Kahan reunite with Aaron Dessner, who co-wrote and co-produced the track at New York’s Long Pond Studio and Nashville’s Gold Pacific Studios and East Iris Studios.
paras.zh: 午夜时分，《Draw You Out》中卡汉与亚伦·德斯纳 (Aaron Dessner) 重聚，后者在纽约的 Long Pond Studio、纳什维尔的 Gold Pacific Studios 和 East Iris Studios 共同创作并制作了这首歌曲。

paras.en: “Draw You Out” features those dramatic, multi-tracked vocals that sent Kahan into music’s top tier with 2022’s “Stick Season,” and will be housed on the official soundtrack, The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping (The Album), due out Nov. 13 via MCA.
paras.zh: 《Draw You Out》具有戏剧性的多音轨人声，使 Kahan 凭借 2022 年的《Stick Season》进入音乐界的顶级地位，并将收录在官方原声带《饥饿游戏：收割日出》（专辑）中，该原声带将于 11 月 13 日通过 MCA 发行。

paras.en: With the fresh cut, inspired by and written for the film, the folk-pop artist is reflective, moody and ready for battle. On it, he sings: “I was born with someone else’s face / A coward’s anger and a fighters rage / I wait around for them to take my place / And say love you’re free now.” Fighting words.
paras.zh: 这位民谣流行艺术家的灵感来自电影并专为电影而创作，清新的剪辑风格深思熟虑、喜怒无常，随时准备战斗。在上面，他唱道：“我生来就有别人的脸/懦夫的愤怒和战士的愤怒/我等待他们取代我的位置/说爱你现在自由了。”战斗的话。

paras.en: Speaking with Billboard’s Lyndsey Havens, the Vermont artist said it was “an insane opportunity” to play a part in the Hunger Games universe, and that he’s “read all the books” and “seen all the movies.”
paras.zh: 这位佛蒙特州艺术家在接受 Billboard 的 Lyndsey Havens 采访时表示，参与《饥饿游戏》宇宙是“一个疯狂的机会”，而且他“读过所有的书”并“看过所有的电影”。

paras.en: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping (The Album) is executive produced by Dave Cobb (Chris Stapleton, Sturgill Simpson) and brings together 29 cross-genre artists, according to a statement from MCA. Kahan is the only artist confirmed for the project to-date.
paras.zh: 根据 MCA 的一份声明，《饥饿游戏：收割日出》（专辑）由戴夫·科布（克里斯·斯塔普尔顿、斯特吉尔·辛普森）担任执行制作，汇集了 29 名跨流派艺术家。卡汉是迄今为止唯一确认参与该项目的艺术家。

paras.en: “Music is such a massive part of the Hunger Games in a lot of ways,” Kahan tells Billboard. “To be able to speak to what the director sees in these characters, what Suzanne Collins wrote these characters for, and to try to match that is a big task – but a really fun challenge. I just can’t believe that I get to be a part of it.”
paras.zh: “音乐在很多方面都是《饥饿游戏》的重要组成部分，”卡汉告诉《告示牌》。 “能够说出导演对这些角色的看法，苏珊娜·柯林斯写这些角色的目的，并尝试与之匹配，这是一项艰巨的任务，但也是一个非常有趣的挑战。我简直不敢相信我能成为其中的一部分。”

paras.en: Lionsgate’s The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping, a prequel that revisits the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, will play in theaters from on Nov. 20.
paras.zh: 狮门影业出品的前传《饥饿游戏：收割日出》将重温《饥饿游戏》事件发生 24 年前的施惠国世界，将于 11 月 20 日在影院上映。

paras.en: Pre-order the album here and check out the tracklist below.
