articles.title: Noah Kahan, Victoria Monét, Drake & Miranda Lambert with Ella Langley: New Music Friday Guide
articles.author: Lyndsey Havens

paras.en: Billboard’s Friday Music Guide serves as a handy guide to New Music Friday’s most essential releases each week — the key music that everyone will be talking about today, and that will be dominating playlists this weekend and beyond.
paras.zh: Billboard 的周五音乐指南是每周周五新音乐最重要版本的便捷指南 - 今天每个人都会谈论的关键音乐，并且将在本周末及以后的播放列表中占据主导地位。

paras.en: Last week, we featured Taylor Swift, Tinashe, Madonna and Charli xcx and Kenny Chesney.
paras.zh: 上周，我们邀请了泰勒·斯威夫特、蒂娜什、麦当娜、查理·xcx 和肯尼·切斯尼。

paras.en: This week, Noah Kahan’s lead single from The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping soundtrack arrives; Victoria Monét drops her highly-anticipated second album; and Miranda Lambert shares her country-meets-disco set, Crisco … plus much more. Check out all of this week’s picks below:
paras.zh: 本周，诺亚·卡汉 (Noah Kahan) 的《饥饿游戏：收割日出》原声带中的主打单曲发布；维多利亚·莫奈 (Victoria Monet) 发布了她备受期待的第二张专辑；米兰达·兰伯特 (Miranda Lambert) 分享了她的乡村与迪斯科组合《Crisco》……以及更多精彩内容。查看以下本周所有精选内容：

paras.en: Not long ago, it was revealed that Noah Kahan had landed the coveted lead single for The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping soundtrack — and it arrives today. The sweeping and emotive “Draw You Out” would sound equally at home on one of Kahan’s albums as it will within the film, which was the exact balance the singer-songwriter was trying to strike. As he told Billboard: “If I have to sit there in the studio and put a lot of love into it, I don’t know if I can connect with it if I don’t feel like parts of me are in there … I really do feel proud of being able to find that balance on this song.” He co-wrote and co-produced the song with Aaron Dessner. The full soundtrack drops Nov. 13, while the film hits theaters Nov. 20.— LYNDSEY HAVENS
paras.zh: 不久前，据透露，诺亚·卡汉 (Noah Kahan) 已在《收割》原声带中获得了令人垂涎的《饥饿游戏：日出》主打单曲，并且于今天发布。宽广而感人的《Draw You Out》在卡汉的一张专辑中听起来和在电影中一样自在，这正是这位歌手兼作曲家试图达到的平衡。正如他告诉 Billboard 的那样：“如果我必须坐在录音室里，投入大量的爱，如果我感觉不到自己的一部分在那里，我不知道我是否能与它产生共鸣……我真的为能够在这首歌中找到这种平衡而感到自豪。”他与亚伦·德斯纳 (Aaron Dessner) 共同创作并制作了这首歌。完整的原声带将于 11 月 13 日发售，而电影则于 11 月 20 日在影院上映。 — LYNDSEHAVES

paras.en: The Jaguar era is officially in the rearview mirror. Fresh off that three-time Grammy-winning project, Victoria Monét has returned with Frequency of Love, a sweeping, swooning 22-track odyssey through every kind of love imaginable. Featuring appearances by Bruno Mars, SZA, Lucky Daye, Bryson Tiller, Chlöe, Leon Thomas and, of course, her daughter Hazel Monét, Victoria’s second album is a triumph. Her pen is as sharp as ever, and her curatorial skills have somehow gotten even more impressive. It may be time for her to clear up some more space on her awards mantle. — KYLE DENIS
paras.zh: 捷豹时代正式成为历史。刚刚获得三届格莱美奖的维多利亚·莫奈 (Victoria Monet) 带着《Frequency of Love》回归，这是一首内容广泛、令人着迷的 22 首曲目，讲述了各种可以想象的爱情。布鲁诺·马尔斯 (Bruno Mars)、SZA、Lucky Daye、布莱森·蒂勒 (Bryson Tiller)、克洛伊 (Chlöe)、莱昂·托马斯 (Leon Thomas) 以及她的女儿黑泽尔·莫奈 (Hazel Monet) 都曾参与演出，维多利亚的第二张专辑堪称一次胜利。她的笔锋一如既往，她的策展技巧也更加令人印象深刻。也许是时候让她在自己的奖项头衔上腾出更多空间了。 — 凯尔·丹尼斯

paras.en: Earlier this year, Drake became the first artist in Billboard 200 history to simultaneously debut three studio albums in the chart’s top three spots with his seismic Iceman-Habibti-Maid of Honour drop. Now, Drizzy has reloaded his R&B-tinged Habibti set with four new tracks, all of which he debuted in his FOMO short film on YouTube two weeks ago. Don Toliver pops up on “Solar Eclipse” and standout “Cold Shoulder,” which also features frequent collaborator Yebba. Is there really such a thing as too much Drake? — K.D.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，Drake 以其震撼人心的《Iceman-Habibti-Maid of Honor》成为 Billboard 200 历史上第一位同时发行三张录音室专辑并跻身排行榜前三名的艺人。现在，Drizzy 重新加载了带有 R&B 色彩的 Habibti 曲目，其中包含四首新曲目，所有这些曲目都是他两周前在 YouTube 上发布的 FOMO 短片中首次亮相的。唐·托利弗 (Don Toliver) 出现在《日食》和出色的《冷肩》中，其中还有经常合作的耶巴 (Yebba)。德雷克（Drake）真的太多了吗？ — K.D.

paras.en: Montero is back — and aiming higher than ever, with a new single titled “World’s Greatest!” With a chorus that sounds like repeated mirror affirmations (“I’m a champion/ I’m a champion”), the verses seem to pull more from early-life diary entries about his upbringing, reminding him just how far he’s made it: “Came up from the bottom/ Used to share a room with my sisters and my brothers … I was sad, I was down, I was covered in defeat/ Now everybody from my town play my songs on repeat.” With this new single, Lil Nas X is not only taking a moment to dust himself off and pat himself on the back, but is testing the power of manifestation — and time will tell just how powerful it really is. — L.H.
paras.zh: 蒙特罗回来了，他的目标比以往任何时候都更高，推出了一首名为“世界上最伟大的！”的新单曲。副歌听起来像是重复的镜像肯定（“我是冠军/我是冠军”），这些诗句似乎更多地取自早年日记中有关他成长的经历，提醒他自己已经走了多远：“从底层走来/曾经和我的姐妹和兄弟共用一个房间……我很伤心，我很沮丧，我被失败所笼罩/现在来自我镇的每个人都重复播放我的歌曲。”在这首新单曲中，Lil Nas X 不仅花时间掸掉身上的灰尘并拍拍自己的背，而且还在测试表现的力量——时间会证明它到底有多强大。 — L.H.

paras.en: Holly Humberstone, “Too Cute To Be Lonely”
paras.zh: 霍莉·亨伯斯通，“太可爱了，不会孤独”

paras.en: Alt-pop artist Holly Humberstone released her excellent second album, Cruel World, earlier this year and is now gifting fans a little more to love. This week, the singer-songwriter announced a deluxe edition, Cruel World…So It Ends, will arrive Nov. 13 — and thankfully, she’s sharing a taste of the extra tracks today. The playfully poppy “Too Cute To Be Lonely” is one of five bonus songs on the deluxe, showcasing some of Humberstone’s most crisp and assured vocals. And much like Role Model with the deluxe for Kansas Anymore (namely, its bonus track and breakout smash “Sally, When the Wine Runs Out”), it’s possible Humberstone’s deluxe could birth an unexpected pop hit of its own while garnering new appreciation for the original set. — L.H.
paras.zh: 另类流行歌手霍莉·亨伯斯通 (Holly Humberstone) 今年早些时候发行了她出色的第二张专辑《残酷世界》(Cruel World)，现在为歌迷们带来了更多的爱。本周，这位创作型歌手宣布豪华版《Cruel World…So It Ends》将于 11 月 13 日上市 - 值得庆幸的是，她今天分享了额外曲目的品味。俏皮的罂粟花“Too Cute To Be Lonely”是豪华版中的五首额外歌曲之一，展示了亨伯斯通最清脆和自信的声音。就像《堪萨斯不再》的豪华版《榜样》一样（即它的额外曲目和突破性的热门单曲《莎莉，当酒耗尽》），亨伯斯通的豪华版可能会带来意想不到的流行歌曲，同时为原版赢得新的欣赏。 — L.H.

paras.en: Dexter and the Moonrocks & Avery Anna, “Why Don’t You Say So”
paras.zh: 《德克斯特与月岩》和艾弗里·安娜，“你为什么不这么说”

paras.en: After breaking big earlier this year with the Alternative Airplay No. 1 “Freakin’ Out,” alternative-grunge act Dexter and the Moonrocks is sharing its debut full-length, Friends That I Don’t Like. For its focus track, the group tapped one friend they do seem to like: emerging pop artist Avery Anna. Her sugary vocals balance out the harder production elements while also blending rather seamlessly with frontman James Tuff’s signature tone. The album’s only other feature is from Treaty Oak Revival on the previously-released single, “12 Steps.” — L.H.
paras.zh: 继今年早些时候凭借另类音乐节目《Freakin’ Out》取得巨大成功后，另类垃圾摇滚乐队《Dexter and the Moonrocks》将分享其首张完整专辑《Friends That I Don't Like》。在其焦点曲目中，该乐队选择了一位他们似乎很喜欢的朋友：新兴流行艺术家艾弗里·安娜（Avery Anna）。她甜美的声音平衡了较难的制作元素，同时也与主唱詹姆斯·塔夫的标志性音色无缝融合。这张专辑唯一的其他特色是之前发行的单曲“12 Steps”中的Treaty Oak Revival。 — L.H.

paras.en: Miranda Lambert & Ella Langley, “Snakeskin Boots”
paras.zh: 米兰达·兰伯特和艾拉·兰利，“蛇皮靴”

paras.en: It seems Lambert and Langley had some unfinished business in the studio — and how lucky for fans. After working together on Langley’s celebrated second album, Dandelion, which Lambert co-produced (including its breakout smash and Hot 100 No. 1 “Choosin’ Texas”), Langley is now returning the favor by guesting on Lambert’s 12th studio album, Crisco. Out today, the album walks the line between country and disco and their collaboration fits the bill well with groovy, midtempo production that sounds tailor-made for a desert dancefloor. — L.H.
paras.zh: 兰伯特和兰利似乎在工作室里还有一些未完成的事情——这对粉丝来说是多么幸运。在兰利与兰伯特共同制作了著名的第二张专辑《Dandelion》（包括其突破性的热门专辑和热门 100 排名第一的“Choosin’ Texas”）后，兰利现在通过客串兰伯特的第 12 张录音室专辑《Crisco》来回报兰利。今天发行的这张专辑介于乡村音乐和迪斯科音乐之间，他们的合作非常符合节奏、中速制作的要求，听起来是为沙漠舞池量身定做的。 — L.H.

articles.title: Ben Affleck Explains His Approach to Using AI Ethically on New Movie ‘Animals’: “It’s Not About Making Fake People or Replacing Anybody, Ever”
articles.author: Kirsten Chuba

paras.en: After Ben Affleck made some news this week when he spoke about using AI on his new movie Animals, and now he’s going deeper on his approach to use the technology in a responsible way.
paras.zh: 本·阿弗莱克本周发表了一些新闻，谈到在他的新电影《动物》中使用人工智能，现在他正在更深入地探讨以负责任的方式使用该技术的方法。

paras.en: Affleck first spoke about Animals’ use of AI at Bloomberg‘s Screentime event on Wednesday, saying, “I used [AI] for lots of things in that movie. I’m a little bit hesitant to point out what they are — or even talk about it — because in my business, we’re trying to foster the illusion of reality, right?” He added, “But yes, we did use it, and in fact, I thought it was a good example (of how to use AI ethically) because it’s a very human movie.”
paras.zh: 阿弗莱克在周三的彭博屏幕时间活动上首次谈到《动物》对人工智能的使用，他说：“我在那部电影中使用了人工智能。我有点犹豫是否指出它们是什么——甚至谈论它——因为在我的行业中，我们试图培养现实的幻觉，对吧？”他补充道，“但是，是的，我们确实使用了它，事实上，我认为这是一个很好的例子（如何道德地使用人工智能），因为这是一部非常人性化的电影。”

paras.en: At the Netflix film‘s premiere on Thursday, Affleck told The Hollywood Reporter that his approach to AI is “really simple, I wouldn’t use something that trains on or has learned from any work that is copywritten, or that is an intelligence created by a peer of mine or somebody that I look up to. That was why we created a dataset that was proprietary, so that it wouldn’t have to be extractive.”
paras.zh: 在周四 Netflix 电影的首映式上，阿弗莱克告诉《好莱坞报道》，他的人工智能方法“非常简单，我不会使用从任何文案作品中训练或学习的东西，或者是由我的同事或我尊敬的人创建的智能。这就是为什么我们创建了一个专有的数据集，这样它就不必是提取性的。”

paras.en: He continued that he’s not at all interested in making movies “where you just type things and things come out” because “I don’t think that’s ever going to happen in a way that anyone’s going to give a shit enough to want to see it. I wouldn’t want to be part of it if it was. What I’m trying to do is actually bring this technology into our business, into a place where these companies who are guild signatories, who have relationships with the creative community, who aren’t going to just go ahead and put you in a movie without your permission and without paying you — that can’t be said for a lot of tech platforms and other spaces where we don’t just abjure this technology and allow others to take it and dominate it, and then weaken ourselves.”
paras.zh: 他继续说道，他对制作“你只需输入一些东西，然后东西就会出来”的电影完全不感兴趣，因为“我认为这种情况永远不会以任何人都想看它的方式发生。如果是的话，我也不想成为其中的一部分。我想做的实际上是将这项技术带入我们的业务，带入一个地方，在那里，这些公司是行会签约者，与创意社区有关系，他们不会只是未经你的许可，也不付钱给你，就让你出演一部电影——这对于很多技术平台和其他领域来说是不可能的，在这些平台和其他领域，我们不仅放弃这项技术，允许其他人采用它并主宰它，然后削弱我们自己。”

paras.en: “I’m already uncomfortable with some of the ways some tech companies behave around image and likeness, and I feel that actually, as my thesis and what was borne out was, if you give this to people who actually make films, you’re going to get way better results. And we have, and we did,” Affleck explained. “And like at Netflix, it’s like, ‘Hey, do you want to use this? Do you want to try this?’ This is a discrete set of tools. It’s not about making fake people or replacing anybody, ever. It’s about another interesting post tool, and if you can see it or if you can tell what it is, like, you’ve ruined it. Just like a bad visual effect, just like a bad performance.”
paras.zh: “我已经对一些科技公司在形象和相似性方面的一些行为方式感到不舒服，而且我觉得实际上，正如我的论文和所证实的那样，如果你把这个交给真正制作电影的人，你会得到更好的结果。我们已经做到了，我们确实做到了，”阿弗莱克解释道。 “就像在 Netflix 一样，‘嘿，你想用这个吗？你想尝试一下吗？’这是一套独立的工具。这从来都不是为了造假人或取代任何人。这是关于另一个有趣的后期工具，如果你能看到它，或者如果你能分辨出它是什么，就像，你就毁了它。就像糟糕的视觉效果一样，就像糟糕的表演一样。”

paras.en: The star has been quietly working in the AI space for several years now, and earlier in 2026 Affleck sold his AI company InterPositive to Netflix for nearly $600 million. He directed, co-wrote and stars in Animals, which follows a Los Angeles mayoral candidate whose son is kidnapped and he and his wife (Kerry Washington) get their hands dirty to come up with the ransom.
paras.zh: 这位明星已经在人工智能领域默默耕耘了几年，2026 年初，阿弗莱克以近 6 亿美元的价格将他的人工智能公司 InterPositive 卖给了 Netflix。他执导、联合编剧并主演了《动物》，该片讲述了一位洛杉矶市长候选人的儿子被绑架，他和他的妻子（凯丽·华盛顿饰）不遗余力地筹集赎金的故事。

paras.en: In his lengthy red carpet chat with THR, Affleck emphasized “we do have an issue in Hollywood. It’s not AI, it’s never actually going to be able to do this, in my view,” instead pointing to problems of theatrical attendance, labor stoppages and production tax rebates. He also pointed to his and Matt Damon’s company Artists Equity and the belief that “in success, everybody is compensated in a very clear way.”
paras.zh: 在与《好莱坞报道》的长篇红毯交谈中，阿弗莱克强调“我们在好莱坞确实遇到了一个问题。在我看来，这不是人工智能，它实际上永远无法做到这一点”，而是指出了影院上座率、停工和制作退税等问题。他还提到了他和马特·达蒙的公司 Artists Equity 以及“在成功时，每个人都会以非常明确的方式得到补偿”的信念。

paras.en: He said InterPositive is of the same philosophy, and “if you are a director or an actor and you are contributing something that’s your art, then yes, if you choose to use this technology to train from that, you avail yourself of that intelligence. You don’t have to give it to the rest of the world. They are not entitled to that, but you can use the technology if everyone else uses it. If you choose, if you feel that it helps your film in one way or another, and there are places where it does.”
paras.zh: 他说 InterPositive 有着同样的理念，“如果你是一名导演或演员，并且你正在贡献一些属于你的艺术的东西，那么是的，如果你选择使用这项技术来进行训练，你就利用了自己的智慧。你不必把它交给世界其他地方。他们没有权利这样做，但如果其他人都使用它，你可以使用这项技术。如果你选择，如果你觉得它以某种方式帮助你的电影，而且在某些地方确实如此。”

paras.en: Affleck added that “the truth about AI that people don’t talk about is it’s like deeply and fundamentally limited in a lot of ways. It’s not magic. It’s not super intelligence. It’s not sentient. That’s just old bullshit. And eventually, we’ll look back and be like, ‘Remember when people were going around saying it was going to be Terminator and these machines were geniuses?'”
paras.zh: 阿弗莱克补充道，“人们不谈论的人工智能的真相是，它在很多方面都受到了深刻而根本的限制。它不是魔法。它不是超级智能。它没有感知力。这只是老废话。最终，我们会回想起来，‘还记得当人们到处说这将是终结者而这些机器是天才的时候吗？’”

paras.en: Animals hits select theaters and starts streaming on Netflix Oct. 9.
paras.zh: 《动物》将于 10 月 9 日在指定影院上映并开始在 Netflix 上播放。

articles.title: Kelly Clarkson Loves AI, But Says AI Artists Shouldn’t Be “Competing With Humans” on Music Charts
articles.author: Carly Thomas

paras.en: Kelly Clarkson is getting candid about what she calls her “controversial” thoughts on artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 凯莉·克拉克森 (Kelly Clarkson) 坦诚地表达了她对人工智能的“有争议”的想法。

paras.en: While chatting with Matt Rogers and Bowen Yang on a recent episode of their Las Culturistas podcast, the Grammy winner explained that while she loves the technology, she doesn’t feel AI artists should be competing on music charts with humans.
paras.zh: 这位格莱美奖得主在最近一期的 Las Culturistas 播客中与马特·罗杰斯 (Matt Rogers) 和鲍文·杨 (Bowen Yang) 聊天时解释说，虽然她热爱这项技术，但她认为人工智能艺术家不应该在音乐排行榜上与人类竞争。

paras.en: “Here’s the thing, I love AI,” she admitted. “There are very amazing things with AI that I’m obsessed with. But also, and I’m very into it artistically too, I have fun with it just like everybody else does. But when you see AI artists competing on a chart with humans, I have an issue. I think there should be a separate chart.”
paras.zh: “事情是这样的，我喜欢人工智能，”她承认道。 “人工智能有很多令人惊奇的事情，让我着迷。而且，我在艺术上也非常喜欢它，我像其他人一样享受它的乐趣。但是当你看到人工智能艺术家与人类在图表上竞争时，我有一个问题。我认为应该有一个单独的图表。”

paras.en: “It’s welcome to the table. I think it’s really cool and creative what we’re going to create with AI musically, and people that maybe can’t do certain things will be able to do it now. I think it’s a fun field to play in,” Clarkson continued, “but I don’t think that they should be competing with humans.”
paras.zh: “欢迎大家参与进来。我认为我们将用人工智能来创造音乐，这真的很酷，也很有创意，那些可能无法做某些事情的人现在也能做到。我认为这是一个有趣的领域，”克拉克森继续说道，“但我认为他们不应该与人类竞争。”

paras.en: “It’s basically like having Olympics and then you’re having robots compete with humans, well who’s going to throw it further? Oh, I wonder. So I’m down with it and I think it’s a very interesting thing and what we’re going to do with it is going to be fun, but I do not think they should be competing,” she added.
paras.zh: “这基本上就像举办奥运会，然后让机器人与人类竞争，那么谁会扔得更远？哦，我想知道。所以我对此很满意，我认为这是一件非常有趣的事情，我们将用它做的事情会很有趣，但我认为他们不应该竞争，”她补充道。

paras.en: AI-generated music has not been banned from Billboard, the music industry standard record chart in the U.S. However, Billboard shared in August that it remains committed to “creating greater transparency around the use of artificial intelligence in music, including identifying songs on its charts and in its editorial coverage that use AI.”
paras.zh: 美国音乐行业标准唱片排行榜 Billboard 并未禁止人工智能生成的音乐。不过，Billboard 在 8 月份表示，它仍然致力于“在音乐中人工智能的使用方面创造更大的透明度，包括识别其排行榜上和编辑报道中使用人工智能的歌曲。”

paras.en: Clarkson acknowledged that AI is “not going anywhere,” and that there are “so many amazing scientific things that are happening” with the technology. But she also expressed the importance of being “able to differentiate” between AI and human work.
paras.zh: 克拉克森承认人工智能“不会去任何地方”，并且该技术“正在发生许多令人惊奇的科学事情”。但她也表达了“能够区分”人工智能和人类工作的重要性。

paras.en: “We can’t lose human,” she added. “We can’t lose what that is. But there could be an appetite for both, is what I’m saying.”
paras.zh: “我们不能失去人类，”她补充道。 “我们不能失去它。但我想说的是，两者可能都有需求。”

articles.title: ‘American Horror Story: 13’ Jeffrey Dahmer Actor on That ‘Coven’ Cliffhanger and Sharing the Serial Killer With Co-Star Evan Peters
articles.author: Jackie Strause

paras.en: [This story contains MAJOR spoilers from the sixth episode of American Horror Story,”The Return of Devil’s Night.”]
paras.zh: [本故事包含《美国恐怖故事》第六集《魔鬼之夜归来》的主要剧透。]

paras.en: American Horror Story fans knew something big was coming with the sixth episode of the all-star 13th season. As if it wasn’t enough to see icons from the franchise reprising multiple roles in the first three episodes of the crossover installment of Ryan Murphy and Brad Falchuk’s hit horror series during week one, the episode title for the third episode of week two carried a huge hint: “The Return of Devil’s Night.”
paras.zh: 《美国恐怖故事》的粉丝们都知道第 13 季全明星第六集将会有大事发生。似乎在第一周瑞恩·墨菲和布拉德·法尔查克的热门恐怖剧集的交叉部分的前三集中看到该系列的偶像们重新扮演多个角色还不够，第二周第三集的剧集标题带有一个巨大的暗示：“魔鬼之夜的回归”。

paras.en: “Devil’s Night” was the epic episode of AHS season five, Hotel, that offered up a dinner party with the most notorious real-life serial killers when Evan Peters‘ James Patrick March summoned Aileen Wuornos (played by Lily Rabe), John Wayne Gacy (played by John Carroll Lynch), Richard Ramirez (played by Anthony Ruivivar), The Zodiac Killer (with a covered face) and Jeffrey Dahmer (played by Seth Gabel).
paras.zh: 《恶魔之夜》是《美国恐怖故事》第五季《酒店》的史诗级剧集，埃文·彼得斯饰演的詹姆斯·帕特里克·马奇召唤了艾琳·沃诺斯（莉莉·拉贝饰）、约翰·韦恩·盖西（约翰·卡罗尔·林奇饰）、理查德·拉米雷斯（安东尼·瑞维瓦尔饰）、十二宫杀手（蒙面）和杰弗里·达默（饰），与现实生活中最臭名昭著的连环杀手共进晚宴。作者：塞思·加贝尔）。

paras.en: The sixth episode’s return to “Devil’s Night” brought back Richard Ramirez, The Zodiac Killer and Dahmer, as March once again called on his infamous friends for mayhem. This time, his target was the witches from AHS season three, Coven, led by Cordelia Goode, played by Sarah Paulson.
paras.zh: 第六集回归“恶魔之夜”，带回了十二宫杀手理查德·拉米雷斯和达默，马奇再次呼吁他臭名昭著的朋友们制造混乱。这次，他的目标是《美国恐怖故事》第三季中的女巫集会，由莎拉·保尔森饰演的科迪莉亚·古德领导。

paras.en: The episode ended in a major cliffhanger, as Cordelia goes down with an axe to her skull thrown by March, and the group of serial killers begins to invade the coven, which also includes the returning witches played by Emma Roberts, Gabourey Sidibe and Billie Lourd. Gabel says the saga continues with an “explosive” seventh episode that picks up where the serial killers left off.
paras.zh: 这一集以悬念结尾，马奇扔出的斧头砍向科迪莉亚的头骨，这群连环杀手开始入侵女巫集会，其中还包括由艾玛·罗伯茨、加布蕾·西迪贝和比莉·洛德饰演的回归女巫。加贝尔说，这个传奇故事将在“爆炸性”的第七集中继续，从连环杀手结束的地方开始。

paras.en: Gabel’s return as Dahmer was a meta experience, since it reunited him with Peters, the actor who went on to play Dahmer (who killed 17 men and boys between 1978 and 1991) in the inaugural season of Murphy and Ian Brennan’s Monster franchise, The Jeffrey Dahmer Story. “I didn’t know how Evan would be approaching this with me coming back with a role he had done before,” Gabel admits The Hollywood Reporter. “But it was clear, right when we got to rehearsal, that he was attached to his March character and just encouraged me to fly, and Jeffrey was mine again and I could do whatever I wanted with it.”
paras.zh: 加贝尔以达莫的回归是一次元体验，因为这让他与彼得斯重聚，彼得斯后来在墨菲和伊恩·布伦南的怪物系列《杰弗里·达莫的故事》第一季中扮演达莫（他在 1978 年至 1991 年间杀死了 17 名男子和男孩）。 “我不知道埃文会如何对待我，带着他以前扮演过的角色回来，”加贝尔向《好莱坞报道》承认。 “但很明显，当我们排练时，他很喜欢他的马奇角色，只是鼓励我飞翔，而杰弗里又是我的了，我可以用它做任何我想做的事。”

paras.en: Below, Gabel dives deeper into his dark return as Dahmer, shares the two words Murphy told him that defined his portrayal, and teases what he knows about the tightly kept plot of the rest of AHS: 13, while musing about how Dahmer led him to his serial killer role on The Rookie (which returns in January).
paras.zh: 下面，加贝尔更深入地探讨了他饰演达默的黑暗回归，分享了墨菲告诉他的定义他的形象的两个词，并调侃了他对《美国恐怖故事：13》其余部分严密保留的情节的了解，同时思考达默如何带领他在《新秀》（一月回归）中扮演连环杀手角色。

paras.en: The 2015 “Devil’s Night” episode of Hotel is one of the most talked about and revisited episodes of American Horror Story. When you first got that offer to play Dahmer, did you have any hesitations about playing him, and did you know at all how big it would be?
paras.zh: 2015 年《旅馆》的“魔鬼之夜”剧集是美国恐怖故事中最受关注和重温的剧集之一。当你第一次收到扮演达默的邀请时，你对扮演他有任何犹豫吗？你知道它会有多大吗？

paras.en: There’s never a hesitation in saying yes to a Ryan Murphy show because you know, at the very least, it’s going to be a blast. My only hesitation was figuring out a way to turn a very real, dark serial killer into something that was satirical and funny. I went into “Devil’s Night” nervous about that, and was just kind of feeling my way through as we were rehearsing with all the other actors. Then Ryan took me aside and said two words, and it unlocked everything for me. He said, “Poor Jeffrey.” In that, I understood that what’s funny about this is that this guy did the most reprehensible things in the world, and he felt like the victim in all of it. I realized that’s what’s funny — he’s so self-indulgent and unaware, so the irony is that with these awful things he’s doing and that are happening, he feels like it’s really inconvenient for him.
paras.zh: 观看瑞恩·墨菲 (Ryan Murphy) 的表演时，你会毫不犹豫地答应，因为你知道，至少，这会是一场爆炸。我唯一犹豫的是想办法把一个非常真实、黑暗的连环杀手变成讽刺和有趣的东西。我进入“魔鬼之夜”时对此感到紧张，当我们与所有其他演员一起排练时，我只是在摸索。然后瑞安把我拉到一边说了两个字，这让我解开了一切。他说：“可怜的杰弗里。”在那之后，我明白了有趣的是，这个家伙做了世界上最应受谴责的事情，而他感觉自己是这一切的受害者。我意识到这就是有趣的地方——他是如此的自我放纵和无知，所以讽刺的是，随着他正在做的这些可怕的事情和正在发生的事情，他觉得这对他来说真的很不方便。

paras.en: At that point, did you know that Ryan Murphy was thinking about doing an entire Monster season around Dahmer?
paras.zh: 那时，您是否知道瑞恩·墨菲 (Ryan Murphy) 正在考虑围绕达默 (Dahmer) 制作整个《怪物》赛季？

paras.en: No, not at all. Once I saw they were doing that, there’s obviously the feeling of, “Oh, did I not do it well enough to get the part” kind of a thing. But it was so clear that I’m right for the satire version of Jeffrey, but not the realistic version where he’s younger, and I thought Evan [Peters] did such a brilliant job with that.
paras.zh: 不，一点也不。当我看到他们这样做时，显然有一种感觉，“哦，我做得不够好，无法获得这个角色”之类的事情。但很明显，我适合讽刺版的杰弗里，但不适合他年轻的现实版，我认为埃文（彼得斯）在这方面做得非常出色。

paras.en: I didn’t know how Evan would be approaching this with me coming back with a role he had done before. But it was clear, right when we got to rehearsal, that he was attached to his March character and just encouraged me to fly, and Jeffrey was mine again and I could do whatever I wanted with it.
paras.zh: 我不知道当我带着他以前扮演过的角色回来时，埃文会如何处理这个问题。但很明显，当我们开始排练时，他很喜欢他的马奇角色，只是鼓励我飞翔，而杰弗里又是我的了，我可以用它做任何我想做的事。

paras.en: It’s very meta. Coming back to AHS and working with Evan Peters, two Dahmers…
paras.zh: 这非常元。回到《美国恐怖故事》并与埃文·彼得斯、两个达默一起工作……

paras.en: Two Dahmers in a Waymo together browsing Grinder on an iPhone. It’s pretty surreal. (Laughs.)
paras.zh: Waymo 中的两个 Dahmer 一起在 iPhone 上浏览 Grinder。这太超现实了。 （笑）

paras.en: You two never shared Dahmer tips with each other when he was in the role?
paras.zh: 当达默扮演这个角色时，你们两个从来没有互相分享过达默的技巧吗？

paras.en: No, no. We didn’t. We didn’t share tips. (Laughs.)
paras.zh: 不，不。我们没有。我们没有分享秘诀。 （笑）

paras.en: You said your version is more of a satire, but did you also do a deep dive into researching him for the Hotel role?
paras.zh: 你说你的版本更像是讽刺，但你是否也深入研究过他的酒店角色？

paras.en: I did do the full deep dive, the full research. I really wanted to understand his psychology and was surprised to find how empathetic I could be with how he took the world’s homophobia and added that to his own repression and kind of turned it into this morbid fantasy that he acted out in reality. The challenge as an actor, which everyone talks about, is that you need to find a way to have some compassion for these evil characters and understand where they’re coming from. That was a very strange, surreal trip to go on where I could find some aspect of myself that could side with him.
paras.zh: 我确实进行了全面的深入研究、全面的研究。我真的很想了解他的心理，并惊讶地发现我对他如何看待世界上的同性恋恐惧症有多么的同情，并将其添加到他自己的压抑中，并将其变成了他在现实中表现出来的病态幻想。作为一名演员所面临的挑战，每个人都在谈论，那就是你需要找到一种方法，对这些邪恶的角色抱有一些同情心，并了解他们的来源。那是一次非常奇怪、超现实的旅行，我可以在其中找到自己可以站在他一边的某些方面。

paras.en: When the call came to do it again, I told myself, I did enough the first time, I don’t need to dive into that research again. So I just went on the ride and trusted that once I got in costume and everything that it would all come back. The Midwestern dialect is such a big part of who he is. That was really the first thing I needed to do to get back in, and then it felt like riding a bike.
paras.zh: 当再次接到电话时，我告诉自己，我第一次已经做得足够了，我不需要再次投入这项研究。所以我就继续骑行并相信一旦我穿上服装和一切，一切都会回来。中西部方言是他性格的重要组成部分。这确实是我回来需要做的第一件事，然后感觉就像骑自行车一样。

paras.en: In the last 10 years since that Hotel scene, dinner scenes have become a prestige TV trope but at the time, that was a new experience. What was it like filming that epic dinner scene?
paras.zh: 自从那次酒店场景之后的过去十年里，晚餐场景已经成为一个著名的电视比喻，但在当时，这是一种新的体验。拍摄那个史诗般的晚餐场景感觉如何？

paras.en: Totally surreal. They did such a great job bringing everyone back to life. All the actors are so fun to play with and so brilliant, and what I love about doing a Ryan Murphy show is that acting is treated as sacred. You really get to spend time rehearsing and figuring out how to make the scene the best it could be.
paras.zh: 完全超现实。他们做得非常出色，使每个人都复活了。所有的演员都很有趣，而且都很出色，我喜欢瑞恩·墨菲的表演，因为表演被视为神圣的。你真的需要花时间排练并弄清楚如何使场景达到最佳效果。

paras.en: I just remember in the “Devil’s Night” episode that we had maybe two days of rehearsal. We had plenty of time filming it. Everyone got to really explore their instincts and impulses, and got to play with each other. Everyone’s an incredibly generous actor, so you’re just giving each other as much as you can, and really having fun with the material and really going for it.
paras.zh: 我只记得在“魔鬼之夜”那一集中，我们大概排练了两天。我们有足够的时间来拍摄它。每个人都必须真正探索自己的本能和冲动，并互相玩耍。每个人都是一个非常慷慨的演员，所以你们只是尽你所能地互相给予，并且真正享受这些材料并真正为之努力。

paras.en: So then you get the call to come back. Ryan has described this season as “AHS good v. evil, Avengers-style.” And now, in this episode, we see its serial killers v. the coven, Avengers-style. Is everyone from the table coming back?
paras.zh: 然后你接到电话让你回来。瑞安将这一季描述为“美国恐怖故事《正义与邪恶》，复仇者联盟风格。”现在，在这一集中，我们看到了复仇者风格的连环杀手诉女巫集会。桌上的人都回来了吗？

paras.en: Not everyone makes it back. I think not everyone’s schedule worked out. But the mash-up of real-world serial killers v. the witches in Coven is really fun — and really pays off a lot more in the next episode [episode seven].
paras.zh: 不是每个人都能回来。我认为并不是每个人的日程安排都顺利。但现实世界的连环杀手与女巫集会的混搭真的很有趣——而且在下一集（第七集）中确实得到了更多的回报。

paras.en: Were you thrilled when you got the call?
paras.zh: 当你接到电话的时候，是不是很激动呢？

paras.en: Oh, yeah. Anytime you get to play some kind of a crazy, real-world character and make it a satire and put a spin, you’re thrilled. And obviously being part of the Avengers-season of Horror Story is a dream because you’re like, “Oh, they liked me. They really liked me.” (Laughs.) “So I get to come back. This is great.” I get to play with Sarah and Emma and Gabourey, and everyone.
paras.zh: 哦，是的。每当你扮演某种疯狂的、现实世界的角色，并把它做成讽刺剧和旋转时，你都会感到兴奋。显然，成为复仇者联盟恐怖故事季的一部分是一个梦想，因为你会说，“哦，他们喜欢我。他们真的很喜欢我。” （笑）“所以我要回来了。这太棒了。”我可以和莎拉、艾玛、加布蕾以及所有人一起玩。

paras.en: This week’s episode ends on a huge cliffhanger — Cordelia (Paulson) is seemingly dead, with an axe in her head from March (Peters). Episode seven picks up from there.
paras.zh: 本周的剧集以一个巨大的悬念结束——科迪莉亚（保尔森饰）似乎已经死了，马奇（彼得斯饰）的斧头插在了她的头上。第七集从那里开始。

paras.en: Is your role two episodes, or do we see you more after episode seven? Are you allowed to say?
paras.zh: 你的角色是两集，还是第七集之后我们会更多地看到你？你可以说吗？

paras.en: I don’t know what I could say. There’s definitely more in seven, but I can’t say more after that.
paras.zh: 我不知道我能说什么。七中肯定还有更多，但之后我不能再说更多了。

paras.en: Cordelia could be dead. We do see that there are witches who have all kinds of powers, so we’ll have to see who’s good at what.
paras.zh: 科迪莉亚可能已经死了。我们确实看到女巫拥有各种各样的力量，所以我们必须看看谁擅长什么。

paras.en: Why was March able to overpower Supreme witch Cordelia, do we think?
paras.zh: 我们认为为什么马奇能够战胜至高女巫科迪莉亚？

paras.en: She seems to be not on her A-game. You see her turn and run, and it’s like, why would she turn and run? Of course he’s going to do something to her. I’m surprised she let her guard down like that. But she’s definitely off her A-game. You see for a couple episodes that she’s feeling like something is off, and it’s really disorienting her, so I think we see her make a mistake in that moment and March takes advantage of it.
paras.zh: 她似乎没有发挥出自己的最佳水平。你看到她转身就跑，你会想，她为什么要转身就跑？他当然要对她做点什么。我很惊讶她竟然如此放松警惕。但她绝对没有达到最佳状态。你会在几集中看到她感觉有些不对劲，这真的让她迷失了方向，所以我认为我们看到她在那一刻犯了一个错误，而马奇利用了它。

paras.en: Why does this group want to go after the coven?
paras.zh: 为什么这群人想要追击女巫集会？

paras.en: There’s this war for control of Earth; hell is kind of rising and coming into this reality, and March has manipulated all the killers into joining this mission so they can be the ones who are in control and taking over. The witches stand in the way of that, they have to stop them.
paras.zh: 这是一场争夺地球控制权的战争；地狱正在崛起并进入这个现实，马奇操纵所有杀手加入这个任务，这样他们就可以成为控制和接管的人。女巫们挡在了这一切的路上，她们必须阻止他们。

paras.en: How much are you told going into an American Horror Story season; did you find out when you get the scripts?
paras.zh: 进入《美国恐怖故事》季，你会被告知多少内容？你拿到剧本的时候发现了吗？

paras.en: As I get the script, yes, and I didn’t even get the whole script, just parts of it. You go in and piece things together, which makes it fun because you’re kind of in the mystery along with everyone else. So you just fully commit to what it is you do know, and it creates this really nice mash-up between everyone fully committing to what it is they know versus what they don’t know.
paras.zh: 当我拿到剧本时，是的，我什至没有拿到整个剧本，只是其中的一部分。你进去把东西拼凑起来，这很有趣，因为你和其他人一样都处于神秘之中。所以你只要完全致力于你所知道的事情，它就会在每个人完全致力于他们所知道的事情和他们不知道的事情之间创造出这种非常好的混搭。

paras.en: But you know how the serial killers v. Coven battle ends.
paras.zh: 但你知道连环杀手与女巫集会的战斗如何结束。

paras.en: Can you describe it, in non-spoiler terms?
paras.zh: 你能用不剧透的方式描述一下吗？

paras.en: It’s explosive. It’s messy. And it’s extremely elemental, because all the spells come out, and all the spells are meeting guns, knives, drills, every kind of weapon conceivable. So you’re truly seeing a mash-up of all the elements.
paras.zh: 这是爆炸性的。很乱。这是非常基本的，因为所有的咒语都出来了，所有的咒语都遇到了枪，刀，钻头，各种可以想象的武器。所以你确实看到了所有元素的混搭。

paras.en: Did Dahmer lead to your role in ABC police procedural The Rookie (where Gabel plays serial killer Liam Glasser)?
paras.zh: 达默是否让你在 ABC 警察程序剧《菜鸟》（其中加贝尔扮演连环杀手利亚姆·格拉瑟）中扮演角色？

paras.en: I don’t know. I think Dahmer is the first time I found that I could flip a switch in my brain and have fun playing dark, demented stuff. So, yeah, I guess you could say it led to The Rookie in that being able to approach dark material in a comedic way helped me find a way to keep these things light.
paras.zh: 我不知道。我认为达​​默是我第一次发现我可以打开大脑的开关并享受玩黑暗、疯狂的东西的乐趣。所以，是的，我想你可以说它导致了《新秀》的诞生，因为能够以喜剧的方式处理黑暗材料帮助我找到了一种让这些东西保持轻松的方法。

paras.en: I think I keep getting hired for these kind of creepy, dark roles because I can have fun with it. I kind of relish the freedom you feel and not having any rules and being allowed to do whatever you want, and letting whatever weird instincts fly, and they end up using it for the take. I think the freedom I felt from the Horror Story style, I was able to apply to The Rookie, which is a very earnest, beautiful show. But by simply having fun with the killer-type role, it keeps it light — so I think that’s why Glasser keeps eluding them and continuing to be a menacing presence.
paras.zh: 我想我一直被雇用来扮演这些令人毛骨悚然、黑暗的角色，因为我可以从中获得乐趣。我有点享受你感受到的自由，没有任何规则，被允许做任何你想做的事情，让任何奇怪的本能飞翔，而他们最终会利用它来获得好处。我认为我从《恐怖故事》风格中感受到的自由，可以应用到《新秀》中，这是一部非常真诚、美丽的节目。但通过简单地享受杀手型角色的乐趣，它就能保持轻松——所以我认为这就是为什么格拉瑟不断躲避他们并继续成为一个具有威胁性的存在。

paras.en: Can you tease anything about the new Rookie season?
paras.zh: 你能透露一下关于新秀赛季的事情吗？

paras.en: I don’t know yet. I got the call just recently, and I’m really excited to be going back. I think I’m going to get to play there for at least a few episodes. I feel like fans are going to be disappointed if Glasser continues to remain free, but at the same time, I don’t want it to end, so we’ll see what happens.
paras.zh: 我还不知道。我最近刚刚接到电话，我很高兴能回去。我想我会在那里玩至少几集。我觉得如果格拉瑟继续保持自由，粉丝们会感到失望，但与此同时，我不希望它结束​​，所以我们会看看会发生什么。

paras.en: And will you return for The Watcher season two?
paras.zh: 你会回归《守望者》第二季吗？

paras.en: I’m angling for it. We’ll see what happens.
paras.zh: 我正在寻找它。我们会看看会发生什么。

paras.en: I know Ian Brennan is writing the new season now.
paras.zh: 我知道伊恩·布伦南正在撰写新一季的剧本。

paras.en: Yeah. I’ve been trying to get calls in there to be like, “Hey, I’ve got ideas!” But I don’t think anyone’s interested! (Laughs.)
paras.zh: 是的。我一直在尝试接到电话，说：“嘿，我有主意！”但我认为没有人感兴趣！ （笑）

paras.en: New episodes of AHS: 13 premiere Thursdays at 9 pm ET/PT on FX and 9 pm PT on Hulu, until the finale on Thursday, Oct. 29. Read all of THR’s season coverage here, including an explainer on how all the seasons connect.
paras.zh: 《美国恐怖故事》新剧集：每周四 13 集首播，时间为 FX 晚上 9 点（东部时间/太平洋时间），Hulu 晚上 9 点（太平洋时间），直到 10 月 29 日星期四大结局。请在此处阅读 THR 的所有季报道，包括所有季如何关联的解释。

articles.title: Jewelry giant Pandora is getting in on lab-grown diamonds and hoping a new Vietnam plant helps growth in Asia

paras.en: Danish jewelry giant Pandora has opened its $150 million manufacturing facility in Vietnam, betting on further growth in Asia as the company diversifies production beyond its longtime base in Thailand.
paras.zh: 丹麦珠宝巨头潘多拉 (Pandora) 在越南开设了价值 1.5 亿美元的制造工厂，随着该公司将生产多元化到泰国以外的长期基地，押注于亚洲的进一步增长。

paras.en: The move underscores Pandora's growing ambitions in Asia, where the company sees significant room for further expansion.
paras.zh: 此举突显了潘多拉在亚洲日益增长的雄心，该公司认为亚洲有巨大的进一步扩张空间。

paras.en: "We are clearly building the capacity today for the growth of tomorrow that we expect," President and CEO Berta de Pablos-Barbier told CNBC's "Squawk Box Asia" on Friday, adding that Asia remains a "very positive region" for Pandora after growing at 10% in the second quarter.
paras.zh: 总裁兼首席执行官 Berta de Pablos-Barbier 周五在 CNBC 的“Squawk Box Asia”节目中表示：“我们今天显然正在为我们预期的明天的增长而建设产能。”他补充说，在第二季度增长 10% 后，亚洲仍然是 Pandora 的一个“非常积极的地区”。

paras.en: Its facility in Ho Chi Minh City is Pandora's first production site outside Thailand and is expected to increase the company's manufacturing capacity by around 50%. The factory can produce up to 60 million pieces of jewelry annually and will employ about 7,000 people when fully operational.
paras.zh: 其位于胡志明市的工厂是潘多拉在泰国以外的第一个生产基地，预计将使该公司的制造能力提高约50%。该工厂每年可生产多达 6,000 万件珠宝，全面投产后将雇用约 7,000 名员工。

paras.en: The jewelry giant also sees growth opportunities elsewhere in Asia, particularly in Japan.
paras.zh: 这家珠宝巨头还看到了亚洲其他地区的增长机会，尤其是日本。

paras.en: Pandora's Japan business has "pretty much doubled" in size over the only three years and continues to grow at "very high double digits," she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说，潘多拉的日本业务在短短三年内规模“几乎翻了一番”，并继续以“非常高的两位数”增长。

paras.en: China, however, presents a different picture, with the company having seen three years of declines. However, Pandora expects to return to growth there this year.
paras.zh: 然而，中国的情况却有所不同，该公司已经连续三年下滑。然而，潘多拉预计今年将恢复增长。

paras.en: "For the first time, we're starting to see growth coming back, and we are actually delivering better growth than we had in the previous year," Pablos-Barbier said, adding that she remains positive about the company's ability to continue growing in China.
paras.zh: 巴勃罗-巴比尔表示：“我们第一次开始看到增长回升，而且我们实际上实现了比前一年更好的增长。”她补充说，她对公司在中国继续增长的能力仍然持乐观态度。

paras.en: Pandora is also leaning further into lab-grown diamonds, as the jeweler sees growing consumer appetite for the more affordable alternative to mined stones.
paras.zh: 潘多拉 (Pandora) 还进一步倾向于实验室培育钻石，因为该珠宝商看到消费者对更实惠的开采宝石替代品的兴趣不断增长。

paras.en: "The consumer is making the choice based on a couple of criteria. The first one is sustainability," Pablos-Barbier said.
paras.zh: “消费者根据几个标准做出选择。第一个是可持续性，”巴勃罗-巴比尔说。

paras.en: She pointed to affordability and sustainability as factors driving consumers toward lab-grown diamonds. The stones cost less than mined diamonds, allowing Pandora to offer diamond jewelry at more accessible prices, while producing around 90% fewer carbon emissions, according to Pablos-Barbier.
paras.zh: 她指出，负担能力和可持续性是促使消费者购买实验室制造钻石的因素。 Pablos-Barbier 表示，这些宝石的成本低于开采的钻石，因此潘多拉能够以更实惠的价格提供钻石珠宝，同时减少约 90% 的碳排放。

paras.en: She also pointed to younger consumers as being more environmentally conscious, though she said preferences can vary by geography.
paras.zh: 她还指出，年轻消费者更具环保意识，但她表示偏好可能因地理位置而异。

paras.en: The company's move into lab-grown diamonds was an "obvious" choice, Pablos-Barbier said, pointing to its use of recycled silver and gold as well as renewable energy at its new Vietnam facility.
paras.zh: Pablos-Barbier 表示，该公司进军实验室培育钻石领域是一个“显而易见”的选择，并指出其在越南新工厂中使用了回收的银和金以及可再生能源。

articles.title: Brazil votes in high-stakes election as U.S.-China rivalry and debt loom large

paras.en: Brazil will hold a knife-edge vote on Sunday as its presidential race kicks off — but the election's outcome is likely to be felt far beyond the country's borders.
paras.zh: 随着总统竞选的拉开帷幕，巴西将于周日举行一场关键性的投票，但选举结果可能会远远超出该国国界。

paras.en: Voters will head to the polls to decide whether incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva — known colloquially as Lula — should remain in office or be replaced by one of 12 alternative candidates.
paras.zh: 选民将前往投票站决定现任总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦（Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva，俗称卢拉）是否应该继续留任，或者由 12 名替代候选人之一取代。

paras.en: If no candidate wins more than 50% of votes in Sunday's first round, the two candidates with the most support will progress to a final runoff vote on Oct. 25.
paras.zh: 如果没有候选人在周日的第一轮投票中赢得超过 50% 的选票，则获得最多支持的两名候选人将进入 10 月 25 日的最终决选投票。

paras.en: Polls point to a tight race, with frontrunners Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro effectively tied for support among voters.
paras.zh: 民意调查显示，这场竞选势均力敌，领先者卢拉和弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗在选民中的支持率基本持平。

paras.en: A win for left-leaning Lula would mark his fourth presidential term, while victory for Bolsonaro is expected to mark a shift back to his father's right-wing movement.
paras.zh: 左倾卢拉的胜利将标志着他的第四个总统任期，而博尔索纳罗的胜利预计将标志着他父亲的右翼运动的转变。

paras.en: Lula's center-left Workers Party (PT) has been a pioneer of social programs aimed at lifting millions of people out of poverty — but it has been stained by corruption scandals. Lula himself spent 18 months in prison after receiving a coastal property from an engineering firm involved in the so-called Car Wash corruption investigation. Former president Dilma Rousseff, who succeeded Lula in 2010, was impeached in 2016, having been accused of budget manipulation.
paras.zh: 卢拉领导的中左翼工人党（PT）一直是旨在让数百万人摆脱贫困的社会计划的先驱，但它却因腐败丑闻而沾上污点。卢拉本人在从一家参与所谓洗车腐败调查的工程公司获得沿海财产后入狱 18 个月。 2010 年接替卢拉的前总统迪尔玛·罗塞夫 (Dilma Rousseff) 因被指控操纵预算而于 2016 年遭到弹劾。

paras.en: Flávio Bolsonaro is a senator and son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, who is currently under house arrest. Jair Bolsonaro was sentenced to 27 years in prison for plotting a coup after losing the 2022 presidential election to Lula.
paras.zh: 弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗是参议员，也是前总统雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗的儿子，目前被软禁。雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗 (Jair Bolsonaro) 在 2022 年总统选举中输给卢拉后，因策划政变被判处 27 年监禁。

paras.en: Bolsonaro is widely viewed as the political heir to his father, with his policy mix favoring privatization, spending cuts and close alignment with the U.S. — policies that have had recent successes across Latin America, with Bolivia, Chile, Colombia and Peru all inaugurating conservative leaders in the last 12 months.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗被广泛视为其父亲的政治继承人，他的政策组合有利于私有化、削减开支以及与美国保持密切一致——这些政策最近在拉丁美洲取得了成功，玻利维亚、智利、哥伦比亚和秘鲁都在过去12个月内任命了保守派领导人。

paras.en: Lula, meanwhile, has put Brazilian sovereignty at the center of his campaign. He has also pledged to reduce Brazil's traditional six-day work week, cut income tax for low-earners and enact policing reforms.
paras.zh: 与此同时，卢拉将巴西主权置于其竞选活动的中心。他还承诺减少巴西传统的每周六天工作时间，削减低收入者的所得税，并实施警务改革。

paras.en: The president has endured a rocky relationship with the Trump administration, which treated Jair Bolsonaro – dubbed colloquially the "Trump of the Tropics" – as a close ally. U.S. President Donald Trump announced 50% tariffs on Brazil in July 2025 in response to what he labeled a "witch-hunt" trial against Jair Bolsonaro.
paras.zh: 总统与特朗普政府的关系不稳定，特朗普政府将雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗（俗称“热带特朗普”）视为亲密盟友。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普于 2025 年 7 月宣布对巴西征收 50% 的关税，以回应他所谓的针对贾尔·博尔索纳罗的“政治迫害”审判。

paras.en: Otaviano Canuto, a nonresident senior fellow at The Brookings Institution and a former executive director at the Board of the International Monetary Fund for Brazil, told CNBC that the upcoming vote was a "hinge election" for the broader region with respect to the U.S. and the so-called "Donroe Doctrine" that has seen the Trump administration take a greater interest in Latin America.
paras.zh: 布鲁金斯学会非常驻高级研究员、国际货币基金组织巴西理事会前执行董事奥塔维亚诺·卡努托 (Otaviano Canuto) 向 CNBC 表示，即将举行的投票对于更广泛的地区来说是一次“关键选举”，涉及美国和所谓的“唐罗主义”，特朗普政府对拉丁美洲更加感兴趣。

paras.en: "Brazil is the largest economy in the region and if you take the region as a whole, 20 republics [in Latin America] are now are ruled by right-wing leaders," he said. "And of course, if a victory by Flavio Bolsonaro happens, that would deepen the strategic alignment of the region with President Donald Trump's plan for America. By contrast, if Lula obtains a fourth term, that will frustrate Washington's bid to dominate the neighborhood, and squeeze out the Chinese influence."
paras.zh: “巴西是该地区最大的经济体，如果将该地区作为一个整体，（拉丁美洲）有 20 个共和国现在由右翼领导人统治，”他说。 “当然，如果弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗获胜，这将加深该地区与唐纳德·特朗普总统的美国计划的战略联盟。相比之下，如果卢拉获得第四个任期，这将挫败华盛顿主导该地区的努力，并挤出中国的影响力。”

paras.en: Paulo Nogueira Batista Jr., a Brazilian economist and former vice president of the BRICS New Development Bank, told CNBC that the outcome of the election will have "a substantial effect on all parts of Brazilian life" because the two leading candidates are "radically different."
paras.zh: 巴西经济学家、金砖国家新开发银行前副行长小保罗·诺盖拉·巴蒂斯塔 (Paulo Nogueira Batista Jr.) 告诉 CNBC，选举结果将“对巴西生活的各个方面产生重大影响”，因为两位主要候选人“截然不同”。

paras.en: "Flavio Bolsonaro has declared to be closely aligned to Donald Trump, and this might affect Brazilian-Chinese relations — [and] China is our main trade partner," he explained. "The geopolitical situation of Brazil that will change enormously if Bolsonaro wins, and will continue more or less like it has been in recent years if Lula wins his re-election bid."
paras.zh: “弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗已宣布与唐纳德·特朗普密切结盟，这可能会影响巴中关系——[而且]中国是我们的主要贸易伙伴，”他解释道。 “如果博尔索纳罗获胜，巴西的地缘政治局势将发生巨大变化，如果卢拉赢得连任，巴西的地缘政治局势将或多或少地像近年来那样持续下去。”

paras.en: According to Canuto, part of Brazil's appeal to the U.S. administration is the country's abundance of critical minerals.
paras.zh: 卡努托表示，巴西对美国政府的吸引力部分在于该国丰富的关键矿产资源。

paras.en: "Trump has been very proactive in trying to guarantee the access to critical minerals, and Brazil is the second source rare earth reserves on the planet, [behind] China," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“特朗普一直非常积极地努力确保获得关键矿产，而巴西是地球上第二大稀土储量来源，仅次于中国。”

paras.en: "So, the U.S.-China rivalry spills over to access to critical minerals and rare earths, and as we all know, all signals coming from Washington point in the direction of demanding the countries in the region establish restrictions to the Chinese access and so on."
paras.zh: “因此，美中竞争蔓延到关键矿产和稀土的获取上，众所周知，来自华盛顿的所有信号都指向要求该地区国家对中国的准入设置限制等。”

paras.en: Another major issue at the center of the election is Brazil's mounting debt pile.
paras.zh: 此次选举的另一个主要问题是巴西不断增加的债务负担。

paras.en: The vote is being closely watched by investors across the globe, with questions swirling around whether the incoming administration can deliver fiscal credibility.
paras.zh: 此次投票受到全球投资者的密切关注，人们对即将上任的政府是否能够提供财政信誉存在疑问。

paras.en: Brazil's debt has steadily risen in recent years, and stood at 82.9% of gross domestic product in August.
paras.zh: 巴西债务近年来稳步上升，8月份占国内生产总值的82.9%。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Brazil's budget deficit stands at 9.48% of GDP, fueling concerns about whether the next administration will be able to deliver fiscal discipline and bring the national books under greater control.
paras.zh: 与此同时，巴西的预算赤字占GDP的9.48%，引发了人们对下一届政府是否能够实行财政纪律并更好地控制国家账簿的担忧。

paras.en: But while the wider economy has come under pressure, with inflation hovering above 4% and the government trimming its economic growth forecasts, Brazil has also been an economic beneficiary of higher oil prices as a net oil exporter.
paras.zh: 不过，尽管整体经济面临压力，通胀徘徊在4%以上，而且政府下调了经济增长预测，但巴西作为石油净出口国，也是油价上涨的经济受益者。

paras.en: "The war in Iran, economically speaking, benefited Brazil in terms of trade gains with the rising price of oil," Canuto told CNBC. "Of course, nothing is for free, and the shocks in terms of prices ended up creating challenges in Brazil in terms of controlling inflation."
paras.zh: 卡努托对 CNBC 表示：“从经济角度来看，伊朗战争使巴西在石油价格上涨的情况下获得了贸易收益。” “当然，没有什么是免费的，物价冲击最终给巴西控制通胀带来了挑战。”

paras.en: Whoever wins, he added, will be obliged to present a plan on bringing the public finances under control.
paras.zh: 他补充说，无论谁获胜，都将有义务提出一项控制公共财政的计划。

paras.en: "In the short term there is no [imminent risk of] crisis, but the levels of nominal debts are reflecting the high interest rates that in turn reflect fiscal fragility. As time passes by, they tend to enter into an unsustainable trajectory, and markets see this and will charge rising premiums and higher interest rates, which would make things worse."
paras.zh: “短期内不存在危机[迫在眉睫的风险]，但名义债务水平反映了高利率，而高利率反过来又反映了财政脆弱性。随着时间的推移，它们往往会进入不可持续的轨道，市场看到了这一点，将收取不断上涨的保费和更高的利率，这将使情况变得更糟。”

paras.en: The yield on Brazil's benchmark 10-year government bond was last seen trading at around 14.16%. In comparison, the yield on the U.S. 10-year Treasury note hit a 24-year high of 5.3338% on Thursday.
paras.zh: 巴西基准 10 年期政府债券收益率最近一次交易于 14.16% 左右。相比之下，美国10年期国债收益率周四触及24年来新高5.3338%。

paras.en: "The fact of the matter is that Brazil, like other countries in the region, will have to undergo some process of fiscal adjustment, and that's a challenge when you have to negotiate with a divided Congress," Canuto added.
paras.zh: 卡努托补充说：“事实是，巴西与该地区其他国家一样，必须经历一定的财政调整过程，当你必须与分裂的国会进行谈判时，这是一个挑战。”

paras.en: But according to Christine Reed — who manages an emerging markets fixed income portfolio at Ninety One — a tightening presidential race means the risk-reward weighting across Brazilian assets is improving.
paras.zh: 但据克里斯汀·里德（91 管理新兴市场固定收益投资组合）称，总统竞选的紧张意味着巴西资产的风险回报权重正在改善。

paras.en: "We see the most positive risk-reward asymmetry in local rates: tighter polls increase the odds of fiscal adjustment in 2027, while tight monetary policy and the removal of pre-election stimulus should weigh on economic activity and support disinflation, leaving room for further rate cuts regardless of who is elected," she said in an email.
paras.zh: 她在一封电子邮件中表示：“我们在当地利率中看到了最积极的风险回报不对称性：更严格的民意调查增加了2027年财政调整的可能性，而紧缩的货币政策和取消选举前的刺激措施应该会拖累经济活动并支持通货紧缩，从而为进一步降息留下空间，无论谁当选。”

paras.en: "The Brazilian real should continue to benefit from high interest-rate carry, tight monetary policy and improving polls, while in hard-currency debt, fiscal fundamentals remain the key risk of a potential Lula re-election and current spreads do not price that risk," she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说：“巴西雷亚尔应该继续受益于高利率利差、紧缩的货币政策和民意调查的改善，而在硬通货债务方面，财政基本面仍然是卢拉潜在连任的主要风险，而目前的利差并没有反映这种风险。”

paras.en: Batista Jr. agreed that the new leader would have to address Brazil's economic difficulties, telling CNBC the best-case scenario for Brazil would be a president who "would not throw caution to the wind, but would recognise the fact that we have a difficult macroeconomic situation to face up to."
paras.zh: 小巴蒂斯塔同意新领导人必须解决巴西的经济困难，他告诉 CNBC，对巴西来说最好的情况是一位“不会把谨慎抛在脑后，而是会认识到我们面临着艰难的宏观经济形势这一事实”的总统。

paras.en: "Both candidates, if they are elected, will have to take measures to control expenditure, possibly to increase taxation," he said — but he cautioned against immediate, wide-reaching reforms.
paras.zh: 他说：“两位候选人如果当选，都将不得不采取措施控制支出，可能会增加税收。”但他警告不要立即进行广泛的改革。

paras.en: "I would not, in any case, recommend a strong, drastic fiscal adjustment in the first year of the government, because that would harm the level of economic activity, which is already weak," he said. "GDP growth has fallen below 2% according to recent projections for this year, so the economy is not growing well — and a very tight fiscal policy imposed suddenly by the incoming government would be, I think, a [worst-case] scenario."
paras.zh: “无论如何，我不会建议在政府第一年进行强有力的、剧烈的财政调整，因为这会损害本已疲软的经济活动水平，”他说。 “根据最近对今年的预测，GDP 增长率已降至 2% 以下，因此经济增长不佳 - 我认为，即将上任的政府突然实施非常紧缩的财政政策将是[最坏的情况]。”

paras.en: — CNBC's Thomas Da Graca Barlow contributed to this article.
paras.zh: — CNBC 的 Thomas Da Graca Barlow 对本文有贡献。

articles.title: Bitget 'not expecting to recover a lot' from $388 million hack, CEO tells CNBC

paras.en: Approximately $1.1 million of the nearly $388 million stolen from crypto exchange Bitget in last week’s cyberattack has been frozen, as the platform continues efforts to trace and recover the assets.
paras.zh: 在上周的网络攻击中，加密货币交易所 Bitget 被盗近 3.88 亿美元，其中约 110 万美元已被冻结，该平台仍在继续努力追踪和追回资产。

paras.en: Frozen assets had not necessarily been returned to the exchange, CEO Gracy Chen told CNBC in an email interview. She did not disclose how much had been recovered.
paras.zh: 首席执行官 Gracy Chen 在接受 CNBC 电子邮件采访时表示，被冻结的资产不一定会归还给交易所。她没有透露已追回多少资金。

paras.en: Speaking on CNBC’s “Squawk Box Europe” on Wednesday, Chen said she was “not expecting to recover a lot of funds,” citing the limited recovery from previous cryptocurrency exchange hacks. However, “exchanges have a responsibility to demonstrate how they protect users, particularly when something goes wrong,” she said.
paras.zh: 周三，Chen 在 CNBC 的“Squawk Box Europe”节目中表示，她“预计不会收回大量资金”，理由是之前的加密货币交易所黑客攻击只收回了有限的资金。然而，“交易所有责任展示他们如何保护用户，特别是当出现问题时，”她说。

paras.en: Bitget said user account balances were unaffected.
paras.zh: Bitget 表示，用户账户余额不受影响。

paras.en: The exchange valued its protection fund at more than $464 million before the theft. It was drawn down to below $200 million following the hack, according to Bloomberg's calculation of the fund's disclosed wallet addresses, before being restored to more than $300 million. Chen said the replenished fund remained publicly verifiable on-chain and was separate from the reserves backing customer balances.
paras.zh: 在盗窃发生前，交易所对其保护基金的估值超过 4.64 亿美元。根据彭博社对该基金披露的钱包地址的计算，在黑客攻击后，该基金的资金被提取到了 2 亿美元以下，然后又恢复到了 3 亿多美元。陈表示，补充的资金仍然可以在链上公开验证，并且与支持客户余额的储备分开。

paras.en: Bitget’s latest Proof of Reserves, based on a Sept. 29 snapshot, showed a self-reported overall reserve ratio of 131%, with all 19 covered assets backed above 100%.
paras.zh: Bitget 最新的准备金证明（基于 9 月 29 日的快照）显示，自我报告的总体准备金率为 131%，所有 19 种担保资产的支持率均超过 100%。

paras.en: “We restored the Fund using Bitget’s own capital,” Chen said. “The financial impact is being absorbed by Bitget rather than passed on to our users.”
paras.zh: “我们用 Bitget 自有资金恢复了该基金，”陈说。 “财务影响正在被 Bitget 吸收，而不是转嫁给我们的用户。”

paras.en: Investigation reports released Sept. 30 by Mandiant, part of Google Cloud, and blockchain security firm SlowMist found that the attackers compromised two third-party security products before gaining access to Bitget’s production wallet systems.
paras.zh: 谷歌云旗下的 Mandiant 和区块链安全公司 SlowMist 于 9 月 30 日发布的调查报告发现，攻击者在访问 Bitget 的生产钱包系统之前破坏了两个第三方安全产品。

paras.en: SlowMist traced the earliest malicious activity in available logs to Aug. 31, when a previously unknown, or zero-day, vulnerability was exploited in one of the products.
paras.zh: SlowMist 在可用日志中将最早的恶意活动追溯到 8 月 31 日，当时其中一个产品中利用了一个先前未知的漏洞（即零日漏洞）。

paras.en: The attackers were then able to obtain privileged internal access and bypass the normal customer-facing withdrawal process without stealing private keys, Mandiant reported.
paras.zh: 据 Mandiant 报道，攻击者随后能够获得特权内部访问权限，并绕过正常的面向客户的提款流程，而无需窃取私钥。

paras.en: “The method, I would say, is quite sophisticated,” Chen said on “Squawk Box Europe,” adding that the attackers deleted traces after transfers to hinder the investigation.
paras.zh: “我想说，这种方法相当复杂，”陈在“Squawk Box Europe”节目中说道，并补充说，攻击者在转移后删除了痕迹，以阻碍调查。

paras.en: Neither report identified the affected security products. When asked, Chen declined to disclose further vendor or product details, citing the potential to introduce additional security risks by releasing information beyond the published findings.
paras.zh: 这两份报告都没有指出受影响的安全产品。当被问及时，陈拒绝透露进一步的供应商或产品细节，理由是发布超出已发布调查结果的信息可能会带来额外的安全风险。

paras.en: The reports did not attribute the attacks to North Korea. Chen had previously said preliminary technical indicators were highly consistent with known North Korean hacking groups.
paras.zh: 报道没有将袭击归咎于朝鲜。陈此前曾表示，初步技术指标与已知的朝鲜黑客组织高度一致。

paras.en: "We will have to wait further for further details on this," she told CNBC.
paras.zh: 她告诉 CNBC：“我们将不得不进一步等待有关此事的进一步细节。”

paras.en: Withdrawals for bitcoin, ether and USDT have resumed. Bitget has scheduled withdrawals for its remaining cryptocurrencies, along with fiat and peer-to-peer services, to resume on Friday.
paras.zh: 比特币、以太币和 USDT 的提现已恢复。 Bitget 已计划于周五恢复剩余加密货币以及法定货币和点对点服务的提现。

articles.title: How climate change is altering petrichor, the glorious smell after it rains

paras.en: The distinct, earthy smell that fills the air after rain following a long dry spell can trigger some serious nostalgia. This scent, petrichor, goes right to our brain’s memory and emotional centers for reasons that may be to do with our very evolution. But as climate change alters Earth’s weather and environment, petrichor is going to transform, too.
paras.zh: 长时间干旱之后，雨后空气中弥漫着独特的泥土气味，可能会引发一些严重的怀旧情绪。这种气味，petrichor，直接进入我们大脑的记忆和情感中心，其原因可能与我们的进化有关。但随着气候变化改变地球的天气和环境，Petrichor 也将发生变化。

paras.en: First, it helps to know why petrichor even happens. During dry periods, soil-dwelling bacteria produce a compound called geosmin that deters insects such as fruit flies. The chemical signals to the flies that the plant material the bacteria grow on isn’t appetizing and that it might be toxic. Geosmin also attracts spore-spreading animals, such as springtails, which help disperse the compound even more widely.
paras.zh: 首先，它有助于了解为什么会发生petrichor。在干旱时期，土壤中的细菌会产生一种叫做土臭素的化合物，可以阻止果蝇等昆虫。向苍蝇发出的化学信号表明，细菌生长的植物材料不好吃，而且可能有毒。土臭素还会吸引传播孢子的动物，例如跳虫，这有助于更广泛地传播该化合物。

paras.en: “Humans are extremely sensitive to geosmin,” says Johan Lundström, a psychologist specializing in olfactory perception at the Karolinska Institute in Sweden. “If there was one drop of geosmin stirred up into an Olympic-sized swimming pool, we’d still smell it.”
paras.zh: “人类对土臭素极其敏感，”瑞典卡罗林斯卡学院专门研究嗅觉的心理学家 Johan Lundström 说。 “如果在奥林匹克规模的游泳池中搅拌一滴土臭素，我们仍然会闻到它的味道。”
