articles.title: This diet may slow brain aging by 2.5 years

paras.en: This diet may slow brain aging by 2.5 years
paras.zh: 这种饮食可以延缓大脑衰老 2.5 年

paras.en: Following the MIND diet may help slow brain shrinkage and delay some signs of brain aging by years.
paras.zh: 遵循 MIND 饮食可能有助于减缓大脑萎缩，并延缓大脑衰老的迹象数年。

paras.en: - People who followed the MIND diet more closely showed slower brain shrinkage and less grey matter loss over time, with the strongest differences equivalent to about 2.5 years of delayed brain aging. Berries and poultry were linked with healthier brain changes, while sweets and fried fast foods were associated with greater tissue loss.
paras.zh: - 随着时间的推移，更严格遵循 MIND 饮食的人大脑萎缩速度更慢，灰质损失更少，最大的差异相当于大脑衰老延迟约 2.5 年。浆果和家禽与更健康的大脑变化有关，而糖果和油炸快餐则与更大的组织损失有关。

paras.en: A diet that combines elements of the Mediterranean diet with an eating plan designed to lower blood pressure may help slow some of the structural changes that occur as the brain ages, according to research published online in the Journal of Neurology Neurosurgery & Psychiatry.
paras.zh: 根据《神经学、神经外科与精神病学杂志》在线发表的研究，将地中海饮食元素与旨在降低血压的饮食计划相结合的饮食可能有助于减缓大脑老化时发生的一些结构变化。

paras.en: Greater adherence to the MIND diet was linked to less brain tissue loss over time, particularly in grey matter, which plays an important role in memory, learning, decision making, and information processing. It was also associated with less enlargement of the brain's ventricles, fluid filled spaces that tend to grow as brain tissue shrinks.
paras.zh: 随着时间的推移，越坚持 MIND 饮食，脑组织损失就越少，尤其是灰质，灰质在记忆、学习、决策和信息处理中发挥着重要作用。它还与脑室扩张减少有关，脑室充满液体的空间往往会随着脑组织的缩小而增大。

paras.en: The Mediterranean-Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension Diet Intervention for Neurodegenerative Delay diet, or MIND for short, has previously been associated with better cognitive health, according to the researchers.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，用于阻止高血压的地中海饮食方法对神经退行性疾病的饮食干预延迟饮食（简称 MIND）此前已被认为与更好的认知健康有关。

paras.en: The eating pattern emphasizes green leafy vegetables; other vegetables; berries; nuts; whole grains; fish; beans; olive oil; and poultry, along with moderate wine consumption. It also recommends limiting butter/margarine, cheese, red meat, pastries/sweets, and fried fast foods.
paras.zh: 饮食习惯以绿叶蔬菜为主；其他蔬菜；浆果；坚果；全谷物；鱼;豆子;橄榄油;和家禽，以及适量的葡萄酒消费。它还建议限制黄油/人造黄油、奶酪、红肉、糕点/糖果和油炸快餐。

paras.en: Although previous research has connected the MIND diet with cognitive benefits, its relationship with age related changes in brain structure has remained less clear. Those structural changes are also relevant to neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's and Parkinson's diseases.
paras.zh: 尽管之前的研究已将 MIND 饮食与认知益处联系起来，但其与年龄相关的大脑结构变化之间的关系仍不清楚。这些结构变化也与阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病等神经退行性疾病有关。

paras.en: Researchers Tracked Brain Changes for Years
paras.zh: 研究人员多年来追踪大脑变化

paras.en: To investigate, researchers studied 1647 middle aged and older adults (average age 60 at the start of the study) from the Framingham Heart Study Offspring cohort (FOS).
paras.zh: 为了进行调查，研究人员对来自弗雷明汉心脏研究后代队列 (FOS) 的 1647 名中老年人（研究开始时平均年龄 60 岁）进行了研究。

paras.en: Participants underwent regular health evaluations every 4-8 years. Starting in 1999, they also received MRI brain scans every 2-6 years.
paras.zh: 参与者每 4-8 年接受一次定期健康评估。从 1999 年开始，他们每 2-6 年接受一次 MRI 脑部扫描。

paras.en: Diet was assessed through at least 1 food frequency questionnaire (FFQ) completed during check ups between 1991-5, 1995-8, and/or 1998-2001. Each participant also had at least 2 brain MRI scan assessments between 1999 and 2019 and showed no evidence of stroke or dementia at the time of their first MRI scan.
paras.zh: 通过 1991-5、1995-8 和/或 1998-2001 年检查期间完成的至少 1 份食物频率调查问卷 (FFQ) 来评估饮食。每位参与者在 1999 年至 2019 年间还接受了至少 2 次脑部 MRI 扫描评估，并且在第一次 MRI 扫描时没有显示出中风或痴呆的证据。

paras.en: The average MIND diet score was just under 7 out of a possible 15, with 15 representing the strongest adherence.
paras.zh: MIND 饮食的平均得分略低于 7 分（满分为 15 分），其中 15 分代表坚持程度最高。

paras.en: People in the highest third for MIND diet adherence were more likely to be women and college educated. They were also less likely to smoke or have obesity.
paras.zh: MIND 饮食坚持率排名最高的三分之一的人更有可能是女性且受过大学教育。他们吸烟或肥胖的可能性也较小。

paras.en: They were also less likely to have conditions that can affect brain health, including type 2 diabetes, high blood pressure, and cardiovascular disease.
paras.zh: 他们也不太可能患有影响大脑健康的疾病，包括 2 型糖尿病、高血压和心血管疾病。

paras.en: Higher MIND Scores Linked to Slower Grey Matter Loss
paras.zh: 较高的 MIND 分数与较慢的灰质损失有关

paras.en: Over an average follow up period of 12 years, MRI scans showed the expected age related changes across the group. These included decreases in total brain, grey matter, white matter, and hippocampal volumes.
paras.zh: 在平均 12 年的随访期内，MRI 扫描显示了整个群体中预期的与年龄相关的变化。这些包括大脑总量、灰质、白质和海马体积的减少。

paras.en: At the same time, cerebrospinal fluid and ventricular volumes increased, as did white matter hyperintensities, which appear as bright spots on MRI scans and can indicate tissue damage.
paras.zh: 与此同时，脑脊液和脑室体积增加，白质高信号也增加，这在 MRI 扫描中显示为亮点，可以表明组织损伤。

paras.en: However, people with higher MIND diet scores experienced slower loss of grey matter.
paras.zh: 然而，MIND 饮食得分较高的人灰质损失较慢。

paras.en: Each 3 point increase in MIND diet score was associated with slower grey matter loss of (0.279 cm³/year). According to the researchers, that corresponded to 20% less age related decline and the equivalent of 2.5 years of delayed brain aging.
paras.zh: MIND 饮食评分每增加 3 分，灰质损失减慢（0.279 立方厘米/年）相关。据研究人员称，这相当于与年龄相关的衰退减少了 20%，相当于大脑衰老延迟了 2.5 年。

paras.en: A similar pattern appeared in ventricular enlargement. Each 3-point rise in MIND diet score was associated with slower expansion of total ventricular volume by −0.071 cm³/year, equivalent to 8% less tissue loss and about 1 year of delayed brain aging.
paras.zh: 类似的模式也出现在心室扩大中。 MIND 饮食评分每上升 3 分，脑室总容积扩张速度减慢 -0.071 cm3/年，相当于组织损失减少 8%，大脑衰老延迟约 1 年。

paras.en: Some foods appeared to contribute more strongly to the favorable associations.
paras.zh: 一些食物似乎对这种有利的关联有更大的贡献。

paras.en: Higher berry intake was linked to slower increases in ventricular volume. Poultry was also associated with slower ventricular enlargement, along with a slower decline in grey matter.
paras.zh: 浆果摄入量越高，心室容积增加越慢。家禽还与脑室扩大较慢以及灰质下降较慢有关。

paras.en: In contrast, higher consumption of sweets was associated with faster ventricular enlargement and greater hippocampal atrophy. Fried fast foods were also linked to a larger decline in hippocampal volume.
paras.zh: 相反，甜食摄入量越高，心室扩大越快，海马萎缩越严重。油炸快餐也与海马体体积大幅下降有关。

paras.en: "MIND-recommended foods rich in antioxidants, such as berries, and high-quality protein sources like poultry may reduce oxidative stress and mitigate neuronal damage," suggest the researchers. "Conversely, fried fast foods, often high in unhealthy fats, trans fats, and advanced glycation end-products, may contribute to inflammation and vascular damage," they add.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示：“MIND 推荐的富含抗氧化剂的食物（例如浆果）和优质蛋白质来源（例如家禽）可以减少氧化应激并减轻神经元损伤。” “相反，油炸快餐通常含有大量不健康脂肪、反式脂肪和晚期糖基化终产物，可能会导致炎症和血管损伤，”他们补充道。

paras.en: Not every food produced the expected pattern.
paras.zh: 并非所有食物都会产生预期的模式。

paras.en: Higher whole grain intake was associated with several unfavorable structural changes, including faster losses of grey matter and hippocampal volume, as well as faster ventricular enlargement.
paras.zh: 较高的全谷物摄入量与一些不利的结构变化有关，包括灰质和海马体积的更快损失，以及心室更快的扩大。

paras.en: Cheese showed the opposite pattern. Greater cheese intake was associated with slower declines in grey matter and hippocampal volume, less ventricular enlargement, and fewer white matter hyperintensities.
paras.zh: 奶酪则表现出相反的模式。摄入更多的奶酪与灰质和海马体积下降较慢、脑室扩大较少以及白质高信号较少有关。

paras.en: Benefits Appeared Stronger in Older Adults
paras.zh: 对老年人的好处似乎更大

paras.en: The overall associations remained consistent across several additional analyses and were stronger among older participants.
paras.zh: 在其他几项分析中，总体关联性保持一致，并且在老年参与者中更强。

paras.en: The researchers say this may suggest that the MIND diet could be especially relevant for people at greater risk of faster brain aging or those who show more variation in the pace of brain atrophy.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，这可能表明 MIND 饮食对于大脑老化速度更快的人或脑萎缩速度变化较大的人尤其重要。

paras.en: Stronger associations were also seen among participants who were more physically active and among those who were not overweight or obese.
paras.zh: 在身体活动较多的参与者以及不超重或肥胖的参与者中也发现了更强的关联。

paras.en: That pattern raises the possibility that combining a brain healthy diet with other healthy lifestyle habits could help reduce the risk of neurodegenerative disease, the researchers say.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，这种模式提出了将大脑健康饮食与其他健康生活习惯相结合有助于降低神经退行性疾病风险的可能性。

paras.en: The findings come from an observational study, so they cannot establish that the MIND diet directly caused the slower brain changes.
paras.zh: 这些发现来自一项观察性研究，因此他们无法确定 MIND 饮食直接导致大脑变化缓慢。

paras.en: The researchers also note that food frequency questionnaires rely on participants accurately remembering what they ate, which can introduce recall bias.
paras.zh: 研究人员还指出，食物频率调查问卷依赖于参与者准确记住他们吃了什么，这可能会引入回忆偏差。

paras.en: They were also unable to rule out mild cognitive impairment at the time of the first MRI scan, changes in diet over time, or the influence of genetic risk factors.
paras.zh: 他们也无法排除第一次 MRI 扫描时的轻度认知障碍、饮食随时间的变化或遗传风险因素的影响。

paras.en: Because the participants were predominantly White, the findings may not apply equally to people from other ethnic backgrounds.
paras.zh: 由于参与者主要是白人，因此研究结果可能不适用于其他种族背景的人。

paras.en: Still, the researchers conclude: "These findings reinforce the potential of the MIND diet as a brain-healthy dietary pattern and support its role in strategies aimed at slowing neurodegeneration in aging populations."
paras.zh: 尽管如此，研究人员得出的结论是：“这些发现增强了 MIND 饮食作为一种大脑健康饮食模式的潜力，并支持其在旨在减缓老龄化人群神经退行性变的策略中的作用。”

paras.en: Materials provided by BMJ Group. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由 BMJ Group 提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

Adherence to the MIND diet and longitudinal brain structural changes over a decade: evidence from the Framingham heart study offspring cohort. Journal of Neurology, Neurosurgery, 2026; 97 (6): 505 DOI: 10.1136/jnnp-2025-336957

articles.title: This light-powered AI can spot deepfakes with nearly 98% accuracy

paras.en: This light-powered AI can spot deepfakes with nearly 98% accuracy
paras.zh: 这种光驱动的人工智能可以以近 98% 的准确率识别深度赝品

paras.en: - Light Publishing Center, Changchun Institute of Optics, Fine Mechanics And Physics, CAS
paras.zh: - 中国科学院长春光机所光机出版中心

paras.en: - UCLA researchers built an AI system that uses light to analyze more than a dozen videos simultaneously, detecting deepfakes with nearly 98% accuracy. Its speed, low energy demands, and resistance to attacks could make it a powerful tool for screening the growing flood of AI-generated video.
paras.zh: - 加州大学洛杉矶分校的研究人员构建了一个 AI 系统，该系统使用光同时分析十多个视频，检测深度伪造的准确率接近 98%。它的速度快、能耗低、抗攻击能力强，可以使其成为筛选日益增多的人工智能生成视频的强大工具。

paras.en: Researchers at the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) have created a new optical-neural processor that uses light to help identify deepfake videos quickly and accurately. Unlike conventional systems that typically examine videos one after another using digital hardware, the UCLA technology can analyze 15 or more video streams at the same time.
paras.zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校 (UCLA) 的研究人员创建了一种新型光学神经处理器，可利用光帮助快速准确地识别深度伪造视频。与通常使用数字硬件逐个检查视频的传统系统不同，加州大学洛杉矶分校的技术可以同时分析 15 个或更多视频流。

paras.en: The key difference is that part of the detection process takes place through the physical propagation of light. This allows many videos to be evaluated simultaneously during a single optical pass rather than requiring each one to move separately through a conventional digital processing pipeline.
paras.zh: 主要区别在于部分检测过程是通过光的物理传播进行的。这允许在单次光路过程中同时评估许多视频，而不需要每个视频单独通过传统的数字处理管道。

paras.en: The technology is detailed in the study "Scalable, Energy-Efficient Optical-Neural Architecture for Multiplexed Deepfake Video Detection," published in eLight. The researchers designed the optical AI system to serve as a high-throughput, attack-resilient first layer of defense for screening large amounts of manipulated and AI-generated video.
paras.zh: 该技术在 eLight 发表的研究“用于多路复用 Deepfake 视频检测的可扩展、节能的光学神经架构”中进行了详细介绍。研究人员设计了光学人工智能系统，作为高吞吐量、抗攻击的第一层防御，用于筛选大量被操纵和人工智能生成的视频。

paras.en: The Growing Challenge of Deepfake Detection
paras.zh: Deepfake 检测日益严峻的挑战

paras.en: Rapid improvements in generative AI have made synthetic videos increasingly realistic, increasing the need for detection systems that are both accurate and capable of operating at large scale.
paras.zh: 生成式人工智能的快速改进使合成视频变得越来越真实，增加了对既准确又能够大规模运行的检测系统的需求。

paras.en: Many advanced deepfake detectors depend on enormous amounts of digital computation. A single analysis can require hundreds of billions of floating-point operations, and videos are often processed sequentially. As more content must be checked, both the processing time and energy requirements can rise proportionally.
paras.zh: 许多先进的深度换脸检测器都依赖于大量的数字计算。一次分析可能需要数千亿次浮点运算，并且视频通常是按顺序处理的。随着必须检查的内容越来越多，处理时间和能源需求也会成比例增加。

paras.en: Digital detection systems face another problem. Attackers can deliberately alter fake videos in subtle ways designed to confuse a detector and make manipulated footage appear authentic.
paras.zh: 数字检测系统面临另一个问题。攻击者可以故意以微妙的方式改变虚假视频，旨在迷惑探测器并使操纵的视频看起来真实。

paras.en: Professor Aydogan Ozcan and his UCLA team developed a hybrid digital-optical system intended to address both challenges.
paras.zh: Aydogan Ozcan 教授和他的加州大学洛杉矶分校团队开发了一种混合数字光学系统，旨在解决这两个挑战。

paras.en: A lightweight digital encoder first collects compact information about each video, including spatial, spectral, and temporal features. That information is transformed into a phase pattern and displayed on a programmable spatial light modulator.
paras.zh: 轻量级数字编码器首先收集每个视频的紧凑信息，包括空间、光谱和时间特征。该信息被转换成相位图案并显示在可编程空间光调制器上。

paras.en: The resulting optical wavefront then travels through a free-space-based, passive optical decoder. At the other end, paired optical detectors directly produce an authenticity score for each video.
paras.zh: 然后产生的光学波前穿过基于自由空间的无源光学解码器。在另一端，成对的光学探测器直接为每个视频生成真实性分数。

paras.en: In effect, the system replaces a computationally demanding digital decoding network with a physical process that can handle many streams in parallel.
paras.zh: 实际上，该系统用可以并行处理多个流的物理过程取代了计算要求较高的数字解码网络。

paras.en: Nearly 98% Accuracy Across 15 Videos at Once
paras.zh: 一次性处理 15 个视频的准确率接近 98%

paras.en: In experiments using visible light, the processor examined 15 Celeb-DF videos simultaneously during each optical pass.
paras.zh: 在使用可见光的实验中，处理器在每次光传输过程中同时检查 15 个 Celeb-DF 视频。

paras.en: It achieved an average detection accuracy of 97.79%, along with a sensitivity of 99.86% and a specificity of 95.72%. Sensitivity measures how successfully the system identifies manipulated videos, making the particularly high sensitivity important for a screening tool designed to keep fake content from slipping through.
paras.zh: 它的平均检测准确度为 97.79%，灵敏度为 99.86%，特异性为 95.72%。灵敏度衡量系统识别被操纵视频的成功程度，因此对于旨在防止虚假内容漏网的筛选工具来说，特别高的灵敏度非常重要。

paras.en: The 99.86% sensitivity translated to an average false-negative rate of ~0.14%. In other words, only a very small fraction of manipulated videos were incorrectly classified as authentic.
paras.zh: 99.86% 的敏感性转化为~0.14% 的平均假阴性率。换句话说，只有极小一部分经过处理的视频被错误地归类为真实视频。

paras.en: The researchers also pushed the system further by increasing its capacity to 18 videos in a single optical pass. Even at that level, average detection accuracy remained at 96.13%.
paras.zh: 研究人员还进一步推动了该系统的发展，将单次光路的容量增加到 18 个视频。即使在这个水平上，平均检测准确率仍保持在 96.13%。

paras.en: The team found that the processor could also become more capable by increasing the physical depth of its passive optical decoder without substantially increasing energy use or inference latency.
paras.zh: 该团队发现，通过增加无源光学解码器的物理深度，处理器也可以变得更强大，而不会显着增加能源消耗或推理延迟。

paras.en: When researchers added two optimized passive diffractive layers while testing more difficult deepfake manipulations, detection accuracy improved by ~6.8%.
paras.zh: 当研究人员在测试更困难的 Deepfake 操作时添加两个优化的被动衍射层时，检测精度提高了约 6.8%。

paras.en: These phase-only diffractive layers can be manufactured as passive, static optical structures/surfaces. They perform additional calculations through the diffraction of light, meaning they do not require additional electrical power while the system is performing an inference.
paras.zh: 这些纯相位衍射层可以被制造为无源静态光学结构/表面。它们通过光的衍射执行额外的计算，这意味着它们在系统执行推理时不需要额外的电力。

paras.en: That approach could allow more sophisticated processing without the same energy costs that typically accompany larger digital neural networks.
paras.zh: 这种方法可以实现更复杂的处理，而无需像大型数字神经网络那样消耗相同的能源成本。

paras.en: Testing the System Against Google VEO-3 Videos
paras.zh: 针对 Google VEO-3 视频测试系统

paras.en: The researchers did not limit their experiments to conventional face swapping deepfakes. They also challenged the processor with videos produced using Google's VEO-3 model.
paras.zh: 研究人员并没有将他们的实验局限于传统的换脸深度假货。他们还用使用 Google 的 VEO-3 模型制作的视频对处理器提出了挑战。

paras.en: Newer generative AI systems can create footage that lacks many of the obvious artifacts associated with earlier deepfake technology, making them a more difficult target for detectors trained primarily on older forms of manipulation.
paras.zh: 较新的生成式人工智能系统可以创建缺乏许多与早期深度造假技术相关的明显伪影的镜头，这使得它们成为主要接受旧式操作训练的探测器更难以瞄准的目标。

paras.en: With only minimal fine-tuning, the optical processor achieved 94.80% accuracy and 97.61% sensitivity on previously unseen VEO-3 videos during experiments.
paras.zh: 在实验过程中，仅进行最小程度的微调，光学处理器就对以前未见过的 VEO-3 视频实现了 94.80% 的准确度和 97.61% 的灵敏度。

paras.en: The results suggest that the approach could potentially adapt as generative AI technology continues to evolve.
paras.zh: 结果表明，随着生成式人工智能技术的不断发展，该方法可能会适应。

paras.en: A Deepfake Detector Designed to Be Harder to Fool
paras.zh: 旨在更难欺骗的 Deepfake 探测器

paras.en: The optical system also showed resistance to black-box adversarial attacks and provides inherent protection against white-box attacks.
paras.zh: 该光学系统还表现出对黑盒对抗攻击的抵抗力，并提供针对白盒攻击的固有保护。

paras.en: Part of that security comes from the way the detector physically performs its calculations. Because some of the inference process takes place through diffraction, important parameters of the optical model are effectively embedded within the hardware.
paras.zh: 这种安全性的一部分来自于探测器物理执行计算的方式。由于一些推理过程是通过衍射进行的，因此光学模型的重要参数被有效地嵌入到硬件中。

paras.en: Those parameters can be difficult for an attacker to measure, reproduce, or reverse engineer. That makes reconstructing the detector and designing carefully tailored adversarial changes that can evade it considerably more difficult.
paras.zh: 攻击者可能很难测量、复制或逆向工程这些参数。这使得重建探测器和设计精心定制的对抗性改变来逃避它变得更加困难。

paras.en: The processor also continued working reliably when videos were affected by image noise, blur, JPEG compression, and experimental misalignments. According to the researchers, those results illustrate how optical computation could provide a more secure and dependable foundation for some artificial intelligence systems.
paras.zh: 当视频受到图像噪声、模糊、JPEG 压缩和实验未对准的影响时，处理器也能继续可靠地工作。研究人员表示，这些结果说明了光学计算如何为某些人工智能系统提供更安全、更可靠的基础。

paras.en: A First Line of Defense Against Deepfakes
paras.zh: 抵御 Deepfake 的第一道防线

paras.en: Rather than replacing sophisticated digital detectors entirely, the UCLA processor is designed to work as a highly sensitive first stage of a larger detection system.
paras.zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校处理器不是完全取代复杂的数字探测器，而是被设计为大型探测系统的高灵敏度第一级。

paras.en: Massive volumes of video could initially pass through the parallel optical processor. Content identified as suspicious could then be sent to more computationally demanding digital models for a more detailed final assessment.
paras.zh: 大量视频最初可以通过并行光学处理器。然后，被识别为可疑的内容可以发送到计算要求更高的数字模型，以进行更详细的最终评估。

paras.en: Such a system could combine the strengths of both approaches. Optical processing could provide parallel operation, low decoder energy requirements, high sensitivity, resistance to adversarial attacks, and the ability to adapt to newer AI video generators, while conventional digital systems could provide deeper analysis when necessary.
paras.zh: 这样的系统可以结合两种方法的优点。光学处理可以提供并行操作、低解码器能量需求、高灵敏度、抵抗对抗性攻击以及适应更新的人工智能视频生成器的能力，而传统的数字系统可以在必要时提供更深入的分析。

paras.en: The researchers say this combination could eventually be useful for large-scale content moderation, media authentication, surveillance, and other security-critical AI applications.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，这种组合最终可能适用于大规模内容审核、媒体身份验证、监控和其他安全关键型人工智能应用。

paras.en: The authors of this work are Parnian Ghapandar Kashani and Dr. Shiqi Chen, who contributed equally, and Professor Aydogan Ozcan. The researchers are affiliated with the UCLA Electrical and Computer Engineering Department, the UCLA Bioengineering Department, and the California NanoSystems Institute.
paras.zh: 这项工作的作者是同等贡献的 Parnian Ghapandar Kashani 和 Shiqi Chen 博士以及 Aydogan Ozcan 教授。研究人员隶属于加州大学洛杉矶分校电气与计算机工程系、加州大学洛杉矶分校生物工程系和加州纳米系统研究所。

paras.en: Materials provided by Light Publishing Center, Changchun Institute of Optics, Fine Mechanics And Physics, CAS. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 资料由中国科学院长春光学精密机械与物理研究所轻工出版中心提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Parnian Ghapandar Kashani, Shiqi Chen, Aydogan Ozcan. Scalable, energy-efficient optical-neural architecture for multiplexed deepfake video detection. eLight, 2026; 6 (1) DOI: 10.1186/s43593-026-00143-y
paras.zh: - Parnian Ghapandar Kashani、Shiqi Chen、Aydogan Ozcan。用于多路复用深度伪造视频检测的可扩展、节能的光学神经架构。伊莱特，2026； 6 (1) DOI：10.1186/s43593-026-00143-y

articles.title: Agile Space Industries Expands Leadership Structure to Support Next Phase of Growth
articles.author: Agile Space Industries

paras.en: DURANGO, Colo., Sept. 28, 2026 – Agile Space Industries today announced that Jason Wright will join the company as President in early October, strengthening Agile’s operational leadership as the company continues its rapid growth as a supplier of in-space chemical propulsion products and services. Chris Pearson continues his role as Agile’s Chief Executive Officer.
paras.zh: 科罗拉多州杜兰戈，2026 年 9 月 28 日 – Agile Space Industries 今天宣布 Jason Wright 将于 10 月初加入公司担任总裁，随着该公司作为太空化学推进产品和服务供应商的持续快速发展，将加强 Agile 的运营领导力。 Chris Pearson 继续担任 Agile 首席执行官。

paras.en: Since 2022, Agile has experienced significant growth, with the company expected to reach approximately five times its 2022 revenue by the end of 2026. Today, Agile employs more than 165 people and operates across Colorado, Pennsylvania, Oklahoma, and Washington state. Growth has been driven primarily by increasing demand for the company’s monopropellant and bipropellant engines and propellant tanks, along with integrated propulsion subsystems and expanding propulsion testing services.
paras.zh: 自 2022 年以来，Agile 经历了显着增长，预计到 2026 年底，该公司的收入将达到 2022 年收入的约五倍。如今，Agile 拥有超过 165 名员工，业务遍及科罗拉多州、宾夕法尼亚州、俄克拉荷马州和华盛顿州。增长主要是由于对该公司的单组元推进剂和双组元推进剂发动机和推进剂罐的需求不断增长，以及集成推进子系统和不断扩大的推进测试服务推动的。

paras.en: As President, Wright will lead the day-to-day management of Agile’s business, with responsibility for operations across the company’s locations and delivery of current product and service contracts. He will also oversee near-term sales, marketing, and business development efforts supporting Agile’s existing products and programs.
paras.zh: 作为总裁，赖特将领导敏捷业务的日常管理，负责公司各地点的运营以及当前产品和服务合同的交付。他还将监督支持敏捷现有产品和计划的近期销售、营销和业务开发工作。

paras.en: “Agile has built tremendous momentum, and the opportunity in front of us continues to grow,” Pearson said. “Jason brings exactly the kind of propulsion, operational and program leadership experience we need as we focus on execution at greater scale for our customers. His experience leading complex propulsion operations and overseeing delivery for blue-chip space customers will be invaluable as we continue building out the company.”
paras.zh: “敏捷已经建立了巨大的势头，我们面前的机会继续增长，”皮尔森说。 “杰森带来的正是我们所需要的推进、运营和项目领导经验，因为我们专注于为客户提供更大规模的执行。随着我们继续发展公司，他领导复杂推进操作和监督蓝筹太空客户交付的经验将非常宝贵。”

paras.en: Wright brings more than 25 years of space industry experience spanning propulsion engineering, manufacturing, testing, operations, and program management. He previously served as a Lockheed Martin subject matter expert for monopropellant and bipropellant thrusters and dual-mode propulsion systems and held leadership positions in propulsion engineering, manufacturing, and testing. His experience also includes serving as operations director for a propulsion manufacturing center and managing programs with more than $100 million in profit-and-loss responsibility.
paras.zh: Wright 拥有超过 25 年的航天工业经验，涉及推进工程、制造、测试、运营和项目管理。他此前曾担任洛克希德·马丁公司的单组元推进剂和双组元推进剂推进器以及双模式推进系统主题专家，并在推进工程、制造和测试领域担任领导职务。他的经验还包括担任推进制造中心的运营总监以及管理损益超过 1 亿美元的项目。

paras.en: Throughout his career, Wright has supported programs and customers across the civil, defense, intelligence, and commercial space sectors, including NASA, the U.S. Air Force, U.S. Navy, U.S. Space Force, DARPA, the intelligence community, and commercial satellite operators.
paras.zh: 在他的整个职业生涯中，赖特一直为民用、国防、情报和商业航天领域的项目和客户提供支持，包括 NASA、美国空军、美国海军、美国太空军、DARPA、情报界和商业卫星运营商。

paras.en: “Agile’s innovative approach comes at an important time for the US and space industry at large, as increased launch availability creates new missions and growing demand for in-space propulsion,” Wright said. “My focus will be on driving operational excellence, meeting our commitments to customers and ensuring we can continue to respond rapidly to evolving propulsion needs as Agile grows.”
paras.zh: 赖特说：“敏捷的创新方法对美国和整个航天工业来说是一个重要时刻，因为发射可用性的增加创造了新的任务，并且对太空推进的需求不断增长。” “我的重点将是推动卓越运营，履行我们对客户的承诺，并确保我们能够随着敏捷的发展继续快速响应不断变化的推进需求。”

paras.en: With Wright overseeing day-to-day operations and near-term execution, Pearson will continue to lead Agile’s long-term strategy, board and investor relations, strategic business development, and technical direction.
paras.zh: 赖特负责监督日常运营和近期执行，皮尔逊将继续领导敏捷的长期战略、董事会和投资者关系、战略业务开发和技术方向。

paras.en: Wright’s appointment reflects Agile’s continued investment in the leadership and operational capabilities needed to support its next phase of growth and meet increasing demand for advanced in-space propulsion solutions.
paras.zh: 赖特的任命反映了敏捷公司对支持下一阶段增长和满足对先进太空推进解决方案日益增长的需求所需的领导力和运营能力的持续投资。

paras.en: Agile Space Industries develops advanced chemical propulsion solutions that enable spacecraft to move, maneuver, and operate in space. From early concepts to the high-rate production of flight hardware, Agile brings together propulsion expertise, additive manufacturing, and in-house testing to rapidly solve complex challenges and accelerate delivery. Agile partners with leading aerospace companies and the U.S. Government on spacecraft and launch vehicle programs. Learn more at agilespaceindustries.com.
paras.zh: Agile Space Industries 开发先进的化学推进解决方案，使航天器能够在太空中移动、机动和运行。从早期概念到飞行硬件的高速生产，Agile 汇集了推进专业知识、增材制造和内部测试，以快速解决复杂的挑战并加速交付。 Agile 与领先的航空航天公司和美国政府就航天器和运载火箭项目开展合作。请访问agilespaceindustries.com 了解更多信息。

articles.title: Space is everyone’s business: Economist Enterprise’s 4th annual Space Economy Summit returns to Orlando
articles.author: Economist Enterprise

paras.en: ORLANDO, FL — September 28th, 2026 — Space is rapidly becoming a practical business tool for industries far beyond aerospace, as satellite intelligence, resilient connectivity and other space-enabled technologies create new opportunities for growth, resilience and security on Earth.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州奥兰多 — 2026 年 9 月 28 日 — 随着卫星智能、弹性连接和其他太空技术为地球的增长、弹性和安全创造了新的机会，太空正在迅速成为航空航天以外行业的实用商业工具。

paras.en: Economist Enterprise’s 4th annual Space Economy Summit, taking place October 28–29, 2026, at the University of Central Florida in Orlando, will bring together senior leaders from government, space, investment and industries including telecommunications, agriculture, healthcare, mining, retail, finance and manufacturing.
paras.zh: 《经济学人》杂志第四届年度太空经济​​峰会将于 2026 年 10 月 28 日至 29 日在奥兰多中佛罗里达大学举行，来自政府、太空、投资和电信、农业、医疗保健、采矿、零售、金融和制造业等行业的高级领导人将齐聚一堂。

paras.en: The summit will examine how innovation in orbit can deliver measurable commercial and strategic value across the wider economy.
paras.zh: 峰会将探讨轨道创新如何在更广泛的经济领域带来可衡量的商业和战略价值。

paras.en: Bringing space-enabled technology to the industries that need it
paras.zh: 将太空技术引入有需要的行业

paras.en: The summit’s speaker line-up reflects the growing importance of space technology beyond the traditional aerospace sector.
paras.zh: 此次峰会的演讲嘉宾阵容反映了空间技术在传统航空航天领域之外日益增长的重要性。

paras.en: Speakers include Taylor Jordan, Assistant Secretary of Commerce for Environmental Observation and Prediction at NOAA and Director of the Office of Space Commerce; Gillian Bussey, Deputy Chief Science Officer at the US Space Force; Martine Rothblatt, Founder, Chairperson and Chief Executive of United Therapeutics; Srini Kalapala, Senior Vice-President and Chief Network Officer, Wireless, at Verizon; Feroz Sheikh, Group Chief Information and Digital Officer at Syngenta; and Jayesh Bhayani, Executive Vice-President and Senior Director of Technology at Tesco.
paras.zh: 演讲者包括美国国家海洋和大气管理局 (NOAA) 负责环境观测和预测的助理商务部长兼太空商务办公室主任泰勒·乔丹 (Taylor Jordan)； Gillian Bussey，美国太空军副首席科学官； Martine Rothblatt，联合治疗公司创始人、董事长兼首席执行官； Srini Kalapala，Verizon 无线高级副总裁兼首席网络官； Feroz Sheikh，先正达集团首席信息和数字官；以及 Tesco 执行副总裁兼高级技术总监 Jayesh Bhayani。

paras.en: The programme also features leaders from the Federal Communications Commission, United Nations Office for Outer Space Affairs, NASA, the International Space Station National Laboratory, Citi, BNY Mellon, Rio Tinto, Ford Motor Company and other organisations across the space and commercial ecosystem.
paras.zh: 该计划还邀请了来自美国联邦通信委员会、联合国外层空间事务办公室、美国宇航局、国际空间站国家实验室、花旗银行、纽约梅隆银行、力拓、福特汽车公司以及太空和商业生态系统中其他组织的领导人。

paras.en: Together, these perspectives will explore how space-enabled technologies can address challenges on Earth, from resilient communications and climate intelligence to supply-chain visibility, agricultural productivity, infrastructure monitoring and new approaches to healthcare and manufacturing.
paras.zh: 这些观点将共同探讨太空技术如何应对地球上的挑战，从弹性通信和气候情报到供应链可视性、农业生产力、基础设施监控以及医疗保健和制造的新方法。

paras.en: From promising pilots to commercial adoption
paras.zh: 从有希望的试点到商业采用

paras.en: As space technology becomes increasingly accessible, the summit will focus on the practical questions that determine whether innovation translates into commercial value.
paras.zh: 随着太空技术变得越来越容易获得，峰会将重点讨论决定创新是否转化为商业价值的实际问题。

paras.en: Discussions will examine customer demand, integration with legacy systems, procurement pathways, resilient supply chains and business models capable of delivering value beyond pilot projects.
paras.zh: 讨论将审查客户需求、与遗留系统的集成、采购途径、弹性供应链以及能够提供试点项目之外的价值的商业模式。

paras.en: The programme will also explore the next phase of the space economy, including direct-to-device connectivity, positioning, navigation and timing resilience, defence demand, commercial space stations, orbital computing, microgravity manufacturing and renewed interest in lunar exploration.
paras.zh: 该计划还将探索太空经济的下一阶段，包括直接到设备的连接、定位、导航和授时弹性、国防需求、商业空间站、轨道计算、微重力制造以及对月球探索的新兴趣。

paras.en: Commercial opportunity and strategic risk
paras.zh: 商业机会和战略风险

paras.en: The growing importance of space-enabled technology is accompanied by questions about regulation, geopolitical competition, orbital congestion, defence dependency, sustainability and commercial viability.
paras.zh: 太空技术的重要性与日俱增，同时也伴随着监管、地缘政治竞争、轨道拥堵、国防依赖、可持续性和商业可行性等问题。

paras.en: The summit will bring together policymakers, investors, space companies and end users to examine how governments and businesses can develop resilient, trusted and commercially sustainable space capabilities.
paras.zh: 此次峰会将汇集政策制定者、投资者、航天公司和最终用户，探讨政府和企业如何发展有弹性、值得信赖和商业可持续的航天能力。

paras.en: Alongside the main programme, the Space Economy Leaders Club will provide an invitation-only forum for 50 senior decision-makers with the influence, capital and operational responsibility to shape the future of the global space economy.
paras.zh: 除了主要活动外，太空经济领袖俱乐部还将为 50 名具有塑造全球太空经济未来影响力、资本和运营责任的高级决策者提供仅限邀请的论坛。

paras.en: The club will bring together chief executives, agency leaders, investors, policymakers, commercial space pioneers and strategic end users of space-enabled technologies for candid discussion and peer exchange.
paras.zh: 该俱乐部将汇集首席执行官、机构领导人、投资者、政策制定者、商业航天先驱和航天技术的战略最终用户，进行坦诚的讨论和同行交流。

paras.en: At the heart of America’s space ecosystem
paras.zh: 位于美国太空生态系统的核心

paras.en: Hosted at the University of Central Florida in Orlando, the summit is positioned within one of the United States’ most important commercial space corridors, connecting academic research, industry innovation and the wider Florida space economy.
paras.zh: 该峰会在奥兰多的中佛罗里达大学举办，位于美国最重要的商业太空走廊之一，将学术研究、行业创新和更广泛的佛罗里达太空经济联系起来。

paras.en: The Space Economy Summit will take place on October 28–29, 2026.
paras.zh: 太空经济峰会将于 2026 年 10 月 28 日至 29 日举行。

paras.zh: 欲了解更多信息并注册：https://econint.co/

articles.title: China launches Guowang, Yaogan-40 satellites, sets up busy Q4 manifest
articles.author: Andrew Jones

paras.en: HELSINKI — China completed its ninth and tenth launches of September, sending Guowang and Yaogan satellites into orbit, ahead of an intense finish to the year.
paras.zh: 赫尔辛基——中国在 9 月份完成了第九次和第十次发射，将“国王”号和“遥感”卫星送入轨道，为今年的紧张收官做好准备。

paras.en: A Long March 8A lifted off at 9:32 a.m. Eastern (1332 UTC) Sept. 23 from the Hainan commercial spacecraft launch site, carrying the 26th group of satellites for China’s Guowang national low Earth orbit satellite internet project. Less than a day later, a Long March 6A lifted off at 4:46 a.m. Eastern (0846 UTC) Sept. 24 from Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center with the fourth group of Yaogan-40 satellites.
paras.zh: 9月23日东部时间1332年上午9时32分，长征八号A运载火箭从海南商业航天发射场升空，搭载着中国国网国家低轨卫星互联网工程第26组卫星。不到一天后，长征六号甲运载火箭于9月24日东部时间凌晨4时46分（世界标准时间0846）从太原卫星发射中心升空，搭载第四组遥感四十号卫星。

paras.en: The pair of launches capped a September in which Chinese launchers flew at a pace that frequently saw multiple orbital missions within days, including four different rockets launching from three sites within 48 hours Sept. 15–16.
paras.zh: 这两次发射为9月份画上了圆满的句号，中国运载火箭的飞行速度经常在几天内执行多次轨道任务，其中包括9月15日至16日48小时内从三个地点发射的四枚不同的火箭。

paras.en: China Aerospace Science and Technology Corp. (CASC) stated the Guowang satellites had entered their planned orbits. The satellites were later tracked by U.S. Space Force in roughly circular 1,100-kilometer-altitude orbits inclined by 50 degrees. The batch was developed under the overall leadership of the China Academy of Space Technology (CAST), CASC’s main spacecraft maker, according to the corporation.
paras.zh: 中国航天科技集团公司（CASC）表示，国王卫星已进入预定轨道。这些卫星随后被美国太空军在大约 1,100 公里高、倾斜 50 度的圆形轨道上进行跟踪。据该公司称，这批产品是在中国航天科技集团公司主要航天器制造商中国空间技术研究院（CAST）的全面领导下研制的。

paras.en: Guowang is run by China SatNet, a state-owned enterprise established in 2021, and is planned to comprise around 13,000 satellites. The constellation uses satellites from multiple manufacturers and is launched on a range of Long March vehicles, with the Long March 8A, which debuted in February 2025, now launching regularly from Hainan’s commercial pads.
paras.zh: 国网由成立于 2021 年的国有企业中国卫星网运营，计划包含约 13,000 颗卫星。该星座使用多个制造商的卫星，并在一系列长征运载火箭上发射，其中长征八号甲于 2025 年 2 月首次亮相，现在定期从海南的商业发射场发射。

paras.en: The three Yaogan-40 (04) satellites will mainly be used for electromagnetic environment detection and related technology experiments, Xinhua reported, using boilerplate language typical of Yaogan launches. The satellites were also developed under CAST’s leadership.
paras.zh: 据新华社报道，三颗遥感四十（04）卫星将主要用于电磁环境探测和相关技术实验，使用遥感发射典型的样板语言。这些卫星也是在中国科协的领导下研制的。

paras.en: The satellites entered near polar orbits with altitudes of around 800 km, joining three earlier batches in similar orbits. Analysis by Integrity ISR indicates that the Yaogan-40 groups are placed into orbital planes separated by 72 degrees in right ascension of the ascending node, suggesting a fifth group will be needed to complete the constellation.
paras.zh: 这些卫星进入了高度约 800 公里的近极轨道，加入了类似轨道的早期三批卫星。 Integrity ISR 的分析表明，Yaogan-40 群被放置在升交点赤经中相距 72 度的轨道平面中，这表明需要第五个群来完成该星座。

paras.en: The Long March 6A, a kerosene-liquid oxygen core with solid boosters, is one of CASC’s main vehicles for both Yaogan and megaconstellation missions from Taiyuan. The rocket has now flown 27 times since its debut in March 2022, with all flights successfully reaching orbit, though the upper stage has experienced a number of breakup events after payload deployment.
paras.zh: 长征六号甲运载火箭是带有固体助推器的煤油液氧核心，是中国航天科技集团公司在太原执行遥感和巨型星座任务的主要运载工具之一。自 2022 年 3 月首次亮相以来，该火箭现已飞行 27 次，所有飞行均成功进入轨道，尽管上级在有效载荷部署后经历了多次解体事件。

paras.en: The pair of launches take China to 70 orbital launch attempts for 2026. With the country aiming to surpass 100 launches in a calendar year for the first time, the final quarter will see heavy activity. China launched 26 times in Q3, following 26 in Q2 and 18 in Q1, and would need to conduct at least 31 launches in Q4. The country’s annual launch schedule is typically backloaded with a greater number of launches later in the year.
paras.zh: 这两次发射使中国在 2026 年进行了 70 次轨道发射尝试。由于该国的目标是在一个日历年内首次超过 100 次发射，因此最后一个季度将出现大量活动。中国在第三季度发射了 26 次，继第二季度 26 次和第一季度 18 次之后，第四季度需要至少进行 31 次发射。该国的年度发射计划通常会在今年晚些时候进行更多的发射。

paras.en: One major mission will be Shenzhou-24. China’s next crewed mission now appears likely to launch around November, using a Long March 2F from Jiuquan. The crew is expected, though not officially confirmed, to include a Pakistani payload specialist, chosen from one of two Pakistan Air Force pilots in training at the Astronaut Center of China. The selected astronaut would become the first foreign astronaut to visit Tiangong.
paras.zh: 神舟二十四号将是一项重大任务。中国的下一次载人任务现在看来可能会在 11 月左右发射，使用的是酒泉的长征二号F。尽管尚未正式确认，机组人员预计将包括一名巴基斯坦有效载荷专家，他是从在中国宇航员中心接受训练的两名巴基斯坦空军飞行员中挑选的。入选的宇航员将成为第一位访问天宫的外国宇航员。

paras.en: A press conference a day ahead of the Shenzhou-24 launch may also provide updates or insights into the schedule for the first launch of the Mengzhou new generation spacecraft and the Long March 10A, both of which are related to China’s crewed lunar plans.
paras.zh: 神舟二十四号发射前一天的新闻发布会还可能提供孟州新一代飞船和长征十号甲首次发射时间表的最新情况或见解，这两者都与中国的载人登月计划有关。

paras.en: Possible debut launches include Orienspace’s Gravity-2, iSpace’s Hyperbola-3 with a first stage recovery attempt, and Zhihang-1 from Zenk Space, which earlier aimed for a launch in June. These would add to 2026 debuts including Tianlong-3 (April), Kinetica-2 (March), the Long March 12B (June), Long March 10B (July) and Pallas-1 (Sept. 1).
paras.zh: 可能的首次发射包括Orienspace的Gravity-2、iSpace的Hyperbola-3（进行第一阶段回收尝试）以及Zenk Space的Zhihang-1（其早些时候计划于6月发射）。这些将在 2026 年首次亮相的基础上增加，包括天龙三号（4 月）、动能二号（3 月）、长征十二号乙（六月）、长征十号乙（七月）和帕拉斯一号（九月 1 日）。

paras.en: Numerous launches for the Guowang and Qianfan constellations are expected. Other notable possible payloads in the coming months include Fengxing-1 on a Gravity-1 solid rocket, which could be China’s first commercial orbital transfer vehicle, from Future Space. Also expected are space computing payloads. The schedule for the planned debut flight of the Haolong reusable spaceplane for cargo to Tiangong from AVIC on a Zhuque-3 rocket from Landspace is currently unknown.
paras.zh: 国望星座和千帆星座预计将进行多次发射。未来几个月其他值得注意的可能有效载荷包括来自未来空间的重力一号固体火箭上的风行一号，这可能是中国第一个商业轨道转移飞行器。预计还有太空计算有效载荷。昊龙可重复使用航天飞机计划通过蓝箭朱雀三号火箭从中航工业飞往天宫的首次飞行时间表目前尚不清楚。

articles.title: Grand Final predictions as Warrington and Wakefield prepare to make history

paras.en: Super League Grand Final 2026: Pundit predictions as Warrington Wolves and Wakefield Trinity eye historic victory

The Sky Sports Rugby League pundits have made their calls on who they think win the Super League Grand Final in 2026; watch Warrington Wolves take on Wakefield Trinity in the Super League Grand Final on Saturday October 3, live on Sky Sports from 5pm
The Super League Grand Final 2026 is nearly here and the Sky Sports Rugby League pundits have had their say on how they think the biggest day of the season will unfold...
Who will win the Super League Grand Final 2026?
It is so difficult to pick and it is very much a 50/50, but I will go with Warrington. After a pretty scrappy performance in the semi-final, I believe they'll be much improved for the final.

Why is this particular final so special?
The final is special because we have teams that finished third and fourth battling it out at Old Trafford. That has never been done before.
I think Matty Ashton will pick up the Rob Burrow award. I fancy him for a long-range try this week.
Who will win the Super League Grand Final 2026?
Why is this particular final so special?
It feels special because this time of year we have always had one of the big guns in the final.
paras.zh: 这感觉很特别，因为每年的这个时候，我们总能在决赛中遇到一位强手。

paras.en: The Wakefield story feels special, Warrington's pain and remarkable 70-plus year wait can be put to bed. Two great stories, one new name on the trophy.
I think it will go to Wakefield's No 9 Tyson Smoothy.
paras.zh: 我认为韦克菲尔德的9号泰森·斯穆蒂将会获得冠军。

paras.en: Who will win the Super League Grand Final 2026?
I think this will be really close and there'll be plenty of nerves because neither club has won a Super League Grand Final.
It almost feels a shame one of them has to lose because seeing a new name on that trophy will be brilliant for the competition.
Why is this particular final so special?

Warrington are battle-hardened after a proper scrap at Headingley while Wakefield must be bouncing after what I'd call the biggest upset in Super League play-off history, beating the League Leaders 33-6 in their own backyard.
Getting to Old Trafford is the reward, but once you're there nobody remembers the runner-up. There's no nice way of losing a Grand Final.

The obvious names for the Rob Burrow award are George Williams and Max Jowitt. Ben Currie will be right in the mix and don't rule out one of Wakefield's big boppers Caius Faatili or Caleb Hamlin-Uele causing some damage.
paras.zh: 罗伯·伯罗奖的明显名字是乔治·威廉姆斯和马克斯·乔伊特。本·库里（Ben Currie）也将加入其中，并且不排除韦克菲尔德的大佬之一凯厄斯·法蒂利（Caius Faatili）或凯莱布·哈姆林-乌勒（Caleb Hamlin-Uele）造成一些伤害。

paras.en: Josh Thewlis is another young man made for the big stage but I keep coming back to Jack Sinfield. Sometimes the biggest stage finds the youngest star. If I was putting a pound on anyone, my pound would be on Jack.
Playing at Old Trafford on the day his dad delivers the match ball as well... you couldn't write it. Although knowing the Sinfields, they probably could.
paras.zh: 在老特拉福德球场比赛的那天，他的父亲也送出了比赛用球……你无法写出来。尽管他们了解辛菲尔德，但他们或许可以。

paras.en: Who will win the Super League Grand Final 2026?

I know this will be a very closely-matched final, but I have a feeling Wakefield finish off their fairytale and become the sixth-ever Super League winner. Just two seasons ago they were in the Championship, and now they are in the biggest match of them all.
paras.zh: 我知道这将是一场势均力敌的决赛，但我有一种感觉，韦克菲尔德将结束他们的童话，成为第六个超级联赛冠军。就在两个赛季前，他们还在英冠联赛中，而现在他们正处于最重要的一场比赛中。

paras.en: Their pack has been unbelievable in 2026 and I think that will prove the difference. They have put their side on the front foot and made the space for their backs to shine. If they win that battle like they have done so many times, then I expect party time in Wakefield on Sunday when they return!
paras.zh: 他们的表现在 2026 年令人难以置信，我认为这将证明与众不同。他们把侧身放在前脚上，为后背腾出空间。如果他们像之前多次那样赢得这场战斗，那么我预计他们回来后周日将在韦克菲尔德举行派对！

paras.en: Why is this particular final so special?
Simply put, we have never quite had a final like this before. For the first time, there is no Wigan, Leeds or St Helens.
It is a seismic moment for the sport and the latest signal that clubs, with the right backing and motivation, can get to the top.
paras.zh: 对于这项运动来说，这是一个震撼人心的时刻，也是俱乐部在正确的支持和动力下可以登上顶峰的最新信号。

paras.en: Warrington have been waiting 71 years for a trophy. Wakefield were relegated less than five years ago. These are two sides who know that history is on the line - one of them now needs to grasp it.
paras.zh: 沃灵顿为了一座奖杯已经等待了 71 年。韦克菲尔德不到五年前就降级了。这两方都知道历史已岌岌可危——其中一方现在需要抓住它。

paras.en: I love the story of it so I think Jack Sinfield wins. Imagine the scenes - Sir Kevin Sinfield delivers the match ball as his son plays in his first Grand Final and then he wins the trophy named after the person who has inspired his father to raise millions for the MND community.
paras.zh: 我喜欢这个故事，所以我认为杰克·辛菲尔德获胜。想象一下这样的场景：凯文·辛菲尔德爵士在儿子第一次参加总决赛时送出了比赛用球，然后他赢得了以激励他父亲为 MND 社区筹集数百万美元的人命名的奖杯。

paras.en: Sport has a funny way of doing things that are too beautiful to be believable.
paras.zh: 体育运动以一种有趣的方式做事，美得令人难以置信。

paras.en: Who will win the Super League Grand Final 2026?
paras.zh: 2026年中超总决赛谁将获胜？

paras.en: Why is this particular final so special?
paras.zh: 为什么这场特殊的决赛如此特别？

paras.en: History is guaranteed. Wakefield Trinity will play in their first Grand Final, while Warrington will be hoping to win the Super League title for the first time.
paras.zh: 历史是有保证的。韦克菲尔德三一队将首次参加总决赛，而沃灵顿队则希望首次赢得超级联赛冠军。

paras.en: It's being played on the same weekend as the NRL Grand Final, which I'm a huge fan of. Also, Sir Kevin Sinfield will complete his latest 7 in 7 challenge at Old Trafford before kick-off, presenting the match ball. Also, the fact his son Jack is part of the Wakefield team. Either Max Jowitt or George Williams will get the fairy tale. Daryl Powell against his old club. So many stories! I could go on.
paras.zh: 它与 NRL 总决赛在同一个周末举行，我是 NRL 的超级粉丝。此外，凯文·辛菲尔德爵士将在开球前在老特拉福德完成他最新的七中七挑战，并展示比赛用球。此外，他的儿子杰克也是韦克菲尔德队的一员。马克斯·乔伊特或乔治·威廉姆斯都会得到这个童话故事。达里尔鲍威尔对阵他的老东家。这么多故事！我还可以继续说下去。

paras.en: How to watch the Super League Grand Final
paras.zh: 如何观看中超总决赛

paras.en: The Super League Grand Final takes place at Old Trafford on Saturday October 3, live on Sky Sports Main Event and Sky Sports+.
paras.zh: 超级联赛总决赛将于 10 月 3 日星期六在老特拉福德举行，天空体育主赛事和天空体育+直播。

paras.en: The match will take place at 6pm, with coverage on Sky Sports from 5pm.
paras.zh: 比赛将于下午 6 点举行，天空体育从下午 5 点开始报道。

articles.title: 'They'll be hating each other!' - Nelson: Don’t let AJ and Fury smiles fool you!

paras.en: Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua: Johnny Nelson says 'don't let smiles fool you - they'll be hating each other!'

Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua will finally settle their rivalry in British heavyweight blockbuster at Principality Stadium in Cardiff on Friday December 11; Fury and Joshua traded taunts at 'friendly' first press conference in London; Sky Sports Boxing's Johnny Nelson shares his thoughts
Anthony Joshua and Tyson Fury's smiles and respect will be replaced by a boiling rivalry when their fight gets closer, says Sky Sports Boxing's Johnny Nelson.
The British heavyweight rivals traded a few taunts but also shared words of mutual respect at their long-awaited first press conference in London on Wednesday evening.

But Sky Sports expert Nelson believes their first media meeting was just a "soft launch" and expects real animosity to appear ahead of their blockbuster battle in Cardiff on December 11, penning his thoughts below...

"I think after all these years of all the back-and-forth and Tyson calling him every name under the sun and AJ being super cool and Eddie Hearn saying what he's saying, I thought when they sat in front of each other on Wednesday, if I'm honest - maybe I got taken away with all the hype - but I thought there was really going to be a real ruckus.
"But they were like a couple of businessmen that went there to say: 'Right, we're going to tick all the boxes.'
"I'm quite sure, as the weeks roll on, you can compare it to a 100-metre sprint.

"It's 10 weeks to go, so this first week, it's niceties. I think as we get to 20 metres down the line, it will get a bit tighter and tighter, and then by the time we're at 50 metres, these guys will be champing at the bit, hating on each other. That's probably what they have to do.
"I think the public might have been a little subdued Wednesday because of all the back-and-forth they've seen previously. So they thought: 'Let's see if this is for real.'
"The build-up to this fight as the weeks roll on, the words will get worse. Tyson's potty mouth will get in the way and things will be said, litigation and threats and everything.
"Even up until the first bell goes, it is going to be drama. This is what this fight's got written all over it.
"So that was a soft launch of what to expect.
"I think the smiling shocked everybody. Only because, as I said, of what we've seen in the build-up and everything.
"It's like a kettle boiling and thinking: 'Right, they're finally in the room together.' For the first time we've seen them head-to-head, these guys were just grown up.

"They were boys, now they're men. They've got children, they've got responsibilities. So now they probably conduct themselves a little better, but they'll turn back into boys again as it gets closer to the fight.
"I do expect Fury to come out and have a tear-up. The last person he said that about was Deontay Wilder, and he did.
"I know Tyson Fury thinks Anthony Joshua isn't good going backwards.

"I don't think Joshua wants this fight to go the distance where it depends on Fury's boxing skills, because boxing Fury is like trying to hit with a bag of rice, so I'd be very surprised if the fight went past five rounds.
"There'll be rocks, people will be hitting the canvas; it's going to be absolute drama.
'Both are past their prime - fight should have happened five years ago'
"I do think they're both past their prime.
"I've always been an AJ fan. I've always thought AJ would do him, but looking at the last fight of both fighters, the one that's got a little more left is Fury. AJ looked vulnerable.
"He looked susceptible. He looked like he could be hurt. And Tyson may not look as sharp and on point as he did 10 years ago, as he did when he boxed Wilder the first time.

"These guys are a lot older but it's whose style suits an older age. Fury's style suits the older age, whereas Joshua's style, if you don't hit him, he's going to hit you and take you out. So I have to say, it leans towards Fury at this stage in their careers.
"But they're getting paid handsomely. They're going to put their lives, their reputations, their bragging rights on the line.
"It's going to be so hard for these two to walk the streets and everybody and their dog will be talking about the fight, putting it on them, saying good luck.
"I can imagine at the Principality Stadium on fight night, the noise, two o'clock in the morning, it's going to be such an atmosphere. It's going to be a great story.
"I would say at least five years ago is when this fight should have happened.
"Five years ago, they were both mature, in their prime and good and ready to go.
"Now we've seen the decline of these fighters and it's not unfair to say that. We've seen better performances from both fighters.
"Five years ago, these two getting in the ring together, you would have had two young, hungry warriors that wanted more.
"Now I think it's more of a business transaction that will turn personal as it goes on. This is more business than pleasure.

"The fight will go on and it's a shame, but at least we're getting it. At least the fans are going to see it. At least the place is going to be packed out. Everybody will be watching this fight because there's been a 10-year build-up to it.
"In terms of who wins, I'm leaning more towards Fury.
"I'm going to get some calls from my friends. I know I'm an AJ fan but you've got to say what you see.
"And I think this time suits Fury all the way through."

articles.title: U.S. pressures European allies to release diesel reserves as Trump considers export ban
articles.author: Steve Kopack

paras.en: The Trump administration ramped up a pressure campaign Thursday to persuade European allies to release diesel from national emergency stockpiles. The White House says additional diesel from Europe would increase global supplies and potentially keep a lid on soaring prices.
The average U.S. price of diesel has soared by 70% since the war with Iran began, hitting $6.38 per gallon Thursday, according to AAA.
Less than five weeks before the U.S. midterm elections, Republicans are eager for any way to lower domestic fuel prices.

“Our European partners should accelerate delivery on their existing commitments and make additional supplies immediately available to address ongoing disruptions” to energy markets, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Thursday on X. “American farmers, truckers, and businesses should not be left carrying the burden of a global diesel shortage.”
Shortly after Bessent’s post, Trump told reporters “we may” request that Europe release some of its emergency reserves.
Earlier this week, U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright had appeared confident that Europe would agree to tap its reserves.

“You will hear announcements from our friends in Europe about new diesel supplies that’ll come to the market that’ll meaningfully push diesel prices down,” Wright told reporters Wednesday at an event with Trump in the Oval Office.
But as of Thursday evening, those announcements hadn’t materialized.

U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said he raised the diesel issue at a G20 trade ministers meeting in Milwaukee this week. But he did not suggest that Washington had gotten any firm commitments about emergency reserves.
“We’d love to have a collaborative response” to the global diesel crunch, he told Bloomberg News on Thursday.
Also in Milwaukee were trade ministers from China, India, the United Kingdom and other countries that have been affected by strained global diesel supplies.
So far, however, the message coming from Europe on diesel reserves is a noncommittal one.
The E.U. is “in very close contact with our member states on this ongoing issue,” European Commission energy spokesperson Anna-Kaisa Itkonen told reporters at a media briefing in Brussels.
“We are also having high-level contacts ongoing with the U.S. administration,” she said.

The majority of Europe’s emergency diesel reserves are stored in Germany and France. Both American and European oil refineries have been running at near full capacity for months, churning out as much diesel fuel as possible.

While the Iran war is responsible for the lion’s share of price increases in crude oil and unleaded gasoline around the world, the price of diesel has been outpacing both of them since July, albeit for a different reason.
Russia has traditionally been a major exporter of diesel, but that stopped this summer after Ukrainian drone strikes destroyed Russian refineries.
On July 8, Russia banned the export of diesel in order to preserve its domestic supply. On Wednesday, the Kremlin extended that ban until the end of October.

“We’re tight on diesel because we’ve lost diesel exports from Russia,” Wright said at the White House. “We’ve lost diesel, some diesel exports from the Middle East, although we’re restoring those. And we’ve lost diesel exports from China.”
“That’s a lot of interruptions,” he said.

But whether Europe will tap its emergency reserves of diesel to increase global supply is complicated by the fact that the Trump administration is actively considering a move that is effectively the opposite of what it is asking Europe to do.
On Wednesday, the president mused about imposing a ban on exports of U.S. diesel.
“I’m thinking about it,” Trump told reporters in the Oval Office. “I speak to Chris and Doug about it a lot,” he said, referring to Wright and Interior Secretary Doug Burgum.
“They sort of think ... it’ll help diesel, but it might raise the price of other things,” he said.
An export ban on U.S. diesel would hit European countries particularly hard.
It would also land at a moment when average U.S. prices for unleaded gas remain almost 50% higher than they were on Feb. 28, the day the U.S. and Israel attacked Iran.

articles.title: Queensland police seize 558 e-mobility devices in three months
articles.author: Jason Dasey

paras.en: Queensland Police seize more than 500 e-mobility devices and issue 2,300 fines in three months
Police across Queensland have given out more than 2,400 traffic infringement notices to e-mobility device users in the last three months, seizing 558 non-compliant vehicles.
Of the fines issued, more than 60 per cent were for riders failing to wear a helmet, while 157 users were caught speeding.
Queensland Police are urging the community to review new e-mobility laws on their website, including changes that came into effect at the end of August.

articles.title: Bluebottles the size of a fist wash up on Gold Coast beaches
articles.author: Gemma Sapwell

paras.en: Bluebottles up to three times the usual size are washing ashore on the Gold Coast.
Scientists say little is known about the larger species' venom potency.
Lifeguards have reported relatively few stings: 20 across 39 patrolled beaches during the school holidays.
Bluebottles up to three times larger than those typically seen in Queensland waters are washing ashore on the Gold Coast, but scientists say little is known about the potency of their venom.
Griffith University marine ecologist Kylie Pitt said Physalia megalista was one of the biggest of five bluebottle species found in Australian waters.
"It doesn't turn up on the Gold Coast beaches all that often. They're usually further south," she said.
"But we don't have a lot of data about when and where they turn up."
Professor Pitt estimated the species' float or sail, which sits on the water's surface, was about 10 centimetres in length, while its stinger could stretch several metres.
"It is quite likely that the different species have got slightly different venom," she said.
"In terms of the way people react, it is dependent on the dose they get and the dose depends on the amount of tentacle that's attached to the skin."
Gold Coast City Council lifeguard supervisor Scott Franzmann said despite the busy school holidays, the impact had been relatively minor, with 20 stings reported across 39 patrolled beaches.
"It's a little bit early for bluebottles at this stage," he said.
"We don't get them until about December, January, around that Christmas period."
Gold Coast resident Tera Jesperson said she saw bluebottles the size of a fist "all over the shoreline".
"It's quite scary because our dog was going up and sniffing them," she said.
"I don't want to be stung — I never have and never want to be."
The Australian Marine Stinger Advisory Service describes bluebottle stings as "instant and sharp" but not life-threatening.
The Royal Australian College of General Practitioners recommends removing any tentacles off the skin with gloves or tweezers before washing the sting with seawater.

Professor Pitt said researchers only concluded last year that five different bluebottle species existed, with the survival of larger stingers potentially assisted by warmer El Niño conditions this season.
"The sail of the bluebottle can be offset either to the left or the right of the body's axis," she said.
"It's like having a yacht sailing on two different tacks — you'll get some more commonly deposited on beaches under north-easterlies or some more commonly deposited under north-westerlies."
Gold Coast resident Mark Wallace said he had seen similar large bluebottles further south when he was a beach inspector at Manly, Sydney.
"We could always tell when they'd come in because you'd hear a scream," he said.
"I don't know what the phenomenon is, but there must be something."

articles.title: What happened in Tennessee's failed execution of Christa Pike and what comes next?
articles.author: Jillian Kestler-D'Amours

paras.en: What happened in Tennessee's failed execution of Christa Pike and what comes next?
It remains unclear why execution failed after observers say Pike was given two doses of lethal injections
Christa Pike was to be the first woman executed in the U.S. state of Tennessee in 200 years.

But the 50-year-old, who was convicted of killing a classmate at age 18, survived two doses of lethal injections after what media observers and experts say was a "very rare" and "unprecedented" failed execution on Wednesday.
Pike's case had drawn widespread national attention as her lawyers and supporters tried to secure a stay of execution, citing her age at the time of the crime and a history of severe childhood abuse.
Her execution was delayed by several hours after a U.S. appeals court ordered a stay pending a legal review of Pike's abuse claims, but the Supreme Court ultimately ruled it could proceed.
- After day of delays, witnesses say Tennessee unable to carry out execution of Christa Pike
- Tennessee governor orders outside review after death row inmate Christa Pike survives execution attempt

Austin Sarat, a professor at Amherst College in Massachusetts and an expert on the death penalty, said about eight per cent of lethal injections in the U.S. have been "botched," meaning something went wrong during the procedure, but the person nevertheless died.
But "what happened to Christa Pike was not a botched execution; it was a failed execution, and it's very rare," Sarat told CBC News in an interview Thursday.
"In Pike's case, insofar as we know it, the pentobarbital — the lethal drugs — had started to flow and had reached her body. That puts us in uncharted territory."
Here's what we know about what happened and what comes next.
The southern U.S. state administers pentobarbital, a barbiturate, in lethal injections.

According to the Tennessee Department of Correction's lethal injection protocol, in effect since last year and shared online by the non-profit Death Penalty Information Center, the state administers 100 millilitres of pentobarbital (for a total of 5 grams).
"If the inmate is not deceased" after that, then a second dose is given to the person, the protocol states. There is nothing in the protocol about what to do if the second lethal dose fails.
The execution had been scheduled for 10 a.m. local time Wednesday but was delayed until the evening due to legal appeals.

Catherine Sweeney, a health reporter at WPLN News, said Wednesday that Pike had been given two separate rounds of pentobarbital but was still breathing when she and the other media witnesses were told to leave.

"It was very ragged. She lifted her head up and was looking around at one point. She said that there was a spot that was burning and hurting, and asked if that was normal," Sweeney said during a news conference.
"None of it was normal," she added. "I covered all the executions last year and most of the ones this year. We haven't seen anything like it. It went really poorly."
Another media witness, Tori Gessner of Nashville's WKRN, gave a timeline of events:
- 6:41 p.m.: Members of the media go into a separate room to witness the execution.
- 7:26 p.m.: Curtains open and Pike says her "last words."
- 7:34 p.m.: Pike says "my arm feels like it's about to burst open." Her spiritual adviser is with her. She's talking and starts "breathing, moaning, snoring."
- 7:46 p.m.: Curtains close; media witnesses can still hear Pike "breathing and snoring."
- 7:49 p.m.: Curtains reopen; "She's snoring very loudly at that point."
- 8:05 p.m.: Curtains close again; "We could still hear her audibly snoring."
- 8:53 p.m.: The microphone is cut off and media witnesses are escorted out of the room.
"Nothing about today was normal, typical — at all," Gessner told reporters.

Corinna Lain, chair of law at the University of Richmond in Virginia who has written extensively about lethal injection in the U.S., outlined three possibilities: The drug may have been degraded; the IV may have come out of Pike's vein, sending the injection into her bodily tissue; or Pike's body simply may not have reacted as expected.
But Lain stressed that "we don't know" for sure, and "that's part of the problem."
"This entire thing is covered in secrecy and it's quite perverse that the state at its most powerful moment — at the apex of its power — is killing people under a veil of secrecy," she told CBC News.
In a news release late Wednesday, the Tennessee Department of Correction said it followed the state's execution protocol.

"The lethal injection chemical in the protocol has consistently been effective, and the protocol does not allow for additional procedures beyond what was carried out this evening. Christa Pike has been transported to an off-site medical facility."
Asked for more information about why the execution failed and on Pike's current condition, the department told CBC News in an email that it had no further comment beyond its earlier statement.
One of Pike's lawyers, Randy Spivey, told reporters on Thursday that she was alive and receiving "life-saving medical care." But he said her exact condition remained unknown.
"We at this point do not know the ramifications of the chemical torture that she has endured," he said. Her lawyers called for Pike's death sentence to be commuted.
Will Tennessee try to execute Pike again?
That also remains unclear, but Lain said the state can try again, as per a 1947 U.S. Supreme Court decision issued after an inmate survived his execution by electric chair.

Tennessee Gov. Bill Lee on Wednesday said he ordered a "comprehensive, third-party review" of Pike's execution. "Therefore, the remaining scheduled execution will not be carried out this year," he said in a statement, as reported by AP.
A spokesperson for the governor did not immediately respond to CBC News' emailed questions about whether the state would try to execute Pike again, and if so, when.
In May, Lee granted a one-year reprieve to another death row inmate, Tony Von Carruthers, after his execution was called off when officers failed to find a vein to administer the lethal injection.
But Sarat at Amherst College said while Pike's case raises a legal issue, it also involves a "simple matter of human decency."

"The government when it kills, or tries to kill, has an obligation to get it right. If it fails, it doesn't get another chance," he said. "One bite at the apple. That should be the norm, and Christa Pike should never have to face this horror again."

articles.title: Putin warns West not to escalate, claims concerns about Russia's Kaliningrad region

paras.en: Putin warns West not to escalate, claims concerns about Russia's Kaliningrad region
If attacked, Putin says Russia willing to deploy 'all the weapons at our country's disposal'

Russian President Vladimir Putin said Thursday that the world was living through a dangerous moment and warned the West not to escalate a standoff over Ukraine by threatening the Russian exclave of Kaliningrad, which Moscow has made clear it would defend with nuclear weapons if necessary.

Putin, who has said Russia had no choice but to launch its full-scale invasion of Ukraine to safeguard its security, said Russia had no plans to attack any European country and wanted to coexist peacefully.

But he reiterated that Moscow would resort to all weapons in its arsenal, including nuclear ones, if its most westernmost territory — Kaliningrad, wedged between Poland and Lithuania — were threatened.

"If it comes to a direct attack on the Russian Federation — in this case, we are referring to Kaliningrad, and perhaps other territories as well — the question of the Russian Federation deploying all the weapons at our country's disposal will, of course, inevitably and immediately be on the agenda," Putin told the Valdai Forum of international Russia experts in Moscow.
Putin said Russia realized it would be facing "an enemy (NATO) twice our size."

"And we will have to make use of our competitive advantages in this struggle. Yes, of course, France and Britain are nuclear powers — we understand that perfectly well and are fully aware of it," he said. "But no one else possesses the kind of weapons that Russia has today. That is our competitive advantage."

Putin's comments followed a diplomatic note that NATO said this week it had received from Russia, warning the Western military alliance Moscow would be ready to resort to nuclear weapons if NATO attempted to cut off Russia's Baltic exclave.

Russia's warning highlighted Moscow's urgent concern over what it has portrayed as a growing NATO threat to Kaliningrad, a heavily militarized Russian territory slightly larger than the U.S. state of Connecticut. NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte said the alliance responded by emphasizing that it is defensive alliance and that nuclear threats are not helpful.

Relations, already dire since Putin's decision to send troops into Ukraine in 2022, have worsened this year, with European governments accusing Moscow of stepping up a "hybrid war" on the continent through acts including sabotage and arson.
Russia denies those allegations and rejects repeated statements by Western politicians that it is preparing for a possible military attack on a NATO country.
Putin warned that cycles of escalation in international conflict could quickly lead to dangerous scenarios.

"We must realize that the moment when nothing can be changed any longer may come very quickly and unexpectedly for everyone. The logic of escalating, increasingly harsh retaliatory measures leads to a fatal point of no return," he said.

"At the heart of this escalation lie arrogance and overconfidence. This is a path to the brink of the abyss. All the more so today, when the arsenals of the world's leading powers contain weapons capable of destroying all life or, at the very least, reducing the Earth to a catastrophic state," Putin said.
"Can we be certain that these weapons will never be used? Well, of course not. We must bear this in mind and avoid such an outcome."

Putin, who said he was ready for a trilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and U.S. President Donald Trump if a proper agenda were worked out first, ruled out stopping Russian strikes on Ukrainian targets in the Black Sea region. He also acknowledged that Ukrainian strikes on oil refineries across Russia had cost the country one per cent of its gross domestic product (GDP).
He said Russia was now responding to Ukraine in kind.

But while he portrayed Western assistance to Kyiv in launching deep strikes inside Russia as a future threat, he said Moscow was not planning to attack European arms factories supplying Ukraine "tomorrow."

articles.title: New York's governor removes district attorney from Cornell rape allegations case, appoints special prosecutor

paras.en: New York's governor removes district attorney from Cornell rape allegations case, appoints special prosecutor
Gov. Kathy Hochul signs executive order appointing office of N.Y. attorney general as special prosecutor
WARNING: This article may affect those who have experienced sexual violence or know someone affected by it.

New York Gov. Kathy Hochul appointed a special prosecutor Thursday to oversee an investigation into a woman's allegations that she was gang raped at a Cornell University fraternity house, with the governor saying she had lost faith in the local district attorney's ability to handle the case.
Hochul said she had signed an executive order appointing the office of New York Attorney General Letitia James as the special prosecutor.

"Newly released information continues to raise serious questions about the investigation conducted by the Cornell Police Department and the decision by the Tompkins County District Attorney not to prosecute an alleged sexual assault on Cornell University's campus in October 2024," Hochul said in a statement.
"This has, in turn, undercut my faith, and the public's faith, in the District Attorney's ability to effectively investigate and prosecute the case at this time."
Hochul said the attorney general would oversee the investigation and, if warranted, present evidence to a grand jury.
"The young woman at the center of this case deserves to know that every fact will be examined and justice pursued," Hochul said.
"This action will ensure that the matter is fully and thoroughly investigated without conflict or bias, and handled independently with the rigor that this matter demands."
A message left for Tompkins County District Attorney Matthew Van Houten was not immediately returned late Thursday.
New information about the alleged 2024 assault, the university's response and the lack of criminal charges at the time has been disclosed over the last week since a lawsuit was filed last month.
The woman, identified only as Jane Doe in court documents, reported the alleged assault to campus police, discussed it with the university's internal investigators and filed a lawsuit in September.

The lawsuit names seven fraternity brothers, the university, the Chi Phi fraternity and others. It alleges that one of the men sent a social media message to more than 50 other fraternity members alerting them to what was happening and inviting people to take part.

Lawyers for two of the men she is suing have denied they participated in a sexual assault. One said his client hadn't touched the woman. Attempts by The Associated Press to reach the other men or their representatives have been unsuccessful.
Local D.A. agreed to reopen investigation
Van Houten, the Tompkins County district attorney, announced earlier this week that he would reopen the investigation after reviewing new information in the woman's civil lawsuit.

He had previously issued a statement defending his initial decision not to issue charges, maintaining that the woman's first account to police did not include allegations that she had been drugged against her will, was incapacitated beyond the ability to consent or was forced into sex.

Under pressure from the public and politicians, including Hochul, the private university agreed Wednesday to bring in outside lawyers to independently investigate how it handled the woman's allegations.

Cornell has said it suspended the Chi Phi fraternity indefinitely and disciplined or expelled some students after Jane Doe reported her alleged assault. The university has declined to provide specifics, citing student privacy rules.

If you’re in immediate danger or fear for your safety or that of others around you, please call 911. For support in your area, you can look for crisis lines and local services via the Ending Sexual Violence Association of Canada database.

articles.title: EU ministers mull new ways to curb irregular migration

paras.en: The interior ministers of European Union countries met in Luxembourg on Thursday to discuss ways to strengthen border controls and curb undocumented migration into the 27-member bloc.
Following the talks, they approved a new regulation to boost deportations of irregular migrants.
It will allow member states to establish so-called return hubs outside the EU for migrants who are legally required to leave the bloc but cannot be returned to their countries of origin.
Countries including Denmark, Austria, Greece, Germany and the Netherlands have been exploring options to change migration policy and set up such migrant centers.
"When it comes to return hubs," Danish Interior Minister Morten Bodskov told reporters, "it's progressing very well."
"We are moving in the right direction," he said without providing further details.
German Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt said there were "preliminary" talks on return hubs but declined to say which countries were involved.
More work was needed to make sure any agreement would withstand possible lawsuits, he said.
"These agreements are meant to be sustainable in the long term," Dobrindt noted, adding that he was nevertheless hopeful that a first deal could be sealed by the end of the year.
Dutch Migration Minister Bart van den Brink said a technical mission already visited a potential host country in early September.
Supporters of the policy say return hubs could facilitate repatriations and act as a deterrent for would-be irregular migrants.
But critics question their legality and argue that they violate migrants' fundamental rights.
Suspending asylum process in emergencies?
On Thursday, Greece even proposed temporarily suspending asylum applications in emergency situations. The right to seek asylum is guaranteed by the EU Charter of Fundamental Rights.
Athens argued that current rules are inadequate to handle mass arrivals as in Spain's North African enclave of Ceuta this summer.

The Spanish government estimates over 72,000 migrants entered Ceuta in late July. While most of them have since returned, some 10,000 remain, reinforcing calls in some EU capitals for a tougher approach. The Spanish government has said only minors and small groups of the people who entered Ceuta were brought to mainland Spain.
Greece's proposal appeared to draw support from some member states.

"We have to find a legal way not to bring them into the asylum procedure," said Dutch Migration Minister van den Brink. "In situations like Ceuta, it should be treated as a border management issue rather than an asylum issue."

Asked whether he saw a suspension of asylum as possible under the new emergency law, Magnus Brunner, EU commissioner for migration, said: "Europe needs the means to protect its borders at all times," while stressing that "we will always comply with fundamental rights and values."
The interior ministers' talks come as undocumented migration remains high on the EU's political agenda, with far-right parties increasingly gaining support across the bloc.
The situation has pushed many governments towards tougher migration policies centered on border controls, deterrence and returns.
European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said this month that the Commission will propose an emergency tool for countries to better deal with mass migration movements.
There are also plans to strengthen the EU's border agency, Frontex, with many stressing the need for the organization to have a rapid intervention force that could intervene in border crises.
