articles.title: Greetings from Syria, where time seems to melt as a glassmaker braves scorching temps
articles.author: Emily Feng

paras.en: Greetings from Syria, where time seems to melt as a glassmaker braves scorching temps
Our world as journalists can move fast; every day there's breaking news from all corners of the world, and we scramble to stay on top of multiple threads of information each day.

That is why I loved watching this glassmaker just outside the historic Old City in Damascus. In 100 degree summer heat, he patiently shaped cup after glass cup in the blistering furnace in front of him, seemingly impervious to the temperature.

Time seemed to matter less than the process of melting and stretching the hot, melted glass. He made cups and oil jars and decorative lamps in a variety of jewel colors, using techniques and styles that have not changed for decades. Watching his craft reminded me to slow down and enjoy the moment, too.

Even though his shop was right on the edge of the Old City of Damascus, it was largely empty. Syria's nearly 14-year civil war has ended, but the economy is still struggling, while inflation has ratcheted up the cost of living in the last year. Even a glass can be a luxury for some.
For more Far-Flung Postcards, click here.

articles.title: Swiss glaciers suffer another year of record ice loss
articles.author: Imogen Foulkes

paras.en: Swiss glaciers suffer another year of record ice loss

BERN, Switzerland — Switzerland's glaciers lost more than 5% of their ice in 2026, marking another year of rapid decline. The loss reflects a wider global trend: Glaciers around the world have been shrinking at increasingly rapid rates, a phenomenon scientists link directly to global warming.

Matthias Huss leads Switzerland's glacier monitoring network, known as GLAMOS, which released the report alongside the Swiss Academy of Sciences (SCNAT). Each summer, Huss heads high into the mountains to measure the country's ice fields. For years, his research has documented rapid ice loss, with the decline peaking in 2022, when Switzerland recorded a record 6% loss in a single year.
At the end of this year's long, hot summer, Huss returned to some of the glaciers to find much of the ice gone.
"They are completely devoid of ice," he said. "It's a moon landscape that is dry and dead. There are some little remnants, some ice blocks still lying around and melting there on the hot rocks."

In other places, alpine plants are now seeding themselves in areas once covered by glaciers that were meters thick. This year's glacier monitoring report shows the ice loss in 2026 is 5.5%, and the only reason it is slightly lower than 2022's record is because there was slightly more winter snow covering the ice.
Ominously, though, Huss' research shows that individual glaciers, among them Switzerland's biggest, like the mighty Rhône and Aletsch, have suffered record ice loss this year.

Why is this important? Because these huge ice fields are often called Europe's water towers. They store winter snow and release it gently as it melts over the spring and summer. That snowmelt fills Europe's key waterways, like the Rhine and the Danube. The water is key to Europe's food supply, and much more.

"It's the food supply, it's the transportation chains," says Huss. This summer, as river levels sank, freight transport in the Rhine and Danube came to a standstill, and nuclear power stations, cooled by river water, had to be temporarily shut down.

This situation can only get worse if the melt continues. Although Europe's rivers did have some water this summer, it came not from seasonal snowmelt, but from the glaciers themselves melting. Once they are gone — and 1,200 smaller glaciers have disappeared in the last 50 years — drought could pose an existential threat to Europe's farmers.

There are other threats too. Glaciers and alpine permafrost are key to stability; they are a kind of glue that holds the mountains together. Without that glue, the risk of landslides and even flooding increases. Last year, the Swiss village of Blatten was wiped out when a fragile glacier crashed down, bringing the side of the mountain with it and destroying 300 homes.

Fortunately, the instability was being monitored, and Blatten's population was evacuated before the landslide. But one year later, they are still living in temporary accommodation, with no idea if they will ever be able to return to homes now buried under an estimated 9 million cubic meters of ice, rock and mud.
This summer, on Nepal's border with Tibet, the collapse of a glacier triggered devastating floods that killed at least 1,400 people.

Matthias Huss is cautious about making a direct link between climate change and such disasters. Mountain environments, he points out, have always been risky. "It's a bit more complicated than just saying it's warm and the glaciers are disappearing, so the mountains are falling apart and causing disasters like this," he explains.

But, he adds, climate change can be the catalyst for such natural disasters. "Combined with this heat, with the disappearance of the ice, with the warming of permafrost, climate change can be a triggering factor. That can just be the last bit that is missing to trigger such events."

And after years of monitoring the glaciers, Huss has little patience with those who still claim climate change does not exist. What is happening to the glaciers should be a warning sign, he argues. "Look at them, it's not a hoax. The evidence is clear, and it's been clear for decades. And I think many people have understood that it's time to act now."

Without action, Europe's beloved alpine landscape could, quite soon, look very different. If the planet keeps warming at its current rate, the glacier monitoring unit predicts, all the glaciers will be gone by the end of this century.

articles.title: Atlanta Dream advance to WNBA playoffs semifinals for first time since 2018 with Game 2 win

paras.en: The Atlanta Dream avoided a first-round playoff exit for the first time in four years.

Atlanta, which finished with the Eastern Conference’s best regular-season record, had little trouble dispatching the Washington Mystics in Game 2 of their first-round WNBA playoff series Tuesday night. Star guard Allisha Gray led the Dream with 22 points in the 83-75 victory, punching Atlanta’s ticket to the semifinals for the first time since 2018.

Atlanta’s postseason run will continue Sunday, when the Dream host Game 1 of the semifinals against New York. The Liberty made league history by sweeping Minnesota, becoming the first No. 8 seed to eliminate a No. 1 seed in the league's 30-year history.

Jordin Canada made 3-pointers on back-to-back possessions in the fourth quarter, and she added a jumper from the free-throw line on Atlanta’s next trip for an 89-70 lead with just under three minutes left on the clock.

Rhyne Howard, the top pick in the 2022 WNBA Draft, ended the night with 15 points before fouling out with just over six minutes remaining in the fourth quarter. Angel Reese also had 15 points and seven rebounds.
The Mystics committed 11 first-half turnovers.
Washington went on a 14-2 run starting in the third quarter to get within 65-62. But Atlanta scored the next 13 points, capped by a 3-pointer by Canada, to rebuild a double-digit lead at 78-62.

The Mystics were making their first playoff appearance since winning the 2019 WNBA championship, while the Dream have captured the conference title three times from 2010-13 but have never won a WNBA championship.
The Dallas Wings hosted the Golden State Valkyries in Wednesday's other first-round series matchup.
The Associated Press contributed to this report.

articles.title: White Sox, Yankees advance to next round with sweeps as Munetaka Murakami provides quote of the year

paras.en: Wednesday afternoon had plenty of potential for drama, with all four wild card series offering the potential for teams to advance into the division round of the Major League Baseball playoffs.

The first game of the quadruple-header, the Atlanta Braves and Philadelphia Phillies, delivered in spades. A Bryce Harper misplay in the 7th inning allowed two Braves' runs to score, putting the Phillies on the brink of elimination. But Schwarber and Harper hit back-to-back homers in the 8th to tie it, and a 10th inning homer for Alec Bohm won it for Philadelphia to force a winner-take-all game three on Thursday.

Then there's the Houston Astros. The Astros entered game two needing a win to force a game three, sending their ace, Hunter Brown, to the mound against the White Sox' powerful lineup. 36 pitches, five hits, four runs, two errors and just two outs later, the White Sox had a 4-0 lead and Brown was out of the game.

That summed up Houston's series; just not quite good enough to overcome Chicago's offense. The White Sox, one of baseball's most strikeout-prone offenses, had 13 in Wednesday's game, but kept chipping away, fending off an attempted Astros comeback with a massive three-run homer from Chase Meidroth in the 6th inning to give them some breathing room.

Four combined innings from Jordan Hicks and Erick Fedde closed it out to send the White Sox through for a massive ALDS against their division rival Cleveland Guardians. But they weren't done with the entertainment quite yet.
In the postgame clubhouse celebrations, star first year third baseman Munetaka Murakami gave what might be the quote of the season. When asked how he felt, Murakami answered, "100."
A minute later, after being joined by another member of the White Sox staff, Murakami, covered in beer, added, "I'm drunk, I'm drunk. Yesterday, maybe hungover, you know?"
After the interviewer offered a gentle correction, he said, "No, not yesterday, tomorrow. Sorry, I don't speak English."

Meanwhile, on the other side of the American League postseason bracket, the New York Yankees had an opportunity to sweep the hated Boston Red Sox after a dominant 9-0 win in game one. And after Cam Schlittler's remarkable outing on Tuesday, Max Fried was nearly as good on Wednesday.

Six innings with just one run allowed, three hits, one walk and six strikeouts, enough for New York to take a 2-1 lead into the bottom of the sixth. Which is where everything imploded for Boston. Garrett Crochet, making his first appearance on a big league mound since late-April, took over, hoping to keep the Yankees at two.

Instead, Spencer Jones reached on a strikeout, then stole second and advanced to third on a throwing error from catcher Adley Rutschmann. George Lombard singled in a run, Jazz Chisholm poked one through the right side, Trent Grisham got a bunt down for a hit, knocking Crochet out of the game without getting an out. Garrett Whitlock came in to stop the bleeding, but after two more runs scored on a sac fly and groundout, Cody Bellinger delivered the big blow.
On a 1-0 changeup, Bellinger took advantage of the short right field porch and knocked in three to make it 8-1.
New York cruised home with a 9-2 win, setting up an ALDS matchup with the Tampa Bay Rays.

There are a few big takeaways from these two sweeps, namely the importance of power in October baseball. It's an old adage that small ball wins against quality pitching, but it was the homers from Chicago in game one and two that gave them the edge, while Bellinger's bomb effectively put the game out of reach in the Bronx. Even without Aaron Judge, the Yankees' lineup outscored Boston 17-2. And with two days off before the start of the ALDS, Schlittler will be able to start in game two of the ALDS, with Gerrit Cole or Carlos Rodon available for game one.

While the Yankees are through, the other three teams left in the AL bracket are the Guardians, Rays and White Sox. Those teams rank 25th, 26th and 28th in total payroll respectively. There's a long ways to go to reach or win the World Series, but it's a bit of a tough look for MLB that the league office has spent the past few months preparing to lock players out by claiming that small market teams with low payrolls have no hope of meaningful baseball.
Pretty sure those three organizations should have hope. Saturday in Cleveland and Tampa should be a blast. Playoff baseball always is.

articles.title: Arizona sheriff's helicopter crew rescues man stranded atop overturned truck in rapidly rising floodwaters

paras.en: Dramatic video shows an Arizona sheriff's helicopter crew rescuing a man stranded on top of his overturned truck as rapidly moving floodwaters surrounded the vehicle.

The Maricopa County Sheriff's Office said its Fox 1 aviation crew responded Tuesday morning to a flooded wash in Tonopah, where deputies found the man sitting atop the overturned vehicle with water rushing around him.
Video released by authorities shows the man perched on the truck as muddy floodwaters rush past him.
Because of the dangerous conditions, first responders determined that directly reaching the man was too risky and decided a "hoist rescue" would be the safest option.
The video shows a Fox 1 crew member being lowered to the vehicle to secure the man in a rescue harness before both are hoisted to safety.
The man was taken to the riverbank, where fire personnel were waiting, according to the sheriff's office.
The helicopter's pilot, Rich Dickner, told CBS News that the water was quickly rising around the vehicle.
"We didn't waste much time," Dickner said.
"As opposed to when we first got there, you can see the water line on the video — it's below the window — and it had risen up to the top of the window," he continued. "So there was that urgency."
People Magazine reported that Deputy Lindsey Smith was lowered approximately 80 feet from the helicopter toward the overturned truck.
She initially struggled to get her footing before securing herself to the vehicle, according to the report.
The entire rescue took less than five minutes, authorities said.
The Maricopa County Sheriff's Office credited the crew's swift response with getting the man to safety.
"Thanks to the skill and quick response of our Aviation crew, the subject was safely brought to shore," the sheriff's office said.
The Weather Channel reported that remnants of Hurricane Polo brought historic rainfall to parts of the Desert Southwest, contributing to dangerous flash flooding.
The Flood Control District of Maricopa County warned drivers not to attempt to cross flooded roads.
"Remember: Conditions can change fast. If you encounter a flooded roadway, Turn Around, Don't Drown."
Fox News Digital has reached out to the Maricopa County Sheriff's Office for additional information.

articles.title: Australian couple among passengers on diverted flydubai flight to Israel, embassy says
articles.author: Tess Ikonomou

paras.en: Two Australian citizens were onboard a flight to Tel Aviv that was diverted after one of the pilots allegedly stabbed the other in an attack, according to the Israeli embassy.
The passengers are a Jewish couple from Sydney, the embassy in Australia confirmed to the Guardian on Thursday. No further details were provided.
The flydubai aircraft was travelling from the United Arab Emirates to Israel when it was forced to make an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia.
One of the pilots, whom Israeli officials said was an Omani citizen, is accused of stabbing his co-pilot. During the alleged attack, the plane plunged about 17,000 feet in just two minutes.

Passenger Yaniv Hayoun later recounted how he and other passengers heard screaming and felt pressure as the plane dived before forcing their way into the cockpit and finding the attacker at the instrument panel.

“I grabbed the attacker, put him in a chokehold, and dragged him out first,” Hayoun said during a meeting with Netanyahu after the plane had landed safely and the passengers were flown to Israel. “He was trying to destroy the instruments to disable the plane.”
Israel’s ambassador to Australia, Hillel Newman, said the incident reminded him of the 11 September attacks.
“You have here a very special incident, and due to the real heroism of some people on board, they were saved.”
Newman said heightened security alerts had been issued following the attack.
“It just shows that … those that hate Israel also hate the peace.
“It’s an attempt to hit at the peace itself, at the Abraham Accords, and the relationships which Israel does have with Arab and Muslim countries.”
The Abraham Accords normalised relations between the UAE and Israel in 2020.
Israeli prime minister, Benjamin Netanyahu, said it was too early to tell who was ultimately behind the the incident.
There are about 12,000 Australian citizens living in Israel and 25,000 in the UAE.

articles.title: Australia news live: Anika Wells named in Time’s ‘influential rising stars’; NSW seeks to join Queensland in ‘from the river to the sea’ ban case
articles.author: Achol Arok (now) and Nick Visser (earlier)

paras.en: Anika Wells named as part of Time 100 ‘most influential rising stars’ list
paras.zh: Anika Wells入选时代100 “最具影响力新星”榜单

paras.en: The federal communications minister, Anika Wells, has been named as one of Time magazine’s “world’s most influential rising stars”, as part of its annual Time 100 list.

Wells, who has overseen the under-16s social media ban and is now working on a world-leading digital duty of care framework, was included on what Time calls its list of “leaders who are shaping the future”.
Also on the list: musicians Sombr and PinkPantheress, soccer player Folarin Balogun, US senator Andy Kim, the Dutch prime minister, Rob Jetten, and Donald Trump’s political adviser James Blair.
Wells was published in the list alongside a testimonial written by the former Labor PM Julia Gillard:

As the world grapples with the extraordinary power of social media and the increasingly pervasive role it plays, Anika Wells has emerged as one of the most significant voices in a growing global movement to reframe the relationship between technology and the well-being of our children.

Even in the face of intense opposition from some of the world’s largest tech companies, she remains steadfast … Future generations will look back on her landmark changes as courageous and trail-blazing.
Australian musician Troye Sivan was also included on the “influential rising stars” list, with a testimonial written by Kylie Minogue. She wrote:
Troye Sivan is a perfect 2020s pop star… Troye doesn’t just make pop music to love. He makes pop music to believe in.
Jetstar staff to escalate industrial action with one-hour stoppages

Jetstar staff will escalate industrial action tomorrow, with union members planning one-hour stoppages at major airports nationwide and abstaining from routine duties. It coincides with school holidays and the start of the NRL grand final weekend.

Australian Services Union (ASU) confirmed members will cease passenger announcements and flight disruption management, while processing eligible fees for excess baggage, seat selection and late changes at $0.

The union said the escalation follows failed negotiations over pay and conditions. Members took industrial action in September, after voting in favour of seeking wages in-line with other Qantas Group staff, higher penalty rates, improved leave, job security and better weather protections.

ASU assistant national secretary, Scott Cowen said members were “left with no other choice”, amid cost-of-living pressures and extreme weather conditions. He said the airline failed to support workers with extra weather protections or a pay offer that responds to this crisis properly”.

Jetstar’s domestic earnings are up 15 per cent this year on record passenger numbers, and Qantas Group is turning a profit. A 2.1% pay rise for the people who made that possible is not what a fair share looks like.
Jetstar has the money and the record year to make this right.”
Jetstar said it does not expect any impact on flights, citing “strong contingency plans.

A spokesperson for the airline said it was “very disappointing” the union chose to pursue further action despite a “comprehensive and fair offer, including meaningful pay increases, improved penalties and allowances, and greater rostering flexibility”.
South Australia’s AI royal commission board selected
A former judge and two global tech experts will lead a royal commission into artificial intelligence after the most “substantial technological shift” in two centuries, AAP reports.
The South Australian government on Thursday revealed the terms of reference for the state inquiry and its pick for chair, the economist and former judge IainRoss.
Kate Pounder and Christopher Manning were selected as commissioners for their expertise in technology policy, innovation, computer science and machine learning.
Ross said the inquiry would balance opportunities for enriching lives, improving productivity and lifting economic performance with an approach that mitigated risks and threats.
Manning, a world-renowned AI expert, is the co-founder of the Stanford Institute for Human-Centred AI and a professor in machine learning at the private research university.
Premier Peter Malinauskas said it was impossible to put the “AI genie back in the bottle”, conceding the fast-developing technology sometimes scared him.
If we don’t contemplate … an AI future forcefully, there could be really severe consequences, as well as a big opportunity cost.
Pill testing at NSW music festivals to return this weekend
The New South Wales government’s reinstated pill testing service at selected music festivals will return to this long weekend’s Knockout Outdoor festival.
The $4.3m initiative will operate at up to 15 festivals each year, selected by NSW Health in consultation with the music fesitval industry and harm-reduction organisations.

The government reiterated that “illicit drugs remain illegal in NSW” and said the service “is not an endorsement of illicit drug use”. It also reminded festivalgoers that there “will always be risks involved when consuming these substances”.
The state’s chief health officer, Dr Kerry Chant, said drug checking services could help people make more informed decisions, but did not guarantee safety. She said:
Drug checking services are intended to help people make informed decisions to reduce drug-related harm, but they are not a guarantee of safety.

Our priority is to reduce harm and keep people safe. Drug checking at music festivals aims to educate individuals, allowing them to avoid dangerous substances and make safer and more informed choices.
RBA denies staff real wages increase after interest rate rise
The Reserve Bank rejected its own staff’s requests for a real pay rise and back pay on lost wages just hours after it hiked interest rates on Tuesday.

While the RBA has repeatedly warned that inflation-matched wage growth risks pushing up consumer prices, its employees argue the bank’s own forecasts show their pay will slip behind the cost of living.
As staff left the office on Tuesday evening, the governor, Michele Bullock, emailed them asking them to vote for a pay offer nearly identical to one already rejected by 54% of staff in July.
Anti-racism training in schools among youth justice reforms needed in Victoria, working group says

A group of South Sudanese Australian leaders in Victoria have called for mandatory anti-racism training for all school staff and ramped up efforts to target organised crime groups preying on young people to reduce the over-representation of the community’s children in the justice system.

The recommendations are contained within a report by the state’s South Sudanese Australian Youth Justice Expert Working Group report, delivered to the state government earlier this year and released publicly on Thursday.
The report contains 59 recommendations designed to reduce the over-representation of South Sudanese Australians in the state’s youth justice system.
The government has established a committee to oversee the implementation of the recommendations. But its response has not outlined which specific recommendations it has accepted.

The state government said it had already commenced work on some of the recommendations while some required “policy, funding, cultural and operational implications that require careful consideration and planning”.

Victoria’s youth justice minister, Ros Spence, said the government was working with the South Sudanese community to stop crime before it starts and ensure “young people have the support to stay on the right path”:
Our response is the result of listening to South Sudanese young people, families, and community leaders. We thank them for their leadership and for putting forward practical solutions.
NSW seeks to join Queensland in defence of ban on ‘from the river to the sea’

The NSW government has sought leave to join the Queensland government in a high court case brought by pro-Palestine protesters against laws banning the contested phrases “from the river to the sea” and “globalise the intifada”.

A spokesperson for the NSW attorney-general, Michael Daley, confirmed that the government had sought to be a party to the case alongside the Queensland government, but declined to comment further. High court listings show the attorney general filed leave to intervene in the case last week.
In a statement, Remah Naji, a spokesperson for Justice for Palestine Magan-djin, who brought the challenge, said:

What the NSW government fails to understand is that by intervening, they’re playing directly into our hands. This intervention was expected. We will use it to transform this from a Queensland case into a national struggle, one in which all people of conscience have a stake.
The Australian Bureau of Statistics released new figures this morning showing job vacancies fell again in August 2026.
Vacancies sat at 325,000, according to quarterly figures, Sean Crick, the ABS head of labour statistics, said:
The decline in job vacancies was driven by the private sector, notably in business goods and services. This was offset somewhat by rises in customer facing roles including in Retail trade.
Over the year, job vacancies declined by 1.3%. The wholesale trade industry had the largest quarterly drop, of 18%, followed by professional, scientific and technical services, down 17.3%.
The largest percentage rises in job vacancies were in retail trade, up 24.5%, followed by financial and insurance services, up by 14.1%.
Israel issues ‘heightened alerts’ after flydubai attack
Israel’s ambassador to Australia, Hillel Newman, says his nation will tighten security following the alleged stabbing attack on a flight en route to Tel Aviv.
The top diplomat said it will be alleged the Omani co-pilot involved in the attack had attempted to crash the plane.
This is a heightened alert period, and of course … Israel will take the precautions.
Prime minister Netanyahu gave a briefing last night, in which he said that there is heightened security alerts.

The Reserve Bank has warned that a sudden loss of faith in the artificial intelligence boom could trigger “disorderly asset price corrections” and that “Australia is unlikely to be immune” from the impact.
The RBA’s latest financial stability review said “threats to global financial stability continue to mount”.

Alongside the huge sums being invested in AI, two ongoing conflicts – in the Middle East and Ukraine – alongside “intensifying strategic competition among major powers” underscored these threats, the RBA said.
High valuations in global corporate debt and share markets meant they were vulnerable to a “disorderly” correction.

“One possible trigger could be a shift in sentiment towards the AI investment boom, which is increasingly fuelled by expectations of sustained rapid earnings growth and a debt-financing cycle that is becoming more opaque and circular,” the report said.
The RBA also warned of the rising risk of cyber-attacks, potentially facilitated by AI, and a sudden sell-off in global bond markets.
These external factors are the most prominent threats to financial stability in Australia.
Sydney’s metro extension meets key safety approvals – but some doors won’t open

The NSW transport minister, John Graham, says the highly anticipated southwest extension of the Sydney Metro has received key safety approvals, but after discussions with the safety regulator, six doors on the line will not be in use when it opens later this year.
Providing an update at a press conference this morning, Graham said:

As part of the initial safety case when first passengers jump on this train, we’ve agreed with [the Office of the National Rail Safety Regulator] that six of those doors will stay closed, so that there’s no even minor safety issues as this runs …
They’ll be clearly signed so passengers know just one of the safety measures in place for this complex build that we’re undertaking on what is a 130-year-old railway.
They include three sets of doors at Dulwich Hill, and one each at Marrickville, Canterbury and Campsie. Graham said it was an “ongoing discussion” whether these doors will eventually be in use.

The issue relates to mechanical “gap-fillers” that have been added to fill the space between the train and curved platforms on the historic line, with the issue affecting doors where those gaps are widest. There are 360 doors across the 10 stations that are part of the extension, with 18 on each platform at Dulwich Hill.
This morning, Graham said “we’re confident we’ll be able to operate this railway safely very shortly”.
No sign of negative equity crisis despite property slump
The Reserve Bank estimates that fewer than one in 100 borrowers owe more on their home than its worth, despite this year’s broadening price falls.
The RBA in its latest financial stability review said Australia’s household sector was largely coping well with rising interest rates and a recent decline in real incomes. The biannual report said:

While some households continue to experience hardship, the estimated share of mortgagors in severe financial stress or in arrears has, so far, remained low, supported by the strong labour market and mortgagors’ savings and equity buffers.

The RBA’s estimate that fewer than 1% of borrowers were in “negative equity” came with the caveat: recent buyers who took out loans worth close to the value of the property were more likely to now be in the position where the mortgage was higher than their home’s market value.

This included those who took advantage of the government’s 5% home guarantee scheme, the RBA said, although evidence suggested that the share of these borrowers falling behind on their payments remained “contained”.

The RBA estimated that even a 20% property price crash would only push about 5% of mortgages into negative equity – a testament to the fact most homeowners have enjoyed significant value gains over the years. The report said:
Negative equity is insufficient to trigger default if borrowers remain able to service their loans, which remains the case for the vast majority of these households.
Anika Wells named as part of Time 100 ‘most influential rising stars’ list
paras.zh: Anika Wells入选时代100 “最具影响力新星”榜单

paras.en: The federal communications minister, Anika Wells, has been named as one of Time magazine’s “world’s most influential rising stars”, as part of its annual Time 100 list.

Wells, who has overseen the under-16s social media ban and is now working on a world-leading digital duty of care framework, was included on what Time calls its list of “leaders who are shaping the future”.
Also on the list: musicians Sombr and PinkPantheress, soccer player Folarin Balogun, US senator Andy Kim, the Dutch prime minister, Rob Jetten, and Donald Trump’s political adviser James Blair.
Wells was published in the list alongside a testimonial written by the former Labor PM Julia Gillard:

As the world grapples with the extraordinary power of social media and the increasingly pervasive role it plays, Anika Wells has emerged as one of the most significant voices in a growing global movement to reframe the relationship between technology and the well-being of our children.

Even in the face of intense opposition from some of the world’s largest tech companies, she remains steadfast … Future generations will look back on her landmark changes as courageous and trail-blazing.
Australian musician Troye Sivan was also included on the “influential rising stars” list, with a testimonial written by Kylie Minogue. She wrote:
Troye Sivan is a perfect 2020s pop star… Troye doesn’t just make pop music to love. He makes pop music to believe in.
Minns says ‘incumbent upon all of us’ to reduce public spending amid high inflation
The NSW premier, Chris Minns, has again defended the state’s record on inflation, as he seeks to distance himself from the federal government ahead of the March 2027 election.

Following calls by the former RBA governor, Philip Lowe, for federal and state governments to reduce public spending and run large budget surpluses amid high inflation and interest rates, Minns yesterday defended NSW’s record, saying “we’ve been careful with public money”.
Asked about Lowe’s comments again on 2GB today, and whether the prime minister and federal treasurer needed to be “called out”, Minns said:

Well, I think it’s incumbent upon all of us ... me included, and all of the premiers as well. I mean, the Reserve Bank’s been really clear. Public demand, government spending in the economy is pushing or putting pressure on inflation, as is other things like the war in the Middle East and Donald Trump’s decision to spark a war in Iran.

But the truth of the matter is, there’s not much we can do about that geopolitical conflict unless Donald Trump’s listening to this program, and even if he is, I don’t think it’d make a difference. So we have to be look at spending in NSW, whatever we can do, and we’ve tried to do that.
Minns went on to say that NSW was the “only state with a AAA credit rating from [rating agency] Fitch”.

We think that protecting public money, particularly as we get close to an election campaign where political parties are up for spending everything to try and get re-elected, we just can’t throw the barn out because the public are about to go to the polls.

articles.title: Daredevil Jaan Roose completes slackline walk high above central Seoul
articles.author: Raphael Rashid in Seoul

paras.en: The lunchtime crowds drifted slowly back to their offices along central Seoul’s main boulevard, heads up and phones raised to the sky.
paras.zh: 午餐时间的人群慢慢地回到他们的办公室，沿着首尔市中心的主要林荫大道，抬起头，电话飘向天空。

paras.en: High above, a narrow ribbon ran between the Koreana hotel and the Dong-A Media Center, a few hundred metres from the capital’s famous Gyeongbokgung palace and Gwanghwamun square.
paras.zh: 高处有一条狭窄的丝带，穿过韩国酒店和东亚媒体中心，距离首都著名的景福宫和光化门广场仅几百米。

paras.en: A countdown ticked down on a big screen, and at 1pm, a figure stepped off the roof of the Koreana and out over the drop.
paras.zh: 一个倒计时在大屏幕上滴答作响，下午1点，一个人物从韩亚航空的屋顶上跳了下来。

paras.en: Jaan Roose, an Estonian aerial athlete and three-time slackline world champion, was in Seoul to cross a 160-metre long highline suspended 120 metres above the city, in what organisers called South Korea’s first high-altitude slackline performance.
paras.zh: 爱沙尼亚空中运动员、三届Slackline世界冠军Jaan Roose在首尔穿越悬挂在城市上空120米处的160米长高线，组织者称之为韩国首次高空Slackline表演。

paras.en: The 34-year-old has made a name for himself slacklining dramatic urban environments, such as his 185-metre high feat between Qatar’s Katara towers.
paras.zh: 这位34岁的年轻人在戏剧性的城市环境中名声大噪，例如他在卡塔尔卡塔拉塔楼之间185米高的壮举。

paras.en: In 2024, he became the first person to slackline the strait of Messina between mainland Italy and Sicily, completing the 3.6km traverse despite a fall near the end, caught by his safety harness. Last month, he covered 14.7km over 12 hours on a line above the Danube in Bratislava, Slovakia.
paras.zh: 2024年，他成为第一个在意大利大陆和西西里岛之间的墨西拿海峡松弛的人，尽管他的安全带接近尾声，但他还是完成了3.6公里的航行。上个月，他在斯洛伐克布拉迪斯拉发的多瑙河上空行驶了14.7公里，历时12个小时。

paras.en: Below Roose, the Seoul traffic kept moving and the crowd held its breath each time he wobbled.
paras.zh: 在Roose的下面，首尔的交通不断移动，每次他摇晃时，人群都屏住了呼吸。

paras.en: “Just looking at him makes my legs go weak,” said Kim Young-sook, an office worker. “I can’t imagine how he can do that without being scared. It’s incredible.”
paras.zh: 上班族金英淑（ Kim Young-sook ）说： “只是看着他会让我的腿变得虚弱。” “我无法想象他怎么能做到这一点而不感到害怕。太不可思议了。”

paras.en: Midway across, Roose sat cross-legged on the line, then lay flat on his back, drawing gasps from below, before the daredevil rose and continued.
paras.zh: 中途，玫瑰盘腿坐在线上，然后平躺在背上，从下面喘气，然后冒失鬼站起来继续。

paras.en: “I’m worried he might fall”, said Choi Eun-jung, who came out to see Roose. “I know he’s a professional, but it’s still a little frightening to watch.”
paras.zh: “我担心他可能会摔倒，”出来见罗斯的崔恩中说。“我知道他是个职业选手，但看着他还是有点吓人。”

paras.en: On reaching Dong-A Media Center, he turned around, and started his return to the hotel rooftop.
paras.zh: 到达东亚传媒中心后，他转过身来，开始返回酒店屋顶。

paras.en: At the halfway point, he again dropped down and waved at the crowd. But this time he hung from the line with one arm and then dangled by his feet.
paras.zh: 中途，他再次跌倒，向人群挥手。但这一次，他用一只胳膊挂在绳子上，然后用脚晃来晃去。

paras.en: When he finished his performance, the crowds clapped, some clearly relieved.
paras.zh: 表演结束后，人群拍手，有些人明显松了一口气。

paras.en: At nearby Cheonggye plaza, people tried out their skills on slacklines, but these were set a mere 30cm and 50cm off the ground. Roose was scheduled for a second performance at 4pm.
paras.zh: 在附近的清溪广场，人们在松弛线上尝试他们的技能，但这些距离地面只有30厘米和50厘米。Roose定于下午4点进行第二次表演。

paras.en: Roose said a visit in 2022 to South Korea inspired his Gwanghwamun walk.
paras.zh: Roose说， 2022年对韩国的访问激发了他在光化门散步的灵感。

paras.en: On that trip, Roose encountered jultagi, Korea’s traditional tightrope walking, which Unesco added to its list of intangible cultural heritage in 2011.
paras.zh: 在那次旅行中， Roose遇到了韩国传统的钢丝绳步道jultagi ，联合国教科文组织于2011年将其列入非物质文化遗产名录。

paras.en: Unlike tightrope walking elsewhere, jultagi is as much comedy as acrobatics. The walker sings, jokes and dances on the rope, trading banter with a clown on the ground as musicians play.
paras.zh: 与其他地方走钢丝不同， jultagi和杂技一样喜剧。步行者在绳子上唱歌、开玩笑和跳舞，在音乐家演奏时与地上的小丑交换玩笑。

articles.title: Too early to say what motive for Dubai-Tel Aviv flight attack was, Israeli PM says

paras.en: Israel's Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has said it is too early to say what was behind the foiled attempt by a co-pilot to crash an Emirati flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv.
paras.zh: 以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡（ Benjamin Netanyahu ）表示，现在要说一名副驾驶试图坠毁从迪拜飞往特拉维夫的阿联酋航班的企图被挫败的原因还为时过早。

paras.en: There is no suggestion yet from authorities of a motive for the attacking pilot, but asked by Fox News whether there was any indication of Iran's involvement, Netanyahu replied: "It's too early to say."
paras.zh: 当局尚未暗示袭击飞行员的动机，但福克斯新闻询问是否有任何迹象表明伊朗参与其中，内塔尼亚胡回答说： “现在说还为时过早。”

paras.en: He said the attacker was being investigated in Saudi Arabia, where he was arrested after the Flydubai plane made an emergency landing.
paras.zh: 他说，袭击者正在沙特阿拉伯接受调查，他在Flydubai飞机紧急降落后被捕。

paras.en: Shaken passengers described how they burst into the cockpit and wrestled with the attacker as the aircraft descended sharply.
paras.zh: 震惊的乘客描述了他们如何在飞机急剧下降时冲进驾驶舱并与袭击者摔跤。

paras.en: Netanyahu added that he expected the attacker would be taken to the United Arab Emirates, where the plane took off. "We'll be following and possibly also participating in this investigation," Netanyahu added.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡补充说，他预计袭击者将被带到阿拉伯联合酋长国，飞机在那里起飞。“我们将关注并可能参与这项调查，”内塔尼亚胡补充道。

paras.en: He told CNN that Israel did not have any warning or advance intelligence about the incident on the plane, which was flying 174 people to Israel.
paras.zh: 他告诉美国有线电视新闻网，以色列对飞机上的事件没有任何警告或事先情报，飞机上有174人飞往以色列。

paras.en: The pilot was arrested after he stabbed the other pilot on a flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv and "apparently tried to crash the plane", according to Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 根据内塔尼亚胡的说法，这名飞行员在从迪拜飞往特拉维夫的航班上刺伤了另一名飞行员并“显然试图坠毁飞机”后被捕。

paras.en: Passengers and crew overpowered the attacker and retook control of the Flydubai aircraft, landing it safely at an airport in Tabuk, northwestern Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 乘客和机组人员制服了袭击者，重新控制了Flydubai飞机，将其安全降落在沙特阿拉伯西北部塔布克的一个机场。

paras.en: The passengers, who were almost all Israeli, arrived later on Wednesday in Tel Aviv on a repatriation flight.
paras.zh: 这些乘客几乎都是以色列人，于周三晚些时候乘坐遣返航班抵达特拉维夫。

paras.en: The stabbed pilot, named as Indian national Captain Smit Machchhar, has been taken to hospital but is reported to be in a stable condition. Netanyahu and India's leader Narendra Modi praised him as a "hero".
paras.zh: 这名被刺伤的飞行员名为印度国民队长Smit Machchhar ，已被送往医院，但据报道情况稳定。内塔尼亚胡和印度领导人纳伦德拉·莫迪称赞他是“英雄”。

paras.en: "Despite being stabbed and seriously injured, he fought back, resisted, opened the cockpit door, and enabled passengers and crew to overpower the attacker â preventing a catastrophic mid-air disaster," Netanyahu wrote on X.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在X上写道： “尽管被刺伤并严重受伤，但他反击，抵抗，打开驾驶舱门，并使乘客和机组人员能够压制袭击者-防止灾难性的空中灾难。”

paras.en: The Indian embassy in Saudi Arabia said Machchhar was in a stable condition in hospital.
paras.zh: 印度驻沙特阿拉伯大使馆表示， Machchhar在医院病情稳定。

paras.en: Modi praised the pilot's actions, writing on X: "In the face of the gravest danger and despite being seriously injured, he showed immense courage and an unwavering resolve to protect the lives of others.
paras.zh: 莫迪称赞了飞行员的行为，并在X上写道： “面对最严重的危险，尽管受了重伤，但他表现出巨大的勇气和坚定不移的决心来保护他人的生命。

paras.en: US President Donald Trump said he had spoken with Netanyahu following the incident, saying it seemed as though the attacker was "perhaps a terrorist" or there were other reasons behind the attack.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德特朗普表示，他在事件发生后与内塔尼亚胡进行了交谈，称袭击者似乎是“可能是恐怖分子” ，或者袭击背后有其他原因。

paras.en: Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz has also called it an "attempted jihadist terror attack", without giving any details.
paras.zh: 以色列国防部长以色列·卡茨（ Israel Katz ）也称其为“未遂的圣战恐怖袭击” ，但没有提供任何细节。

paras.en: Flydubai's flight FZ1073 took off from Dubai International Airport in the UAE at 03:05 GMT (07:05 local time), en route to Ben-Gurion Airport in Israel.
paras.zh: Flydubai的FZ1073航班于格林威治标准时间03:05 （当地时间07:05 ）从阿联酋迪拜国际机场起飞，前往以色列本古里安机场。

paras.en: Around two and a half hours into its journey, data from flight tracking website Flightrader24 reported a rapid descent over Saudi Arabia, dropping more than 17,000 feet (over 5,000m) in less than two minutes.
paras.zh: 飞行追踪网站Flightrader24的数据显示，飞行开始约两个半小时后，飞行数据在沙特阿拉伯上空快速下降，在不到两分钟的时间内下降了超过17,000英尺（超过5,000米）。

paras.en: Minutes later, the plane signalled an emergency code - squawk 7700 - before switching it to a squawk 7500 code reporting a hijacking.
paras.zh: 几分钟后，飞机发出紧急代码- SQUAWK 7700 -然后切换到SQUAWK 7500代码报告劫持。

paras.en: Around 20 minutes after these codes were signalled, the plane looped back into Saudi Arabia, where it later started its manual descent for landing.
paras.zh: 这些密码发出信号约20分钟后，这架飞机返回沙特阿拉伯，后来开始手动下降着陆。

paras.en: Less than an hour later, the plane returned to squawk 7700.
paras.zh: 不到一个小时后，飞机返回了SQUAWK 7700。

paras.en: Shortly after the incident, the Israeli and Saudi Arabian air forces dispatched fighter jets, while Netanyahu held urgent consultations.
paras.zh: 事件发生后不久，以色列和沙特阿拉伯空军派出了战斗机，而内塔尼亚胡举行了紧急磋商。

paras.en: Initial media reports suggested a fight had broken out between the aircraft's two pilots, causing the rapid descent and landing.
paras.zh: 最初的媒体报道表明，飞机的两名飞行员之间爆发了战斗，导致飞机快速下降和着陆。

paras.en: However, in the hours after the plane touched down in Tabuk, eyewitness accounts and a statement by Netanyahu confirmed one of the pilots had stabbed the other and, according to the Israeli prime minister, "apparently tried to crash" the aircraft.
paras.zh: 然而，在飞机在塔布克降落后的几个小时内，目击者的说法和内塔尼亚胡的一份声明证实，其中一名飞行员刺伤了另一名飞行员，据以色列总理称，这架飞机“显然试图坠毁”。

paras.en: He said an Israeli passenger told him "the plane went into a spin and began to descend" before the passenger and a crew member entered the cockpit and overpowered the "pilot who had carried out the stabbing".
paras.zh: 他说，一名以色列乘客告诉他“飞机旋转并开始下降” ，然后乘客和一名机组人员进入驾驶舱并压制了“进行刺伤的飞行员”。

paras.en: Two on-duty crew travelling on the flight were then able to land the plane safely, Flydubai said.
paras.zh: Flydubai说，两名乘坐飞机的值班机组人员随后能够安全降落飞机。

paras.en: In an address on Wednesday evening, Netanyahu called the situation "a very serious security incident" and said Israeli security forces were "maintaining close contact with the relevant authorities to ensure the continued safety of the passengers".
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在周三晚上的一次讲话中称这种情况是“非常严重的安全事件” ，并表示以色列安全部队“与有关当局保持密切联系，以确保乘客的持续安全”。

paras.en: Unlike Israel's defence minister, Netanyahu did not give a motive for the incident during the address.
paras.zh: 与以色列国防部长不同，内塔尼亚胡在讲话中没有给出这一事件的动机。

paras.en: "I salute these heroes who demonstrated extraordinary resourcefulness and courage," he added. "They saved many lives and prevented a major disaster."
paras.zh: “我向这些表现出非凡的智慧和勇气的英雄致敬，”他补充说。“他们挽救了很多人的生命，避免了一场大灾难。”

paras.en: Flydubai said in a statement that "an altercation occurred in the flight deck" and the flight was "successfully secured by on-duty Flydubai crew travelling on the flight, who diverted and landed the aircraft safely at Tabuk airport".
paras.zh: Flydubai在一份声明中表示， “驾驶舱发生争执” ，该航班“由乘坐该航班的值班Flydubai机组人员成功固定，他们将飞机安全转移并降落在塔布克机场”。

paras.en: An airline spokesperson added: "Our immediate priority is to ensure the ongoing safety, health, and wellbeing of all passengers and crew members involved in this incident and support the official investigation."
paras.zh: 航空公司发言人补充说： “我们的当务之急是确保参与此事件的所有乘客和机组人员的安全、健康和福祉，并支持官方调查。”

paras.en: The passengers who had been on board flight FZ1073 arrived in Tel Aviv at around 18:40 local time (15:40 GMT). They were greeted at the airport by crowds of onlookers playing music, singing, dancing and waving Israeli flags.
paras.zh: 乘坐FZ1073航班的乘客于当地时间18:40左右（格林尼治标准时间15:40 ）抵达特拉维夫。他们在机场受到一群围观者的欢迎，他们演奏音乐、唱歌、跳舞和挥舞以色列国旗。

paras.en: A number of people were "very emotional and crying as they came off the plane," a paramedic from Israel's ambulance service told the BBC.
paras.zh: 以色列救护车服务处的一名护理人员告诉英国广播公司，许多人“下飞机时非常激动和哭泣”。

paras.en: One passenger, Yaniv Hayun, met Netanyahu and told him how he and others on the flight had restrained the attacker.
paras.zh: 一名乘客亚尼夫·哈云（ Yaniv Hayun ）会见了内塔尼亚胡，并告诉他他和飞机上的其他人是如何制服袭击者的。

paras.en: "The pilot who was stabbed was simply very close to the door, so it was hard for us to open it," Hayun said in a video posted on social media by the prime minister's office, but before the stabbed pilot - now identified as Machchhar - collapsed, he was able to open the door.
paras.zh: “被刺伤的飞行员离门很近，所以我们很难打开它，” Hayun在总理办公室在社交媒体上发布的视频中说，但在被刺伤的飞行员-现在被确定为Machchhar -倒塌之前，他能够打开门。

paras.en: Yaniv said he put the attacker, who was trying to disable the plane, in a chokehold before other passengers helped pin him down.
paras.zh: Yaniv说，在其他乘客帮助他之前，他将试图使飞机失效的袭击者置于窒息状态。

paras.en: He added that he "pulled the controls" of the plane and after it levelled out, another pilot took over control.
paras.zh: 他补充说，他“拉动了飞机的控制” ，飞机夷为平地后，另一名飞行员接管了控制权。

paras.en: Zvika Meness, another passenger, told Israeli public broadcaster Kan News that he and other passengers tied the attacker up "with his own zip ties and with the multimedia headphones".
paras.zh: 另一名乘客Zvika Meness告诉以色列公共广播公司Kan News ，他和其他乘客“用自己的拉链和多媒体耳机”将袭击者绑起来。

paras.en: He said: "There are children and families here who have been through a very severe, highly traumatic event."
paras.zh: 他说： “这里有儿童和家庭经历了非常严重，高度创伤性的事件。”

articles.title: Plummeting Israel flight like 'rollercoaster', says passenger

paras.en: Plummeting Israel flight like 'rollercoaster', says passenger
paras.zh: 乘客说，以色列航班像“过山车”一样直线下降

paras.en: A passenger on board Flight FZ1073, which fell 17,000ft (5,200m) in less than two minutes when a pilot apparently stabbed his co-pilot, told the BBC about his experience.
paras.zh: FZ1073航班上的一名乘客在不到两分钟的时间内坠落了17,000英尺（ 5,200米） ，当时一名飞行员显然刺伤了他的副驾驶，他告诉BBC他的经历。

paras.en: The aircraft had been flying to Israel when the incident took place, which Almog Itali described as feeling like a "rollercoaster".
paras.zh: 事件发生时，这架飞机正在飞往以色列， Almog Itali称之为“过山车”。

paras.en: The plane was diverted to Saudi Arabia after several passengers said they took control of the flight and two other pilots at the rear of the plane reportedly came forward to land the plane.
paras.zh: 这架飞机在几名乘客表示他们控制了飞机后被转移到沙特阿拉伯，据报道，飞机后方的另外两名飞行员挺身而出降落飞机。

articles.title: US death row inmate Christa Pike taken to hospital after surviving two lethal injections, says lawyer

paras.en: Tennessee death row inmate Christa Pike has been taken to hospital after her heart was still beating following two lethal injections during her execution, her lawyer says.
paras.zh: 她的律师说，田纳西州死囚克里斯塔·派克（ Christa Pike ）在执行死刑期间接受了两次致命注射后，她的心脏仍在跳动，她已被送往医院。

paras.en: Her legal team filed an emergency motion to halt the convicted murderer's execution as it was happening, saying: "Ms Pike has lost consciousness and still has a heartbeat and is audibly snoring."
paras.zh: 她的法律团队提出了一项紧急动议，要求停止对被定罪的凶手的处决，并说： “派克女士已经失去知觉，仍然有心跳，听起来像是在打鼾。”

paras.en: One of her attorneys told the BBC that Pike, 50, was "being provided life-saving measures" in hospital after two syringes of pentobarbital had been administered.
paras.zh: 她的一位律师告诉英国广播公司，在接受两次戊巴比妥注射后， 50岁的派克正在医院“接受救生措施”。

paras.en: Pike was sentenced to death in 1996 for the murder of 19-year-old Colleen Slemmer.
paras.zh: 派克因谋杀19岁的科琳·斯莱默（ Colleen Slemmer ）于1996年被判处死刑。

paras.en: Pike was 18 when she and her then-boyfriend, Tadaryl Shipp, beat, tortured and killed 19-year-old Slemmer, whom they had met at a job training camp for troubled teens.
paras.zh: 派克18岁时，她和当时的男友塔达里尔·希普（ Tadaryl Shipp ）殴打、折磨并杀害了19岁的斯莱默（ Slemmer ） ，他们在为陷入困境的青少年提供的工作训练营中遇到了他们。

paras.en: Slemmer's mother May Martinez said she wanted the execution to take place, telling the Associated Press on Saturday: "Every time I think about it, I think about Colleen feeling that pain and trying to get up and run."
paras.zh: Slemmer的母亲May Martinez说她希望执行死刑，周六告诉美联社： “每当我想到它时，我都会想到Colleen感到疼痛并试图站起来跑步。”

paras.en: Her attempted execution took place at Riverbend Maximum Security Institution in Nashville at about 20:00 local time on Wednesday night.
paras.zh: 她于当地时间周三晚上20:00左右在纳什维尔的Riverbend Maximum安全机构被处决。

paras.en: Pike was given two doses of pentobarbital, and the curtain in the witness room was closed twice, the Associated Press reports.
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，派克接受了两剂戊巴比妥，证人室的窗帘关闭了两次。

paras.en: Media were at some point asked to leave, the news agency said.
paras.zh: 该通讯社说，媒体在某些时候被要求离开。

paras.en: Pike's legal team said in a statement to the Tennessean newspaper: "Tonight the State of Tennessee once again failed to carry out a lawful execution.
paras.zh: 派克的法律团队在给田纳西州报纸的一份声明中说： “今晚，田纳西州再次未能执行合法处决。

paras.en: "We take no pleasure in being right, but the concerns raised by Ms Pike proved to be true: difficult vein access, blown veins, degraded pentobarbital, no emergency medical care available when things inevitably go wrong, all under a protocol that remains veiled in secrecy."
paras.zh: “我们不高兴自己是对的，但派克女士提出的担忧被证明是真实的：静脉通路困难，静脉被吹，戊巴比妥降解，当事情不可避免地出错时没有紧急医疗护理，所有这些都是在一个秘密的方案下进行的。”

paras.en: Pike's lawyers filed an emergency motion to stay her execution and provide medical care after the lethal injection was apparently botched.
paras.zh: 派克的律师提出了一项紧急动议，要求在致命注射显然失败后暂停处决并提供医疗护理。

paras.en: District Judge Clifton L Corker issued a ruling noting that "medical personnel have begun to administer medical care as requested in the motion".
paras.zh: 地区法官Clifton L Corker发布了一项裁决，指出“医务人员已开始按照动议中的要求提供医疗服务”。

paras.en: The Tennessee Department of Correction has said it stands by all the actions it took during the attempted execution.
paras.zh: 田纳西州惩教局表示，它支持在未遂处决期间采取的所有行动。

paras.en: "The Tennessee Department of Correction followed every step of the State's lawful, established execution protocol approved by the Attorney General's Office," department spokesperson Dorinda Carter told the Tennessean newspaper.
paras.zh: 田纳西州惩教部门发言人多琳达·卡特（ Dorinda Carter ）告诉《田纳西州报》： “田纳西州惩教部门遵循了总检察长办公室批准的该州合法、既定的执行协议的每一步。”

paras.en: "The lethal injection chemical in the protocol has consistently been effective, and the protocol does not allow for additional procedures beyond what was carried out this evening. Christa Pike has been transported to an off-site medical facility," she said.
paras.zh: “方案中的致命注射化学品一直有效，方案不允许在今晚之外进行额外的程序。Christa Pike已被送往非现场医疗机构，”她说。

paras.en: Dr Joel Zivot, a professor at the Emory University School of Medicine who told the BBC he had been retained by Pike's legal team as a medical expert, said she likely never achieved a sufficient blood level of pentobarbital to cause apnoea and cardiovascular failure during the attempted execution.
paras.zh: 埃默里大学医学院教授Joel Zivot博士告诉英国广播公司，他被派克的法律团队聘为医学专家，她说她可能从未达到足够的戊巴比妥血液水平，在试图执行期间导致呼吸暂停和心血管衰竭。

paras.en: "It's very possible that as a consequence of the delay of the beginning of resuscitation she will have a brain injury," Zivot said in an email.
paras.zh: Zivot在一封电子邮件中说： “很可能由于复苏开始的延迟，她会受到脑损伤。”

paras.en: The attempted capital punishment went ahead after multiple last-minute legal challenges by Pike's lawyers failed.
paras.zh: 派克的律师在最后一刻多次法律挑战失败后，死刑的尝试继续进行。

paras.en: The US Supreme Court had thwarted two separate efforts to stop the lethal injection.
paras.zh: 美国最高法院挫败了两项分别阻止致命注射的努力。

paras.en: Late on Wednesday, the Supreme Court overturned a reprieve granted by a lower court earlier in the day, which granted a pause saying it needed more time to consider the arguments in Pike's case.
paras.zh: 周三晚些时候，最高法院推翻了当天早些时候下级法院批准的缓刑，该缓刑允许暂停，称需要更多时间来考虑派克案件中的论点。

paras.en: It followed the Supreme Court's earlier dismissal of an appeal by Pike's lawyers, who had argued the jury did not get the chance to weigh mitigating evidence of Pike's documented history of childhood sexual abuse, before they sentenced her to death in 1996.
paras.zh: 在此之前，最高法院早些时候驳回了派克的律师的上诉，他们认为陪审团在1996年判处她死刑之前，没有机会权衡派克有记录的童年性虐待历史的减轻证据。

paras.en: The defence said that for years, the state of Tennessee had argued in court that she lied about being sexually abused as a child.
paras.zh: 辩方说，多年来，田纳西州在法庭上辩称，她谎称自己小时候遭到性虐待。

paras.en: But at a recent hearing about her execution method, the state said it did not dispute that she had suffered sexual abuse and rape.
paras.zh: 但在最近关于她的处决方法的听证会上，该州表示对她遭受性虐待和强奸没有争议。

paras.en: Tennessee's governor denied a clemency request this week from Pike, the only woman on the state's death row.
paras.zh: 田纳西州州长本周拒绝了派克的宽大处理请求，派克是该州死囚牢房中唯一的女性。

paras.en: In her clemency petition, Pike said that she intended to beat Slemmer, not kill her, but that she was unable to "put the brakes on".
paras.zh: 派克在她的宽大处理请愿书中说，她打算殴打Slemmer ，而不是杀死她，但她无法“刹车”。

paras.en: "I was a mentally ill 18-year-old kid," she said in a statement. "It took me numerous years to even realise the gravity of what I'd done. Even more to accept how many lives I affected. I took the life of someone's child, sister, friend. It sickens me now to think I had the ability to commit such a crime."
paras.zh: “我是一个患有精神疾病的18岁孩子，”她在一份声明中说。“我花了很多年才意识到我所做的事情的严重性。更重要的是要接受我影响了多少人的生命。我夺走了别人的孩子、姐姐、朋友的生命。现在，我觉得自己有能力犯下这样的罪行，这让我感到恶心。”

paras.en: The murder in 1995 created a media frenzy in Knoxville, Tennessee, after Colleen was found with an inverted pentagram - a symbol that is associated with satanic groups - carved into her chest. Pike has denied carving the symbol herself.
paras.zh: 1995年的谋杀案在田纳西州诺克斯维尔引发了一场媒体狂热，此前科琳被发现胸前刻着一个倒置的五角星--一个与撒旦团体有关的符号。派克否认自己雕刻了这个符号。

paras.en: Before the killing, Pike had accused Colleen of insulting her and trying to steal her then-boyfriend.
paras.zh: 在杀人之前，派克指责科琳侮辱她，并试图偷走她当时的男朋友。

paras.en: Two other residents at the camp later testified that Pike had bragged about the murder before and after, and showed them a piece of Colleen's skull.
paras.zh: 营地的另外两名居民后来作证说，派克在前后吹嘘这起谋杀案，并向他们展示了科琳的一块头骨。

paras.en: Colleen's mother May Martinez said she had waited decades to see Pike's sentence carried out.
paras.zh: 科琳的母亲梅·马丁内斯（ May Martinez ）说，她等了几十年才看到派克的判决得到执行。

paras.en: Over the weekend, she told the Associated Press that a group helped raise funds for her and her husband to travel from Florida to Tennessee to witness the execution.
paras.zh: 上周末，她告诉美联社，一个团体帮助她和她的丈夫从佛罗里达州前往田纳西州见证处决。

paras.en: "Not a day goes by, or a minute goes by that I do not think about Colleen. Holidays are the worst," Martinez said.
paras.zh: “没有一天过去了，也没有一分钟过去了，我没有想到Colleen。假期是最糟糕的，”马丁内斯说。

paras.en: Since 1976, when the Supreme Court resumed the death penalty, only 18 women have been executed in the US, compared to 1,663 men. That's about 1% of all US executions.
paras.zh: 自1976年最高法院恢复死刑以来，美国只有18名女性被处决，而男性为1663人。这约占美国所有处决人数的1%。

articles.title: TAEMIN Forced to Pull Plug on Entire North American Tour Due to Visa Issues: ‘No Clear Timeline For Issuance’
articles.author: Gil Kaufman

paras.en: K-pop star TAEMIN has been forced to cancel the entire North American run of his TAEMIN WORLD TOUR <LiMiNaL> due to reported visa issues. In a statement posted on X earlier this week, the solo star and former member of boy band SHINee explained, “Due to ongoing uncertainty surrounding U.S. visa and related administrative processes affecting key touring and production personnel, we have made the difficult decision to postpone the scheduled North American dates of the 2026-27 TAEMIN WORLD TOUR <LiMiNaL>.”
paras.zh: 由于签证问题，韩国流行歌星泰民被迫取消了整个北美的泰民世界巡回演唱会<LiMiNaL>。在本周早些时候在 X 上发布的一份声明中，这位独唱明星、男孩乐队 SHINee 的前成员解释道：“由于美国签证和影响关键巡演和制作人员的相关行政程序的持续不确定性，我们做出了艰难的决定，推迟原定的 2026-27 泰民世界巡回演唱会 <LiMiNaL> 的北美日期。”

paras.en: The 33-year-old singer added that a “significant number” of key touring and production staff hired for the North American tour were still awaiting their travel visas, with “no clear timeline for issuance. Given the continued uncertainty surrounding the participation of essential personnel, we determined that proceeding with the tour as scheduled would carry significant operational and production risks.”
paras.zh: 这位 33 岁的歌手补充说，为北美巡演聘用的“大量”主要巡演和制作人员仍在等待旅行签证，“没有明确的发放时间表。鉴于关键人员参与的持续不确定性，我们确定按计划进行巡演将带来重大的运营和制作风险。”

paras.en: He promised that the North American leg of his world tour remains an “integral part” of the outing and assured fans he will announce rescheduled shows soon. In the meantime, refunds for the originally scheduled North American shows will be available upon request from the original point of purchase.
paras.zh: 他承诺，他的世界巡演的北美站仍然是这次巡演的“不可或缺的一部分”，并向粉丝保证他将很快宣布重新安排的演出。与此同时，原定北美演出的退款将根据原购买点的要求提供。

paras.en: “We sincerely apologize to everyone who has been looking forward to the shows and appreciate your understanding,” he wrote. “We look forward to sharing the new North American tour dates with you soon.”
paras.zh: 他写道：“我们向所有期待演出的人致以诚挚的歉意，并感谢你们的理解。” “我们期待尽快与您分享新的北美巡演日期。”

paras.en: The six-city tour was slated to open on Oct. 12 at SAP Center in San Jose, Calif. before hitting Los Angeles, Las Vegas, Grand Prairie, Texas, Chicago and Newark, N.J.
paras.zh: 六城市巡演定于 10 月 12 日在加利福尼亚州圣何塞的 SAP 中心拉开帷幕，然后前往洛杉矶、拉斯维加斯、德克萨斯州大草原城、芝加哥和新泽西州纽瓦克。

paras.en: The dates were slated to support TAEMIN’s August EP Phase 1: SOFT VIOLENCE, which dropped four months after he made his Coachella debut with the first-ever solo set by a male Korean artist at the festival.
paras.zh: 这些日期原定是为了支持泰民 8 月的 EP 第一阶段：SOFT VIOLENCE，该专辑在泰民在科切拉音乐节首次亮相、首次由韩国男性艺术家在音乐节上独唱四个月后停播。

paras.en: Under the second Trump administration a number of international artists have faced long delays in obtaining visas and last-minute revocations by the State Department. Recent examples include Canadian indie rockers The New Pornographers, FKA Twigs, Australian artist Keli Holiday (Adam Hyde), and norteño artist Julión Álvarez.
paras.zh: 在特朗普第二届政府执政期间，许多国际艺术家在获得签证方面面临着长期拖延和国务院在最后一刻撤销签证的情况。最近的例子包括加拿大独立摇滚歌手 The New Pornographers、FKA Twigs、澳大利亚艺术家 Keli Holiday (Adam Hyde) 和北欧艺术家 Julión Álvarez。

articles.title: ‘Street Fighter’ Soundtrack Takes ‘Guile’s Theme’ From Arcade to Big Screen: See the Full Track List
articles.author: Alicia Urrea

paras.en: If you’ve ever played Street Fighter, there’s a good chance you might recognize “Guile’s Theme” before the first few notes even finish. Now, the famous melody has been transformed into a cinematic piece that gives the tune a new, adrenaline-filled life.
paras.zh: 如果您曾经玩过《街头霸王》，那么您很有可能在前几个音符结束之前就认出了“Guile 的主题”。现在，这首著名的旋律已被改编成电影作品，赋予了这首曲子新的、充满肾上腺素的生命。

paras.en: Leo Birenberg and Zach Robinson have unveiled their new version of “Guile’s Theme,” the lead single from the upcoming Street Fighter original motion picture soundtrack — and Billboard is exclusively revealing the full track list for the soundtrack below as well. “Guile’s Theme” arrives ahead of the film’s Oct. 16 theatrical release, giving one of the video game franchise’s signature musical pieces a cinematic upgrade. It pairs its familiar melody with orchestral arrangements, electric guitar and an overall heroic sound.
paras.zh: 里奥·比伦伯格 (Leo Birenberg) 和扎克·罗宾逊 (Zach Robinson) 推出了他们的新版本“Guile’s Theme”，这是即将上映的《街头霸王》原创电影原声带的主打单曲，而 Billboard 也独家公布了下面原声带的完整曲目列表。 《Guile’s Theme》在影片 10 月 16 日院线上映之前上映，为视频游戏系列的标志性音乐作品之一带来了电影化升级。它将熟悉的旋律与管弦乐编排、电吉他和整体英雄般的声音相结合。

paras.en: The new recording is more than just a nostalgic nod to the game. For Birenberg and Robinson, “Guile’s Theme” was part of the musical foundation that helped shape them as composers. The duo said the Street Fighter music has been a major influence on their musical identities since they were young, making the opportunity to reinterpret the theme for the new film extremely substantial.
paras.zh: 新录音不仅仅是对游戏的怀旧致敬。对于比伦伯格和罗宾逊来说，“Guile’s Theme”是帮助他们成为作曲家的音乐基础的一部分。两人表示，《街头霸王》音乐从他们年轻时起就对他们的音乐身份产生了重大影响，这使得重新诠释新电影主题的机会变得非常重要。

paras.en: “To describe the music of Street Fighter as an influence would simply be an understatement — it is legitimately one of the core musical works that forged our musical identities,” the pair said in a statement. “As young and budding composers, we listened to Yoko Shimomura’s iconic ‘Guile’s Theme’ probably more than Raiders of the Lost Ark. We hope fans will hear the love and reverence we hold for this music within our version of ‘Guile’s Theme.’ We are beyond grateful to Kitao [Sakurai] and the teams at Legendary and Capcom for the opportunity to contribute music to the Street Fighter universe.”
paras.zh: “将《街头霸王》的音乐描述为一种影响只是一种轻描淡写的说法——它确实是塑造我们音乐身份的核心音乐作品之一，”两人在一份声明中表示。 “作为年轻的崭露头角的作曲家，我们听下村阳子标志性的《Guile's Theme》的次数可能比《夺宝奇兵》还要多。我们希望粉丝们能够在我们版本的《Guile's Theme》中听到我们对这首音乐的热爱和崇敬。我们非常感谢北尾[樱井]以及传奇影业和卡普空的团队给了我们为《街头霸王》宇宙贡献音乐的机会。”

paras.en: The soundtrack, also due Oct. 16 via Milan Records, will feature Birenberg and Robinson’s original score for the film, along with two new original songs from industrial metal band HEALTH that were written specifically for the movie.
paras.zh: 该原声带也将通过米兰唱片公司于 10 月 16 日发行，其中包括比伦伯格和罗宾逊为电影创作的原创配乐，以及工业金属乐队 HEALTH 专为电影创作的两首新原创歌曲。

paras.en: Directed by Kitao Sakurai, the new Street Fighter brings the Capcom fighting game franchise back to theaters with Andrew Koji as Ryu, Noah Centineo as Ken Masters and Callina Liang as Chun-Li. The story is set in 1993 and follows Ryu and Ken as they reunite after being recruited by Chun-Li for the World Warrior Tournament. The expansive cast also includes Jason Mamoa as Blanka, David Dastmalchian as M. Bison, Cody Rhoes as Guile, Curtis “50 Cent” Jackson as Balrog and Joe “Roman Reigns” Anoa’i as Akuma.
paras.zh: 由北尾樱井执导的新《街头霸王》将 Capcom 格斗游戏系列带回影院，安德鲁·小司 (Andrew Koji) 饰演 Ryu，诺亚·琴蒂尼奥 (Noah Centineo) 饰演肯·马斯特斯 (Ken Masters)，卡琳娜·梁 (Callina Liang) 饰演春丽。故事发生在 1993 年，讲述了 Ryu 和 Ken 在被春丽招募参加世界战士锦标赛后重聚的故事。庞大的演员阵容还包括杰森·马莫阿（Jason Mamoa）饰演布兰卡（Blanka）、大卫·达斯马奇安（David Dastmalchian）饰演M.
